title: Director Dulux Stores - Ontario & Western Canada
description:
Position Summary

The Director, Operations for Ontario & Western Canada provides strategic and operational leadership for the Dulux store network across Ontario and Western Canada. This role is accountable for translating the store operations strategy into clear regional priorities, building a disciplined execution rhythm, and leading Regional Operations Managers to deliver consistent operating standards, strong customer experience, profitable store performance and effective people leadership.

Reporting to the VP Sales & Operations – Dulux Stores Canada, the Director will partner closely with the Director, Sales – Ontario and the Senior Director, Sales – Western Canada to align commercial priorities with store execution, sales strategy, service levels and market growth. The role will also collaborate with the Senior Director, Dulux Operations, Real Estate, Store Development, Logistics, Health & Safety, Store Audit and Customer Service partners to strengthen execution across the network.

Key Responsibilities

Store Operations & Customer Experience

  • Lead the Ontario and Western Canada store operations plan in line with Dulux business priorities and national operating standards. Turn the strategy into clear regional and store-level priorities, each with defined owners and measures.
  • Drive consistent, customer-focused execution across the store network, including service standards, store readiness, order fulfilment, merchandising, promotions and key business initiatives.
    • Improve productivity and operating discipline through effective labour planning, inventory management, process adherence and expense control. Make sure store audits, health and safety and compliance requirements are met.

    Leadership & Talent Development

    • Lead, coach and develop Regional Operations Managers, and build strong Store Manager capability across the network. Set clear expectations for leadership, customer experience and business performance across a geographically dispersed team.
    • Build leadership capability and succession depth through field engagement, talent reviews and development plans. Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, customer focus, safety and continuous improvement.

    Business Performance & Partnerships

    • Own P&L performance across Ontario and Western Canada, including store profitability, labour, controllable expenses, productivity and inventory. Take action to protect margin and close performance gaps.
    • Lead regular business reviews and field visits with Regional Operations Managers, using performance data and field insights to put recovery or acceleration plans in place. Give senior leadership clear updates on results, risks and opportunities.
    • Partner with the Director, Sales – Ontario and the Senior Director, Sales – Western Canada to align sales and operations priorities, so stores are ready to support customer acquisition, retention and growth.
    • Work with the Senior Director, Dulux Operations and enabling functions to put standard operating procedures, controls and continuous-improvement initiatives in place. Make sure operational risks and recurring store issues are resolved with clear ownership.

    Network Growth & Change

    • Lead operational readiness for new-store openings, relocations, closures and renovations. Partner with Marketing, Real Estate, Store Development, Logistics and Sales on ownership, timelines, staffing and execution.
    • Support organizational changes and regional realignments while keeping things stable for employees and customers.

    Qualifications & Competencies

    Key Competencies

    • Strategic & Operational Leadership: Turns business strategy into clear regional and store-level plans. Uses labour, expense, inventory and customer data to make sound decisions that support strong service and profitable growth.
    • People & Change Leadership: Builds strong teams and develops future leaders. Guides geographically dispersed teams through change with clear direction and accountability.
    • Collaboration & Influence: Works well across Sales, Operations and support functions. Communicates clearly and credibly with field teams, partners and senior leaders.

    Preferred Experience

    • Progressive multi-unit operations leadership experience across several regions or markets, including leading other leaders and developing field-based store teams.
    • A proven record of improving execution, customer experience, productivity and profitability across a multi-site network, backed by strong P&L, labour and inventory management.
    • Experience leading new-store openings, relocations or organizational change is an asset, as is experience in retail, trade, distribution, building products or coatings.
    • Post-secondary education in Business, Operations or a related field, or equivalent experience.

    Working Requirements

    • Regular travel throughout Ontario and Western Canada to support stores, field leaders and cross-functional initiatives.
    • Ability to work across a geographically dispersed organization and balance strategic leadership with visible field presence.

    What We Offer

    • Comprehensive benefits, including paid time off and group benefits, available from your first day.
    • $550 annual Health Spending Account for eligible health and dental expenses
    • 24/7 telemedicine services for employees and eligible dependents
    • Employee & Family Assistance Program (EFAP) providing confidential, 24/7 support for employees and their families
    • Paid wellness days for eligible employees
    • Flexible Hybrid model

    Compensation

    Compensation for this role is determined based on factors such as location, market conditions, internal equity, and the candidate's experience and qualifications. In addition to salary, full-time permanent employees are eligible for our broader total rewards package, which includes comprehensive benefits, including paid vacation and wellness days, as well as other incentives for eligible employees.

    The estimated salary for this role will be within the following range: $125000-150000 CAD annually. Candidates whose compensation expectations fall outside of the posted range are still encouraged to apply. We recognize that each candidate brings unique skills and experience, and compensation will be discussed throughout the recruitment process.

    Our Commitment to Diversity, Inclusion & Accessibility

    At Canadian Industries Limited (CIL), we are committed to creating a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where everyone has the opportunity to succeed. We welcome applications from qualified candidates of all backgrounds and experiences.

    CIL is committed to providing an accessible recruitment experience. If you require accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know. All accommodation requests will be handled confidentially and respectfully.

    We don’t use AI in our recruitment process. All hiring decisions are made by our recruitment team.

title: Regional Branch Manager
description:
Join Our Team as a Regional Branch Manager at IHMVCU!

At IHMVCU, we're committed to delivering personalized, community-centered financial solutions that help our members achieve their goals. We believe in the power of relationships and the importance of making a meaningful impact in the communities we serve. This role will oversee our Merle Hay branch and spearhead the launch and leadership of new branch locations.

Ready to make an impact? This high-visibility leadership role will shape the success and growth of our Des Moines market. You'll lead branch teams, drive sales and operational results, and create an environment where team members thrive and members receive an exceptional experience. If you're energized by developing people, achieving results, and growing a market, this could be the opportunity for you!

Experience Required:

  • Bachelor's Degree preferred with at least seven years credit union or related experience; a minimum of five years supervisory experience with demonstrated leadership ability and team building skills preferred.
  • Strong leadership skills with a professional attitude and the ability to handle difficult situations effectively. Strong skills in mediation and conflict resolution.
  • Thorough knowledge of sales, product and services; ensures appropriate application of the credit union's policies and procedures.
  • Ability to plan, organize, implement, and interpret programs, goals, objectives, policies, and procedures, and coordinate multiple projects.
  • Interpersonal skills to represent the credit union in a positive way, both internally and externally always. Ability to demonstrate IHMVCU's culture and core values.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in both oral and written communication. Accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Ability, availability and willingness to work flexible hours to accomplish workload. Job will require a non-traditional workweek with extra hours including evening and/or weekend duties.

Main Responsibilities:

Strategic Execution:

  • Ensure the successful execution of annual objectives, goals, and strategies for the assigned region.
  • Lead the promotion and demonstration of IHMVCU's culture and core values by being an active participant, a visible and available leader, and a communicator/implementer of key objectives, goals, and strategies to improve our member and employee experience.
  • Oversee financial performance within the region, including budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis to drive revenue growth.
  • Track and review regional performance levels; compile summary reports and communicate standings; develop any direct-action plans for improvement areas.

Operational Efficiency:

  • Develop and maintain a fluid retail channel staffing model based on member contact patterns and projections that maximizes efficiencies and fosters a positive working environment without sacrificing the member experience.
  • Maintain a strong control environment, including cash, dual control, security, confidentiality, audit, compliance and fraud-loss prevention requirements.
  • Maintain working knowledge of account opening, consumer lending, transaction processing, digital services and complex account-service matters in order to support the team when needed.
  • Support retail projects, pilots and change initiatives; provide practical feedback and help leaders implement new expectations consistently.

Leadership and Coaching Expectations:

  • Set clear role, activity, service and performance expectations for each team member.
  • Hold team members accountable for outbound activity, follow-up, pipeline management, referrals, production and member-service expectations appropriate to their roles.
  • Develop team members for expanded responsibilities and build a ready talent pipeline for future opportunities.
  • Create an inclusive, positive and accountable branch environment in which expectations are understood and consistently reinforced.

Member Experience and Community Engagement:

  • Resolve escalated member and operational concerns with professionalism, sound judgment and appropriate follow-through.
  • Own branch results for deposit growth, consumer lending, new accounts, ancillary products, referrals, member engagement and other established scorecard measures.
  • Partner with Mortgage, Business Services, Investment Services, Insurance and other internal teams to deepen member relationships and support qualified referrals.
  • Develop relationships with local businesses and community organizations that support membership, deposit and relationship growth.

Being a team member of IHMVCU is more than just a job, we want to make differences in the communities we live in and serve. Check out our careers page for more information including benefits Final compensation will be determined by various factors such as experience, specific skills and internal pay equity.

Move Up your career at IHMVCU with this great opportunity!

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Sitting: Sedentary work involves sitting most of the time. Jobs are sedentary if walking and standing are required only occasionally, and all other sedentary criteria are met.
  • Talking: Expressing or exchanging ideas by means of the spoken word; those activities where detailed or important spoken instructions must be conveyed to other workers accurately, loudly, or quickly.
  • Hearing: Perceiving the nature of sounds at normal speaking levels with or without correction and having the ability to receive detailed information through oral communication and making fine discriminations in sound.
  • Finger, handle, touch: Picking, pinching, typing or otherwise working, primarily with fingers rather than with whole hand or arm as in handling. Applying pressure to an object with the fingers and palm.
  • Lifting Demands: Up to 10 lbs.
  • Visual Demands: Visual acuity to do things such as: preparing and analyzing data and figures; transcribing; viewing a computer terminal; extensive reading. Ability to identify and distinguish colors. The worker is required to have visual acuity to operate motor vehicles.

title: Utility
description:
MUST COMPLETE ENTIRE APPLICATION TO BE CONSIDERED

Boise Cascade's most valuable asset is its employees. Join our production team as a utility employee.

Boise Cascade has been in the business of manufacturing wood products and distributing building materials for over half a century. Today we’re one of the largest manufacturers of plywood and engineered wood products in North America – and the only wholesale stocking distributor for building products that can service the entire United States. Because our business is built on relationships, our employees are critical to our success. And we’re committed to investing in them. We call it, Total Rewards. Here’s a look at what’s included:

  • Medical + Prescription Drug

title: Quality Auditor (2nd Shift)
description:
The Quality Auditor is responsible for ensuring that processes within the distribution center are aligned with Bosch’s Quality Management System (QMS) and ISO 9001 standards. This role involves conducting regular audits, performing ISIR inspections, managing Statistical Quality Control (SQC), and supporting quality improvement activities. The auditor will verify compliance, report deviations from standards, and ensure that countermeasures are put in place for the immediate containment of issues. The role is key in supporting quality assurance and continuous improvement across the distribution center.

Key Responsibilities

  • QMS & ISO 9001 Compliance: Verify that processes within the distribution center are aligned with Bosch’s Quality Management System (QMS) and ISO 9001 standards, ensuring all processes are documented and compliant with quality standards.
  • Internal Audits: Conduct regular internal audits to assess compliance with QMS and ISO 9001 requirements, documenting findings and reporting deviations from the processes or standards.
  • Deviations and Corrective Actions: Report deviations from processes or standards in a timely manner. Ensure that countermeasures are implemented for immediate containment and that corrective actions are taken to address non-conformities.
  • Quality Reporting: Compile and document daily reports on VQ audits performed, non-conformities found, and corrective actions taken. Ensure timely and accurate communication and documentation in compliance with Bosch standards.

title: Solutions Engineer – Physical AI
description:
Who we are

Roofline is building a Deployment Platform to run any AI model on disruptive hardware at the edge. As a Solutions Engineer, you’ll make that real for our customers: getting their models running on their hardware, driving proof-of-concepts to adoption, and representing Roofline at conferences. What you learn in the field shapes what our engineering team builds next.

Why us?

  • The opportunity to grow. Be at the forefront of building and shaping an industry-defining venture. There are plenty of opportunities to learn and evolve.
  • The team succeeded. We are building the leading AI compiler team in Europe. Join our future-focused team to contribute to meaningful, disruptive innovations with us.
  • The flexibility you need. Whether you need to take extra time off, adjust your schedule, or have other ideas to maximize your productivity, we’ve got your back
  • The compensation that rewards. We are looking for world class talent and pay accordingly. We offer equity for every employee since we truly want you to participate in our success.
  • The culture you desire. We actively make space to build our culture. We organize dedicated regular events and retreats for the whole team.

Your mission

  • As the technical face of Roofline, you represent us to customers and ecosystem partners, at conferences, in technical talks and workshops. You’ll be the person our sales team brings in when the conversation gets technical.
  • Act as technical lead on customer engagements: define the technical approach, plan and coordinate the day-to-day work of the engineers assigned to your project, and own delivery from proof-of-concept to adoption.
  • Design and build applications with Roofline’s tools on real customer use cases. Support where it counts: pair with customer engineers, fix integration issues, and get their models running on their target hardware.
  • Own the technical strategy of the sales cycle and handle our strategic engagement with customers. Help to build and drive proof-of-concepts, and deliver benchmarks and evaluations (latency, throughput, power, memory footprint) that turn interest into adoption.
  • Shape our developer-facing tools to deliver the best possible user experience. Translate customer needs into a technical direction and develop concrete product proposals, working with our engineers to get them built.
  • Raise the level of the team around you. Mentor engineers and make our technical go-to-market strategy scalable.

Your profile

  • Several years hands-on experience in AI and embedded systems, including experience working with customers and partners.
  • Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related fields.
  • Strong C/C++, Python skills
  • Familiarity with ML frameworks and compiler stacks (PyTorch, ONNX, MLIR, TVM/IREE or similar)
  • A track record of taking AI use cases from a vague customer conversation to a working prototype on target hardware. Using model optimization and quantization, deployment through real toolchains and runtimes, and debugging the cases where accuracy or latency doesn't match the datasheet.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, and at ease in front of technical customers, at the whiteboard or on a conference stage.
  • Demonstrated technical influence beyond your own deliverables. Have product changes you argued for and got shipped, engineers you've mentored, or practices a team adopted because you established them.
  • Ambition and curiosity to solve complex problems, a strong mindset to take ownership and drive our solutions forwards, and a collaborative attitude to foster our culture.

Nice to haves:
  • Several years of industry experience building AI models, e.g. in automotive, robotics, vision, or language.
  • Experience working with embedded targets or compiler infrastructure, e.g., LLVM.
  • Business development and sales experience.

title: Internship Specialistico - Chirurgia (VA)
description:
R-261539 Discipline Specific Intern – Surgery (VA)

Luogo – Clinica Veterinaria Malpensa, Samarate (VA)
Orario – In regime di libera professione. La pianificazione delle attività sarà concordata in modo flessibile in base alle reciproche disponibilità.

Perché unirsi a noi?

  • Intraprenderai un percorso di Internship Specialistico in Chirurgia, svolto sotto la supervisione di un Diplomato al College Europeo di Chirurgia Veterinaria (ECVS).

  • Affiancherai professionisti esperti e ti confronterai quotidianamente con casistiche chirurgiche diversificate, acquisendo esperienza in un contesto specialistico.

  • Approfondirai diverse aree della chirurgia veterinaria, tra cui chirurgia generale, oncologica, mini-invasiva, cardiochirurgia, vascolare e d'emergenza.

  • Acquisirai e consolidarai competenze cliniche e scientifiche attraverso l'esposizione alle attività del reparto e il confronto con il team di Chirurgia e Anestesia.

  • Potrai affrontare le selezioni per un programma di Residency in Chirurgia Veterinaria, attraverso un percorso orientato alla futura specializzazione.

Il team

AniCura Clinica Veterinaria Malpensa è una struttura veterinaria di referenza aperta 24 ore su 24, situata in provincia di Varese, nelle vicinanze dell'Aeroporto di Milano Malpensa. La clinica gestisce circa 10.000 casi all'anno e offre un'ampia varietà di servizi specialistici, in un contesto caratterizzato da un approccio multidisciplinare e da un'elevata casistica.

La struttura dispone di tecnologie diagnostiche e terapeutiche avanzate, tra cui risonanza magnetica ad alto campo Siemens da 1,5 Tesla, TC a 128 strati, apparecchiature di elettrodiagnostica, ecografia, radiologia digitale, ecocardiografia, ECG digitale, sistemi Holter, laboratorio di elettrofisiologia ed endoscopia rigida e flessibile. Completano la dotazione il laboratorio analisi interno, l'Unità di Terapia Intensiva e Rianimazione e il reparto di degenza.

Il reparto di Chirurgia è composto da 12 medici veterinari chirurghi e offre servizi di chirurgia di base, specialistica e mini-invasiva. L'attività comprende diverse aree di intervento, tra cui chirurgia generale, oncologica, mini-invasiva, cardiochirurgia, chirurgia vascolare e chirurgia d'emergenza.

La clinica garantisce inoltre un servizio di chirurgia d'emergenza attivo 24 ore su 24, 7 giorni su 7, grazie alla stretta collaborazione con il reparto di Anestesia e Terapia Antalgica, composto da 11 anestesisti.

Il reparto rappresenta un contesto di formazione specialistica, nel quale il confronto tra diverse competenze e discipline consente di approfondire la gestione dei casi chirurgici e i relativi percorsi diagnostici e terapeutici.

Cosa cerchiamo

  • Laurea in Medicina Veterinaria e regolare iscrizione all'Ordine dei Medici Veterinari, con abilitazione all'esercizio della professione.

  • Possesso di Partita IVA o disponibilità ad attivarla.

  • Interesse specifico per la Chirurgia Veterinaria e motivazione a intraprendere un percorso di formazione specialistica in questo ambito.

  • Preferibile una precedente esperienza clinica, ad esempio attraverso un Rotating Internship o altre esperienze formative in strutture veterinarie.

  • Capacità di lavorare in team e di collaborare efficacemente con professionisti appartenenti a diverse discipline specialistiche.

  • Buone capacità relazionali, comunicative e di gestione del paziente e del proprietario.

  • Forte motivazione all'apprendimento, all'aggiornamento scientifico e alla crescita professionale, con interesse a proseguire il proprio percorso verso una possibile Residency in Chirurgia Veterinaria.

Cosa offriamo

  • Collaborazione in P. Iva.

  • Percorso formativo di Internship Specialistico della durata da 6 a 12 mesi.

  • Possibilità di usufruire di sconti dedicati sui servizi clinici AniCura e presso partner selezionati, tra cui Royal Canin.

  • Accesso alla piattaforma di convenzioni, che offre sconti e offerte speciali su un'ampia gamma di prodotti e servizi.

  • Opportunità di partecipare a seminari e conferenze che favoriscono il continuo aggiornamento professionale e consentono di mantenere le proprie competenze costantemente aggiornate.

  • Formazione continua attraverso programmi di e-learning e percorsi formativi dedicati.

  • Supporto psicologico.

Pronto per il tuo prossimo passo? Candidati oggi e diventa parte della creazione di UN MONDO MIGLIORE PER GLI ANIMALI DOMESTICI.

Chi siamo

AniCura è uno dei principali fornitori europei di cure veterinarie, che riunisce una rete di cliniche e ospedali veterinari dedicati alla salute e al benessere degli animali da compagnia. La nostra ambizione è plasmare il futuro della medicina veterinaria attraverso la collaborazione continua, la condivisione delle migliori pratiche e l'impegno verso i nostri valori fondamentali.

Facciamo parte di Mars Veterinary Health, la più grande azienda veterinaria a conduzione familiare al mondo. Come parte di questa rete globale connessa, ogni anno aiutiamo a curare milioni di animali domestici e sosteniamo le persone che li amano. Essere di proprietà privata ci consente di rimanere concentrati sul nostro Scopo - UN MONDO MIGLIORE PER GLI ANIMALI DOMESTICI - e di investire nell'erogazione di cure veterinarie di alta qualità in ogni fase.

In AniCura, prendersi cura degli animali inizia dal prendersi cura delle nostre persone. Siamo orgogliosi di una cultura basata sulla collaborazione, sull'apprendimento e sul supporto, in cui i colleghi sono incoraggiati a svilupparsi sia personalmente sia professionalmente. Le nostre persone sono al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo e sono ciò che ci distingue davvero. Quando ti unisci ad AniCura, diventi parte di qualcosa di più grande: un'organizzazione internazionale in crescita che sta contribuendo a creare un futuro prospero per le cure veterinarie e per i professionisti che le rendono possibili.

AniCura è un datore di lavoro che garantisce pari opportunità e tutti i candidati qualificati saranno presi in considerazione per l'assunzione indipendentemente da razza, colore, religione, sesso, orientamento sessuale, identità di genere, origine nazionale, stato di disabilità, appartenenza alle categorie protette o qualsiasi altra caratteristica protetta dalla legge. Se hai bisogno di assistenza o di un adattamento durante il processo di candidatura a causa di una disabilità, tale assistenza è disponibile su richiesta scrivendo a giada.malerba@anicura.it. AniCura è lieta di fornire tale assistenza e nessun candidato sarà penalizzato a seguito di tale richiesta.

title: Larsen Strings - Produktionschef
description:
Vil du have ansvar for at produktionen fungerer godt hver dag, og være tæt nok på til at se, hvad der skal til, når planen møder virkeligheden?

Larsen Strings søger en erfaren produktionschef der trives med daglig planlægning, nærværende personaleledelse og praktisk problemløsning. Du følger produktionen tæt, hjælper medarbejderne med at lykkes og omsætter data og ny teknologi, herunder AI, til løsninger der virker i hverdagen.

Om Larsen Strings

Larsen Strings udvikler, producerer og distribuerer strenge til violin, bratsch og cello til musikere over hele verden. Virksomheden blev grundlagt i 1990 af Laurits Th. Larsen og har hovedsæde i Sønderborg, hvor vi beskæftiger ca. 35 medarbejdere. Vores produkter anvendes af både solister, ensembler og orkestre på de største internationale scener. Med en stærk kombination af innovation, kvalitet og musikalsk forståelse har vi placeret os som et af de førende brands inden for strenge til strygeinstrumenter.

Din rolle

Du refererer til CEO Thomas Petersen, er en del af ledergruppen og leder den daglige produktion i Sønderborg. Rollen er operationel og synlig: Du følger planerne, er i dialog med medarbejderne på tværs af skift og tager fat, når bemanding, maskiner eller materialer udfordrer driften. Du får personaleansvar for et team på ca. 13 medarbejdere. Lederen af teknisk afdeling og indkøber refererer direkte til dig, og du samarbejder med kolleger på tværs af virksomheden.

Produktionen kører i 3 skift og fremstiller til lager. Du omsætter derfor lagerstatus, efterspørgsel, salg og tilgængelig kapacitet til en realistisk produktionsplan og følger op, når forudsætningerne ændrer sig.

Hos os bliver du en del af en international virksomhed med stærke faglige traditioner, høj kvalitetsbevidsthed og en højt automatiseret produktion, hvor håndværk, præcision og teknisk forståelse fortsat spiller en afgørende rolle.

Dine vigtigste opgaver

  • Planlægge og følge op på produktion, bemanding, kapacitet, materialer og leverancer, herunder ugentlige opfølgninger med 3. partsproduktion i Tjekkiet.
  • Være en nærværende leder på tværs af skift med tydelige forventninger, løbende dialog og opfølgning.
  • Gennemføre løbende forbedringer og bidrage til vurdering af automatisering og maskininvesteringer ud fra behov, effekt og økonomi.
  • Følge produktivitet, lager og maskinudnyttelse og omsætte observationer og data til konkrete handlinger.
  • Arbejde tæt sammen med Teknisk Afdeling om stabil drift, forebyggende vedligehold, fejl og forbedringer.
  • Koordinere disponering af råvarer og hjælpematerialer med indkøb og de øvrige relevante kolleger.

AI og digital udvikling i driften

AI kan støtte produktionsplanlægningen ved at samle data om lager, salg og pipeline. Du hjælper med at finde og afprøve relevante løsninger, for eksempel en intern sprogmodel eller AI-agenter, og omsætte dem til arbejdsgange, medarbejderne kan bruge.

Du har praktisk forståelse for, hvor AI kan skabe værdi i driften og kan vurdere datagrundlag, begrænsninger og kvaliteten af resultaterne. Sammen med virksomhedens fagfolk og leverandører hjælper du løsningerne ind i hverdagen.

Vi forestiller os følgende om dig

Du har flere års erfaring med produktionsledelse og trives med at være tæt på den daglige drift. Erfaring fra teknisk eller automatiseret serieproduktion med flere skift er en fordel. Du har en teknisk uddannelse eller tilsvarende teknisk forståelse og praktisk erfaring.

  • Du forstår produktionsprocesser og maskiner godt nok til at prioritere, stille de rigtige spørgsmål og samarbejde kvalificeret med teknikere og leverandører.
  • Du har arbejdet med produktionsplanlægning, ERP-systemer og driftsdata. Kendskab til Business Central, Power BI og lignende er en fordel.
  • Du kan pege på praktiske måder, AI kan hjælpe med planlægning eller andre opgaver i driften.
  • Du er tydelig, empatisk og handlekraftig og motiveres af at skabe resultater sammen med medarbejderne.

Vi tilbyder

En alsidig lederrolle tæt på produktionen i en specialiseret, international virksomhed med korte veje fra beslutning til handling. Du får tæt kontakt til produktionen og mulighed for at påvirke den daglige planlægning, udvikle medarbejderne og afprøve ny teknologi i praksis. Løn og øvrige vilkår aftales efter erfaring og kvalifikationer.

Tiltrædelse og kontakt

Tiltrædelse efter aftale. Der er mulighed for overdragelse fra den nuværende produktionschef i løbet af januar 2027. Larsen Strings bistås af LOHFF|THORNING i processen. Kontakt Marck Thorning på +45 43 14 42 01 eller marck@lohffthorning.dk, hvis du vil høre mere om stillingen.

title: Senior Construction Project Manager
description:
Turner & Townsend Heery is seeking a Senior Construction Project Manager to join our Spokane team.

The Senior Construction Project Manager will monitor large, complex construction projects for clients, with direct accountability for project delivery.

Responsibilities:

  • Conduct periodic site visits to monitor the progress of construction.
  • Review status of work completed during the period covered.
  • Review that work is generally proceeding in a good and workmanlike manner and in general accordance with the approved drawings and specifications.
  • Review contractors' direct cost payment requisitions and budget status.
  • Review of subcontracts, bonds/subcontractor default insurance.
  • Review of change orders.
  • Review of Developer's monthly job cost reports and opine on adequacy of contingency.
  • Review of construction and disbursement schedules.
  • Review of lien waiver and other documentation submitted by the Developer.
  • Prepare project status reports and recommend the release of construction funds.
  • Review contract drawings and specifications and opine for completeness and general compliance with commonly accepted architectural /engineering best practices.
  • Analyze the Developer's direct and indirect cost budget including cost estimate back-up and coordinate with the Cost Advisory group performing parameter estimates, spot quantity take-offs and review of supporting documentation submitted by the Developer, contractor and subcontractors.
  • Review and make relevant comments concerning the terms of the construction agreement, the submitted subcontracts, architectural and engineering design agreements, building loan agreement as well as review both Contractor and Architect's qualification statements.
  • Review and comment on construction and disbursement schedules as well as other submitted documents including but not limited to:
    • Zoning approvals
    • Certified surveys
    • Building permits and approvals
    • Utility company approval letters
    • Soil and foundation engineering reports
    • Designer's certification of code and ADA compliance.
  • Prepare Construction Risk Assessment Reports.
  • Other duties as assigned.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong organizational and analytical skills.
  • Ability to provide efficient, timely, reliable and courteous service to customers.
  • Ability to effectively present information.
  • Requires in-depth knowledge of financial terms and principles.
  • Ability to calculate complex figures.
  • Ability to forecast and prepare budgets.
  • Conducts financial/business analysis including the preparation of reports.
  • Ability to solve advanced problems and deal with a variety of options in complex situations.
  • Requires expert level analytical and quantitative skills with proven experience in developing strategic solutions for a growing matrix-based multi-industry sales environment.
  • Draws upon the analysis of others and makes recommendations that have a direct impact on the company.
  • Intermediate skills with Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Ability to read and understand architectural drawings.
  • Knowledge in MS Project, leases, contracts, and construction practices.
  • Knowledge of the entitlement/permitting process and construction delivery methods and agreements.
  • Familiarity with construction best practices, general building codes, and various building types and systems.
  • Passion for being detail oriented and highly organized

Education and Experience:

  • 5-10 years managing public sector construction projects including design and construction phases.
  • Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, or related field.
  • Experience with alternative contract delivery - CM/GC specific.
  • Licensure as either a Professional Engineer or Registered Architect is desired.

Preferences:

  • CCM or CACM certification.
  • Professional DBIA certification.
  • Experience with Progressive D/B delivery.
  • Experience with K-12 or other public education facilities

title: Elektronik- eller datafagtekniker til Fregatten NIELS JUEL i Korsør
description:
”JOIN THE NAVY – SEE THE WORLD”

Er du uddannet elektronikfagtekniker, IT- eller elektronikteknolog, datafagtekniker?

Kan du tænke dig at arbejde som driftstekniker med højteknologiske radarer, satellitkommunikation, sonar og større integrerede netværk?

Har du lyst til at bruge dine færdigheder, indgå i et stærkt socialt og fagligt fællesskab og samtidigt se verdenen?

Så er du måske den nye kollega, vi søger i elektroniksektionen på NIELS JUEL.

OM NIELS JUEL

Fregatten NIELS JUEL er én af tre fregatter i IVER HUITFELDT-klassen, som er Søværnets største sejlende enhed og en af Danmarks mest avancerede og teknologisk varierede arbejdspladser med en bred vifte af sensor-, kommunikations- og computersystemer som f.eks. radarer, sonar, HF-radioer og taktiske netværk.
NIELS JUEL er et moderne skib med basehavn i Korsør, der kan løse en bred vifte af sømilitære opgaver – nationalt såvel som internationalt.

Elektroniksektionen består af i alt otte konstabler, to befalingsmænd og én officer. Sektionen er en del af Våben- og Elektronikdivisionen, der ledes af skibets Våben- og Elektronikofficer. Divisionen varetager drift og vedligehold på skibets våben- og elektroniksystemer, der udgør ca. halvdelen af alle skibets tekniske systemer.

Dine kommende kollegaer lægger vægt på det sociale både på skibet og til en række sociale arrangementer i løbet af året. De har en høj faglighed og stærkt sammenhold og består af både unge og erfarne medarbejdere.

STILLINGEN INDEBÆRER

Du vil indgå som en af besætningens teknikere, der har til opgave at servicere og overvåge skibets elektroniksystemer, herunder sensor-, kommunikations- og navigationssystemer såvel som informations- og kommunikationstjenester og netværk.

På søen vil du, udover at deltage i det daglige arbejde, være med til at opretholde skibets beredskab og indgå i klartskibs organisation, som led i at håndtere skader under kamp og reparere skibets systemer.
Til søs kan belastningen være meget varieret alt efter skibets aktivitetsniveau. Lange dage må derfor kunne forventes, når skibet er til søs.

NIELS JUEL sejler både nationalt og internationalt, hvilket giver mulighed for at få mange spændende oplevelser blandt forskellige kulturer og nationaliteter.

NIELS JUEL har basehavn i Korsør, og når skibet er hjemme, vil der være mulighed for afspadsering.
Ud over det daglige arbejde i havn, skal der bestrides en vagt ombord, hvori du indgår i tørnen med resten af divisionens konstabler.

Vi kan tilbyde et alsidigt job i en dynamisk hverdag med mulighed for udvikling, herunder et uddannelses- og tjenesteforløb med kurser og efteruddannelse, hvor vi tager udgangspunkt i din baggrund og de kompetencer, som du skal have i din specifikke stilling, og, i videst muligt omfang, dine ønsker.
Vi lægger vægt på høj faglighed, udvikling samt et godt kollegialskab. Elektroniksektionen har et tæt samarbejde med skibets våbensektion, som til sammen udgør Våben- og Elektronikdivisionen.

Niels Juel kigger ind i 2027 som et travlt år, grundet opkøring imod certificering til INTOPS, derfor vil 2027 tilbyde en masse træningsaktivitet under sejlads med havne ophold i mange spændende lande.

KVALIFIKATIONER

Du er uddannet elektronikfagtekniker, IT- eller elektronikteknolog, datafagtekniker.

Du vil blive en del af Elektroniksektionens teknikere på konstabel-niveau, og vil derfor have hands-on på sektionens materiel. Dit arbejde vil kræve en selvstændig og analytisk tilgang til udfordringer - stærkt støttet af resten af sektionens personel.

Vi forventer, at du har et åben og fordomsfrit sind, samt at du imødeser tekniske udfordringer og anser dem som noget positivt, ser muligheder i stedet for begrænsninger og er klar på at være en del af et ungt, lærende og omskifteligt team.

Både militære og civile ansøgere er velkomne, med og uden tidligere erhvervserfaring. Uanset uddannelse og baggrund, hører vi gerne fra dig hvis du synes stillingen lyder spændende.

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning, samt CV.

Krav:

Du skal kunne gennemføre eller have gennemført Søværnets Basis Uddannelse (SBU)*.

Du skal have en afsluttet uddannelse som elektronikfagtekniker, IT- eller elektronikteknolog eller datafagtekniker. Hvis du næsten er færdig med din uddannelse så venter vi gerne på den rette ansøger.

Du skal kunne sikkerhedsgodkendes til klassifikationsgraden HEMMELIGT.

Du skal kunne erklæres egnet til internationale operationer.

*Hvis du har en grunduddannelse fra HRN eller FLV vil det være muligt at overgå til SVN med et tre-ugers omskoling, samt tekniske kurser ved Søværnets Skole - Center for Sømilitær Teknologi.

Helbredskrav:

Helbredsvurdering: Helbred egnet C

Tandvurdering: Tand egnet C

Vaccination: Grundvaccination

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår

Stillingen er en konstabelstilling på overenskomstmæssige vilkår. Stillingen kan besættes med en tjenestemand. Løn m.v. er reguleret ved den til enhver tid gældende LC/CO10-fællesoverenskomst og organisationsaftale mellem Forsvarsministeriets Personalestyrelse, CO10 og Centralforeningen for Stampersonel for stampersonel af linjen og reserven samt elever i Forsvarsministeriet med tilhørende myndigheder.

Faglært tillæg er betinget af godkendt uddannelse mod fremvisning af gældende svendebrev eller uddannelsesbevis jf. gældende overenskomst.

Dit faste tjenestested vil være i Korsør.

Som ansat i Forsvarsministeriets område er du omfattet af nogle særlige vilkår. Du skal bl.a. kunne sikkerhedsgodkendes og opretholde sikkerhedsgodkendelsen under hele ansættelsesforløbet.

Du har som ansat pligt til at forrette tjeneste uden for landets grænser, herunder ved enheder i internationale operationer med henblik på deltagelse i konfliktforebyggende, fredsbevarende, fredsskabende, humanitære og andre lignende operationer.

Du skal være opmærksom på, at der knytter sig fysiske og funktionsrelaterede helbredsmæssige krav til stillingen.

I stillingen er du til enhver tid forpligtet til at kunne opfylde de helbredsmæssige og fysiske krav, der er fastsat for funktionen – her C som betyder, at du skal kunne opnå en helbredsgodkendelse til fuld tjeneste uden geografiske begrænsninger af nogen art.

KONTAKT OG ANSØGNING

Hvis du har uddybende spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte skibets Elektronikbefalingsmand Thomas Olsen, telefon 30 11 11 36 eller 72 85 43 44. Telefontid tirsdag-torsdag 0900-1500.

Har du spørgsmål til løn- og ansættelsesvilkår, kan du kontakte HR-konsulent Birgit Dyrholm ved Forsvarsministeriets Personalestyrelse på telefon 72 81 91 71 eller mail PKOM-BDY@MIL.DK.

title: Vi søger en ny eventkoordinator-elev
description:
Vil du være med til at skabe flere og mere loyale striber og begejstre fællesskabet gennem events og oplevelser – lige fra Odense Stadion til resten af Fyn? Så søger vi en eventkoordinator-elev.

Odense Boldklub er Syddanmarks største sportsbrand, og med en voksende fanskare har vi brug for en elev, der tør gå forrest og skabe nye muligheder. Du brænder for OB, elsker fodbold og forstår fodboldverdenen. Sammen med os skal du skabe stribede oplevelser og stærke fællesskaber på Fyn – og sikre den bedst mulige stadionoplevelse for vores fans.

Hvad indebærer jobbet? Du lærer at:

  • Planlægge events på kampdage
  • Booke kunstnere og sikre en høj kvalitet i indholdet på kampdage
  • Planlægge tilbud til vores unge striber og sikre, at vi altid er relevante for vores yngre fans
  • Lede et kampdagsteam
  • Løse administrative opgaver, herunder evaluering af events
  • Styre årshjulet og koordinere opgaver

Vi søger en elev, der:

  • Har stor interesse for OB, sport og eventbranchen
  • Har lyst til at tage ansvar og lære at drive projekter i mål
  • Er struktureret og gerne vil blive god til at bevare overblikket i travle situationer
  • Kan lide at kommunikere og samarbejde med andre
  • Er fleksibel og klar til at arbejde, når det kræves – også aften og weekend
  • Har power og passion for at skabe den bedste oplevelse for vores fans og fællesskabet

Vi kan tilbyde dig:

  • Ansvar og egne projekter
  • Et stærkt team, der støtter din faglige og personlige udvikling
  • En arbejdsplads med fart på, hvor dagene er spændende og byder på varierede opgaver
  • Indblik i, hvordan man driver en professionel fodboldklub

**Praktisk information
**Stillingen starter i begyndelsen af januar 2027.

Hvis du er nysgerrig på, hvem vi er, og hvordan events og arrangementer kan se ud hos os, kan du følge med på vores sociale medier.

Ansøgningsfristen er den 20. november 2026 kl. 12.00. Samtaler bliver afholdt i uge 49.

Du kan søge elevstillingen her.

Har du spørgsmål forud for din ansøgning, er du velkommen til at kontakte oplevelseschef Daniel Walsh på dwal@ob.dk.

Skoleophold under uddannelsen
Som en del af eventkoordinatoruddannelsen indgår der obligatoriske skoleophold på TietgenSkolen i Odense inden for følgende fagområder:

  • Eventjura og drejebog
  • Event og idéudvikling
  • Regler, sikkerhed og kvalitet
  • Projektstyring og eventøkonomi

Derudover indgår der mellem 2 og 6 ugers valgfag, som ligeledes afholdes på TietgenSkolen i Odense.

Har du spørgsmål om skoleophold og adgangskrav, kan du kontakte vores samarbejdspartner Christel Bjerremann fra TietgenSkolen på ciha@tietgen.dk.

title: Airport Operations Duty Manager
description:
Vil du være med til at sikre en stabil drift, høj punktlighed og god koordinering på tværs af lufthavnens mange samarbejdspartnere? Som Airport Operations Duty Manager får du en central rolle i den daglige operation, hvor du bidrager til hurtige beslutninger, effektiv håndtering af hændelser og et tæt samarbejde mellem interne og eksterne aktører.

Din nye rolle
Som Airport Operations Duty Manager er du en central del af den daglige styring og koordinering af lufthavnens operationelle drift. Du fungerer som et vigtigt kontaktpunkt mellem operationelle partnere og interne interessenter og bidrager til, at lufthavnens drift forløber sikkert, stabilt og effektivt.

Dine vigtigste opgaver bliver at:

  • Sikre tværgående operationel koordinering i driftstiden mellem kl. 05:00 og 23:00
  • Være gatekeeper for interne og eksterne henvendelser vedrørende den daglige drift
  • Koordinere håndteringen af operationelle hændelser, der påvirker drift og punktlighed
  • Sikre rettidig, tydelig og ensartet kommunikation til relevante interessenter
  • Bidrage til tidlig planlægning og koordinering på tværs af lufthavnens operation
  • Understøtte en stabil og effektiv trafikafvikling
  • Skabe fremdrift og sikre gode beslutninger i komplekse driftssituationer

Rollen kræver både overblik, evnen til at træffe beslutninger og evnen til at skabe følgeskab på tværs af mange interessenter.

Din nye afdeling
Den daglige afvikling af flytrafikken og passagerernes rejse gennem lufthavnen er kernen i Operational Airport Services.

Vi sikrer, at flyoperationer, bagage, service og rengøring fungerer effektivt og sikkert, så driften hænger sammen fra start til slut. Du bliver en del af et område, hvor vi arbejder døgnet rundt for at få fly i luften til tiden og sikre en smidig og tryg rejse for tusindvis af passagerer hver dag.

Du bliver en del af Punctuality & Operational Relations, som har ansvaret for at overvåge og forbedre punktligheden i lufthavnens trafikafvikling. Afdelingen arbejder tæt sammen med flyselskaber, ground handlere, Naviair og øvrige operationelle partnere for at sikre en koordineret og effektiv drift. Som Airport Operations Duty Manager får du en synlig rolle i dette samarbejde og bidrager til at skabe de bedst mulige rammer for både passagerer og samarbejdspartnere.

Om dig
Du trives i et travlt driftsmiljø, hvor opgaverne er mange, og hvor prioriteringer kan skifte hurtigt. Du er god til at skabe overblik, samarbejde med mange forskellige interessenter og træffe velovervejede beslutninger, også når situationen er kompleks.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har minimum to års erfaring med operationel drift inden for luftfart
  • Har dokumenteret erfaring med koordinering af operationelle opgaver
  • Er god til at skabe struktur og overblik i komplekse situationer
  • Selv tager initiativ til at koordinere i god tid
  • Får hurtigt overblik i komplekse situationer og træffer velovervejede valg
  • Kommunikerer klart og professionelt på både dansk og engelsk
  • Trives i et vagtbaseret setup med skiftende arbejdstider

Du bliver en del af en turnusordning med vagter mellem kl. 05:00 og 23:00, herunder weekendvagt hver tredje weekend.

CPH som arbejdsplads
Tæt på driften – dér hvor det hele sker

Lufthavne er en by i byen. Her bidrager tusindvis af mennesker på tværs af fagligheder og virksomheder til at holde lufthavnen i gang – døgnet rundt, året rundt.

Du træder ind på en arbejdsplads med fokus på samarbejde, faglig stolthed og professionalisme, hvor din indsats er afgørende for helheden.

Hvad vi tilbyder
I CPH gør vi os umage for at skabe gode rammer om din hverdag.

Du får adgang til medarbejdergoder, der både gør arbejdslivet lettere og giver balance i hverdagen. Det gælder blandt andet attraktive barselsvilkår, sundhedsforsikring for dig og din familie, pensionsordning, gratis parkering, gode transportmuligheder samt træningsfaciliteter og adgang til sundhedscenter.

Samtidig bliver du en del af et mangfoldigt og inspirerende fællesskab med mulighed for personlig og faglig udvikling samt sociale aktiviteter.

Yderligere information
Har du spørgsmål til jobbet, kan du kontakte Head of Punctuality & Operational Relations, Michael Nicolaisen på michael.nicolaisen@cph.dk. Ansøgninger modtages kun via vores rekrutteringssystem.

Ansøgningsfrist
Vi ser frem til at modtage dit CV hurtigst muligt og senest den 29. november 2026. Vi vurderer kandidater løbende og ansætter, når den rette kandidat er fundet.

Vi skaber forbindelse til verden

CPH har i mere end 100 år forbundet mennesker og kulturer. Vi sender danskerne ud i verden og byder verden velkommen til Danmark. På tværs af CPH og i samarbejde med vores partnere udvikler vi fremtidens lufthavne. Sammen skaber vi ansvarlig vækst gennem sikker og stabil drift, digitalisering og gode passageroplevelser.

Det er en forudsætning for ansættelse, at du kan blive politigodkendt og opretholde godkendelsen gennem hele din ansættelse.

Læs mere om hvordan det er at være medarbejder hos os på cph.dk/job.

title: Account Development Manager
description:
The Account Development Manager is a key member of the US Commercial team responsible for driving sales growth through assigned Pittsburgh Paints Store accounts. This role focuses on expanding existing business, developing new customer relationships, and increasing product adoption across an assigned territory.

This is a remote/field-based sales position in the Pittsburgh Market requiring strong relationship-building skills, a growth mindset, and the ability to identify and capture new business opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive sales growth by expanding existing accounts, increasing product adoption, and achieving territory sales goals
  • Develop new business opportunities through prospecting, customer outreach, and relationship-building
  • Build and maintain strong customer partnerships to increase retention and minimize sales loss
  • Create and execute territory sales plans to maximize market coverage and prioritize high-value opportunities
  • Utilize consultative selling techniques to understand customer needs and recommend solutions
  • Improve profitability by managing pricing opportunities, discounts, margins, and overall territory performance
  • Track sales activity, customer engagement, forecasts, and performance metrics using CRM tools and reporting systems
  • Educate customers on products, promotions, and solutions to increase engagement and sales
  • Collaborate with internal teams including Operations, Corporate Account Managers, Marketing, and Customer Service to support customer success
  • Represent the Pittsburgh Paints Company brand professionally through customer interactions and field activities

Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED required
  • Sales experience required; outside sales experience preferred
  • Strong prospecting skills with a “hunter” mentality and passion for winning new business
  • Experience with CRM systems preferred
  • Coatings or related industry experience a plus
  • Ability to travel daily within assigned territory
  • Valid driver’s license required
  • Strong communication, relationship-building, and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to adapt quickly and thrive in a fast-paced environment

Success Factors

The ideal candidate demonstrates:

  • Strong drive to achieve and exceed sales goals
  • Customer-focused approach with the ability to understand market needs
  • Action-oriented mindset with a passion for results
  • Ability to build trust and strong partnerships
  • Coachable, collaborative, and team-oriented approach
  • Energy, responsiveness, and the ability to succeed in a dynamic sales environment

Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without employment-based visa sponsorship (now or in the future). This includes H-1B, L-1, TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, F-1, J-1, OPT, CPT or any other employment-based visas).

The company offers comprehensive benefits such as Health, Dental, Life, Retirement Plan (401k), Paid Vacation & Holidays, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Disability/Leave, and other Voluntary benefit offerings. Actual benefit offerings confirmed at the time of hire.

PPC Participates in a Fixed and Variable Rate (FAVR) program. With FAVR, you drive your own car and receive tax-free reimbursements that cover both fixed costs (like insurance) and variable costs (like gas), giving you more choice and equity in your vehicle.

title: Assistant Manager - FT-8044
description:
Summary/Objective:

FullSpeed Automotive is one of the largest multi-brand automotive service platforms in the country, operating locations nationwide under brands customers know and trust. Every great customer experience starts at the store level — and the Assistant Manager plays a critical role in making that happen every single day.

The Assistant Manager supports the Store Manager in leading day-to-day operations, ensuring the team delivers fast, friendly, and high-quality automotive service while maintaining a safe, clean, and well-run location. This role is hands-on — splitting time between the service bay, the front counter, and the back office — and is a key developmental step for those looking to grow into store leadership.

We are looking for someone who leads by example, takes pride in a job done right, and genuinely enjoys building a team that customers and coworkers can count on.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Team Leadership & Supervision

  • Support the Store Manager in supervising daily operations, stepping in to lead the location in the manager's absence.

  • Coach, train, and motivate technicians and service advisors to deliver consistent, high-quality service.

  • Assist with scheduling team members to ensure proper coverage during peak hours and busy seasons.

  • Help onboard and train new team members on service procedures, point-of-sale systems, and customer service standards.

  • Foster a positive, team-oriented work environment that reflects FullSpeed Automotive's values.

Customer Experience & Sales

  • Greet customers, explain services, and ensure every visit reflects FullSpeed Automotive's commitment to speed, quality, and trust.

  • Recommend additional services based on manufacturer guidelines and vehicle needs, helping customers make informed decisions.

  • Resolve customer concerns or complaints promptly and professionally, escalating to the Store Manager when needed.

  • Support efforts to build repeat business through excellent service and genuine customer care.

Store & Shop Operations

  • Assist in managing daily store operations, including opening/closing procedures, cash handling, and point-of-sale transactions.

  • Help monitor and maintain inventory levels for parts, fluids, and supplies — placing orders as directed by the Store Manager.

  • Ensure the shop and customer areas are clean, organized, and presentable at all times, reflecting brand standards.

  • Support compliance with all safety protocols, environmental regulations, and company policies.

  • Assist with tracking daily sales, productivity, and key performance metrics, helping the team stay focused on store goals.

Quality & Safety

  • Help ensure all services are performed correctly, safely, and in accordance with brand and manufacturer standards.

  • Conduct or support quality checks on completed work to maintain a high standard of service.

  • Promote a safety-first culture, ensuring team members follow proper procedures for equipment use, chemical handling, and shop safety.

  • Assist in identifying and addressing maintenance needs for shop equipment and facilities.

Disclaimer:

The above job description is meant to describe the general nature and level of work being performed; it is not intended to be construed as a comprehensive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required for the position.

This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by the employee occupying this position. Employees will be required to follow any other job-related instructions and to perform other job-related duties requested by their supervisor in compliance with Federal and State laws.

Requirements are representative of minimum levels of knowledge, skills, and/or abilities. To perform this job successfully, the employee must possess the abilities or aptitudes to perform each duty proficiently. Continued employment remains on an “at-will” basis.

FullSpeed Automotive is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, pregnancy, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, protected veteran status, medical condition or disability, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Sr Analyst, Financial Planning and Analysis
description:
Knoxville, TN
Numbers tell a story. Are you the one who can read it before anyone else does?
We're looking for a sharp, curious Financial Analyst to join our Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A) team — the group senior leaders turn to when they need the truth behind the trends and the confidence to make big decisions. This isn't a spreadsheet-in-a-corner job. Your analysis will land in front of executives, shape strategy, and directly influence where the company invests, grows, and wins.
If you love turning raw data into a clear point of view — and you want a seat at the table where real decisions get made — keep reading.

What You'll Own
Financial Planning and Forecasting

  • Build and refine the financial models that drive budgeting, forecasting, and long-range planning.
  • Dig into historical performance to spot trends, predict what's next, and get ahead of the story.

Budget Management

  • Partner directly with department leaders to shape budgets that actually reflect the business.
  • Track performance against plan, flag the variances that matter, and recommend the moves to fix them.

Performance Analysis

  • Deliver deep-dive analysis — actuals vs. budget vs. forecast — that cuts through the noise.
  • Pinpoint what's driving results and turn those insights into recommendations that boost profitability and sharpen performance.

Strategic Decision Support

  • Arm senior leadership with the insights behind their biggest calls: cost optimization, pricing, and investment opportunities.
  • Model the "what ifs" — scenarios and sensitivity analyses that reveal the upside and the risk before a dollar is spent.

Reporting and Communication

  • Craft clear, compelling reports, dashboards, and executive summaries that make complex numbers easy to act on.
  • Deliver accurate, on-time reporting that leadership can trust and standards demand.

What You Bring
We're seeking candidates with a local presence in Knoxville, TN or the surrounding communities.
This position does not support immigration sponsorship. To be considered, you must have the legal right to work in the United States without additional sponsorship.

  • Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, or a related business field (required)
  • Minimum 5 years of professional experience (preferred)
  • Prior financial analysis experience (preferred)

Specialized Knowledge

  • Advanced Microsoft Office skills
  • A solid grasp of data analytics and reporting
  • Working knowledge of financial, reporting, and database systems — Oracle EPM, Infor FSM, Tableau

What Sets You Apart

  • Real financial acumen — you get the "why" behind the numbers
  • The independence to juggle multiple priorities and projects with minimal oversight
  • Standout strategic, analytical, and problem-solving instincts
  • Sharp organizational skills and a genuine eye for detail
  • A collaborator who can influence, negotiate, and navigate tough conversations
  • Communication skills strong enough to make finance make sense to non-finance teammates


Why You'll Want This Role
You'll do work that's seen — by the people who run the business. You'll grow fast, learn from leaders who value analytical firepower, and build a career where your insight has a direct line to impact.
Ready to make the numbers mean something? Let's talk.

title: Architect Principal - Citywide (5212) - (C00487)
description:
Under general administrative direction, the Principal Engineer/Architect manages, plans, assigns and directs the activities of several units or a group of professional and sub-professional engineering/architectural personnel engaged in a wide variety of design and/or construction projects.

The essential functions of the class may vary depending upon assignment and may include:

  • Planning, directing and coordinating the design activities of a number of major sections engaged in complex engineering and/or architectural projects.
  • Establishing, preparing, managing, reviewing and monitoring organizational budgets.
  • Establishing and evaluating organizational goals and objectives; planning, coordinating and directing the activities of professional engineering and/or architectural personnel with those of contractors, subcontractors, state and local agencies, and inspection and construction personnel.
  • Supervising subordinate personnel, completing performance appraisals, and participating in the disciplinary process when necessary.
  • Establishing design and construction standards; reviewing and approving correspondence, reports, estimates and other materials.
  • Writing policies, procedures, correspondence and evaluations.
  • Conducting important negotiations with representatives of government and architectural and engineering agencies.
  • Coordinating, interpreting, and enforcing policies; conferring and coordinating with operating division managers, other departments, and state and local agencies.
  • Making presentations to boards, organizations, and the public.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

1. Nine (9) years verifiable professional architecture work experience of which six (6) years of that experience must be as a licensed professional architect. Two (2) of the nine (9) years must be equivalent to the City and County of San Francisco class 5211 Senior Architect;

AND

2. Possession of a valid California License as a Registered Architect.

Substitutions for Architecture Specialty:

1. A Master's Degree in Architecture may substitute for 1 (one) year of work experience.
2. A PhD in Architecture may substitute for 2 (two) years of work experience.

This note applies to all candidates who are applying from out of the state of California for all specialties:

1. Candidates licensed in other states who otherwise meet the minimum requirements of this announcement, but do not possess the required California license, may file for this examination, and if successful, will be placed under waiver on the resulting eligible list until the required California license is presented.

License or Certificate:

Some positions may require a valid driver license.

Working Conditions: Some positions may require specific lifting up to 50 pounds; climbing ladders; working in high places and confined spaces; exposure to various weather conditions and outdoors; bending, sitting, and walking for extended periods of time and over uneven surfaces. Positions in this class may also be required to work specific schedules which may include weekends, holidays, part time, nights, and/or overtime.

Verification:

Every application is reviewed to ensure that you meet the minimum qualifications as listed in the job ad. Review SF Careers Employment Applications for considerations taken when reviewing applications.

Applicants may be required to submit verification of qualifying education and experience at any point during the recruitment and selection process. If education verification is required, information on how to verify education requirements, including verifying foreign education credits or degree equivalency, can be found at .

title: Branch Manager I
description:
Position Purpose:

A Branch Manager (BM) operates as a business leader and is responsible for coaching and building your team. In this role, you will inspire, model and motivate service through staff coaching and training to achieve an exceptional customer experience. The BM fosters a motivated, diverse team environment; by setting employees up for success, promoting objectives for the branch and for each employee. The BM also maintains and develops relationships with new and existing customers and creates great partnerships within Civista and the community in which we serve. title: Lease-Up File Coordinator - Phoenix Regional Office.
description:
Dominium is helping tackle the affordable housing crisis – and we’re looking for motivated candidates to join our team and advance our mission. With offices in Atlanta, Dallas, Phoenix and Minneapolis, Dominium is one of the nation’s most respected and innovative affordable housing development and management companies. We create quality, affordable homes and engage with our residents to foster a strong sense of community and connection.

Join us in making a difference in people’s lives every day at a company where you can challenge yourself to develop both personally and professionally.

We are currently seeking a Lease-Up File Coordinator at our Phoenix Regional Office.

Position Summary:

The Lease-Up File Coordinator is responsible for ensuring compliance with all Dominium guidelines and federal, state, and local regulations. This position requires strong attention to detail in processing applications, audit corrections, and recertifications, while adhering to IRS regulations and state agency standards. After substantial leasing is completed, the Lease-Up File Coordinator transitions to the next project to continue providing essential compliance support.

    Responsibilities:

    • Strong understanding and knowledge of federal, state, and local laws and regulations as they relate to compliance including but not limited to:
      • Low Income Housing Tax Credit (LIHTC/Section 42)
      • Section 8
      • Section 236
      • Home
      • Bond
      • Rural Development
      • Public Housing
    • Reviews and pre-approves certification and recertification files within 24-hours of receipt
    • Notifies the Regional Manager of any concerns related to meeting of established deadlines by the site, non-compliance, incomplete report submissions, or unit non-compliance
    • Follows procedures outlined in the Operations Policy and Procedure Manual (OPPM) as it relates to all areas of Compliance
    • Ensures adherence to all Fair Housing laws and regulations
    • Establishes and maintains strong working relationships with site and corporate employees through in-person interactions, phone calls, and email communication
    • Participates in state and syndicator file audits by assisting in site preparation and response
    • Travel as determined by Senior Management based on the needs of each property

    Qualifications:

    • Two years of experience in related field desired.
    • Two years of successful experience in applicable Compliance program. Certified Occupancy Specialist (COS) preferred.
    • Proven ability to review files and documents for accuracy and completeness, while following strict guidelines and procedures.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interact professionally with site staff and corporate teams.
    • Willingness to travel and adjust to new projects or tasks as determined by Senior Management.

We believe housing provides dignity, and our work has a positive, lasting impact on the lives of individuals and families – often for generations. title: Revenue Security Representative
description:
Salary Range: $70,740 - $73,758
Relocation: No

About Us

Oncor Electric Delivery Company LLC, headquartered in Dallas, is a regulated electricity transmission and distribution business that uses superior asset management skills to provide reliable electricity delivery to consumers. Oncor (together with its subsidiaries) operates the largest transmission and distribution system in Texas, delivering power to nearly 4 million homes and businesses and operating more than 145,000 miles of transmission and distribution lines in Texas.

Summary

As a Revenue Security Representative at Oncor, you are responsible for fully researching and investigating locations with suspected electric energy diversion when public safety and/or proper metering of electric services are compromised. The job involves eliminating theft and diversion by cutting and removing electric service at a weatherhead, pole, or handhole. The Revenue Security Representative develops documentation for internal and external legal, corporate security, or law enforcement authorities while maintaining a professional and respectful demeanor in adversarial situations. These orders must be completed safely and within prescribed timeframes, resulting in the proper delivery and measurement of electric energy.

This position requires working various workdays, schedules, and locations. Physical demands include walking, standing, sitting, climbing in and out of a company truck multiple times per day, and carrying a ladder and equipment weighing up to 50 pounds. The official reporting location for this role is the Revenue Security Warehouse in Fort Worth; however, most of your time will be spent in your assigned work zone, which will be in West Dallas and Irving.

Key Roles and Responsibilities

  • Recognizes proper and improper meter base wiring and meter tampering to evaluate the integrity of self-contained and instrument-rated meter installations.
  • Takes appropriate actions (examples include removing the meter, cutting overhead service, or disconnecting underground service) to immediately stop theft and remove public hazards while following the company’s safety rules and regulations.
  • Documents findings using, but not limited to, computer applications (Power Source, Word, Excel, and Outlook), smartphone camera, and proper evidence handling for diversion investigations for all types of retail customer accounts per tariff requirements.
  • Researches, verifies, and records data in Customer Care & Billing (CC&B), Enterprise Asset Management (EAM), and monitoring solution systems to ensure accurate inventory management and retail customer billing.
  • Coordinates with other functional groups—primarily Corporate Security, Field Service Representatives, Revenue Management, the Tampering Review Team, Construction Services, and Executive Referrals—to ensure proper procedures are followed and appropriate actions taken.
  • Performs all essential aspects and functions of the job as well as any other specific job requirements.
  • Must be available to work overtime as necessary, including all days of the week and holidays when needed.
  • Must be available for 24‑hour on-call work when needed.
  • Must be available to work at any location in the regional area when needed.

Skills

  • Effective communication with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Knowledge of computer and company applications.
  • Demonstrates knowledge of metering applications, including proper socket wiring diagrams, voltages, and associated dangers.
  • Ability to recognize substandard metering installations and take appropriate corrective action.

Education and Experience

  • High school diploma, GED, or equivalent is required.
  • Possession of a valid Texas Class C Driver License is required.
  • Two or more years of experience in an investigative, inspection‑oriented, loss‑prevention, or research‑oriented work environment is required. (Open to considering experience outside the electric utility industry as long as it correlates to the skills of this role.)
  • Experience with electric metering field service or another related technical utility discipline is encouraged.

Measures of Success

  • Demonstrates contribution to workgroup and company goals.
  • Demonstrates the ability to perform work with minimal supervision while maintaining a mentoring relationship with assigned personnel.
  • Follows Measurement Services safety procedures to ensure the safety of employees and the public.
  • Interacts with internal and external stakeholders to resolve issues in accordance with company policies and standards.

Benefits

At Oncor, we offer a comprehensive set of benefits, compensation and performance management programs designed specifically to attract, retain, motivate and reward our high-performing workforce. Our supportive and inclusive culture allows every team member the opportunity to thrive and make a difference. We invest in our employee’s success and well-being by offering such things as:

  • Annual incentive program.
  • Competitive health and welfare benefits (medical, dental, vision, life insurance).
  • Ability to earn wellness incentives (up to $2,300 in 2026 as an Employee only) and other wellbeing resources.
  • 401k with dollar-for-dollar company match up to 6%.
  • 401k match for student debt program.
  • Cash balance pension plan.
  • Adoption Assistance.
  • Mental health resources.
  • Employee resource groups.
  • Tuition reimbursement.
  • Competitive vacation, 10 company holidays and 2 personal holidays.
  • Paid parental leave.
  • Salary continuation for up to 6 months for approved employee illness or injury.
  • Other perks such as commuter benefits, electric vehicle incentive program, appliance purchase plan.

Participation in benefit programs for employees in collective bargaining units is subject to the applicable collective bargaining agreement.

title: ISSO (Mid-Level)
description:
Halvik Corp delivers a wide range of services to 13 executive agencies and 15 independent agencies. Halvik is a highly successful WOB business with more than 50 prime contracts and 500+ professionals delivering Digital Services, Advanced Analytics, Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning, Cyber Security and Cutting-Edge Technology across the US Government. Be a part of something special!

Position Overview

Halvik is seeking a candidate to support a Federal customer in implementing and maintaining security measures to protect the customer's systems, data, and networks from cyber threats. The position includes performing Information Assurance (IA) engineering activities that support cybersecurity posture and ensure compliance with applicable Federal requirements, and performing assessments and monitoring activities, and maintaining compliance with Federal security requirements.

Core Responsibilities

  • Performing regular security assessments of networks, systems, applications, and cloud environments
  • Developing or supporting the development of incident response plans and conducting security training sessions.
  • Monitoring compliance with applicable security standards, regulations, and NTIA security policies.
  • Supporting continuous monitoring activities, including vulnerability scanning, log analysis, and remediation tracking.
  • Preparing security assessment documentation such as SAPs, SARs, and POA&Ms in accordance with NIST RMF.
  • Validating remediation effectiveness through retesting, evidence review, and compliance verification.

Minimum Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Information Technology or Business -OR- Associate's Degree and one (1) year relevant experience with professional certification -OR- two (2) years relevant experience with professional certification
  • Experience: Two+ years of information technology experience; minimum two years of ISSO experience preferred
  • Technical Proficiency: Proficient in planning for and performing audits to ensure compliance with agency and federal security requirements. Knowledge of and/or capability to review and develop system security plans and other required security documentation; perform vulnerability assessment scans or interpret results of scans and track mitigation actions and progress of system engineers and administrators; and perform certification and accreditation activities as required to ensure assigned systems remain accredited and risk is managed to an acceptable level.
  • Compliance: Ensure compliance with Federal cybersecurity regulations, including NIST, FISMA, and associated guidance. Ensure artifacts, assessments, and system configurations remain aligned with NIST SP 800-53 controls, FedRAMP baselines, Federal agency policy and directives.
  • Certifications:
    • Per education requirements above.
  • Must possess an active Secret clearance.

Preferred Expertise

  • CISSP or equivalent Cybersecurity certification (e.g., Security+) preferred.
  • Demonstrated success supporting Federal contracts.
  • Strong background coordinating with stakeholders (e.g., system owners, ISSOs, architecture teams, and cybersecurity leadership) to validate cybersecurity requirements, address information assurance concerns, and resolve compliance or security issues.
  • Strong analytical, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical risks and content into terms suitable for executive and government stakeholders.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with others and contribute to a team environment.

Privacy Policy – Halvik Corp

Company-supported medical, dental, vision, life, STD, and LTD insurance
Benefits include 11 federal holidays and PTO
Eligible employees may receive performance-based incentives in recognition of individual and/or team achievements.
401(k) with company matching
