title: Business Systems & Data Analyst
description:
This is not a remote position.

Superior Beverage Group | Business Services

Position Overview

Superior Beverage Group is seeking a highly motivated, analytical, and solutions-oriented Business Systems & Data Analyst to join our Business Services team.

This position plays a key role in supporting business sales and operations through data analysis, process improvement, reporting, automation, and technology-driven solutions.

The ideal candidate is more than technically proficient. We are looking for a curious, resourceful problem-solver who enjoys working with people, understanding business challenges, and developing solutions that improve efficiency, accuracy, and decision-making across the organization.

This role requires an individual who can independently manage projects, navigate complex business processes, and effectively collaborate with departments throughout the company.

Key Responsibilities

Business Intelligence & Data Management

  • Develop, maintain, and enhance business reports, dashboards, and analytical tools.

  • Create complex Excel workbooks and reporting solutions to support operational and strategic decision-making.

  • Write and maintain SQL queries to extract, transform, analyze, and validate business data.

  • Develop and maintain ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes and data pipelines across multiple systems.

  • Analyze, cleanse, reconcile, and validate large datasets to ensure accuracy and consistency.

  • Identify trends, discrepancies, and opportunities for process improvement.

  • Translate business requirements into meaningful reporting and analytics solutions.

Business Process Improvement & Automation

  • Design, develop, and maintain automated workflows and business processes using tools such as Microsoft Power Automate and Power Apps.

  • Evaluate existing processes and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.

  • Develop solutions supporting both internal operations and external business partners.

  • Troubleshoot complex process and system issues, identifying root causes and implementing sustainable solutions.

  • Document business processes, workflows, technical solutions, and operating procedures.

  • Leverage emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence, to enhance productivity while maintaining appropriate human oversight and validation.

­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­JOB DESCRIPTION

_____________________________________________________________________________

Summary/Objective

The Skills Trainer will provide support, skill training, and one-on-one supervision to clients as outlined in the treatment plan. The Skills Trainer will also maintain case records and documentation per Volunteers of America Northern Rockies' policies and procedures and coordinate facility operations and client needs with other staff.

Essential Functions

  • Provide support, supervision, activities, and skills training individually and/or in group settings outlined in the treatment plan. This may include coping skills, self-care, social interaction skills, illness management, crisis management, daily living activities, community awareness, incoming/outgoing residence transitional support, etc.

  • Conducts in-home skills training visits to assist clients with developing independent living skills.
  • Assist in preparing materials for the day treatment process, e.g., preparing copies/packets, preparing the group room, and cleaning and organizing the workspace.

    • Non-medical monitoring as prescribed in policies and procedures
  • Provides medication monitoring of clients following medical policies and procedures.
  • Provides basic risk assessment and immediate referral to program coordinator, primary clinician, or on-call staff for expanded risk assessment and intervention.
  • Provide for clients' life and medical safety, behavioral control, and crisis prevention activities within the scope of practice, and contact supervisors, primary clinicians, and appropriate emergency services as needed.
  • Is responsible for contacting clinical staff as needed to intervene in situations requiring professional support, increased intervention, alternative placement, or level of care.
  • Coordinate daily facility operations, including required monitoring, walkthroughs, and room searches of facility and clients according to program needs.

  • Maintains productivity/billable hour expectations as determined by leadership.

Competencies

  • Continuous demonstration of behaviors aligned with a posture of servant leadership and our

cultural values.

This position has no direct supervisory responsibilities.

Work Environment

This job operates in a residential facility environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as laptops, photocopiers, and smartphones.

Physical Demands

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and the ability to adjust focus. title: Featurejournalist til Illustreret Videnskab
description:
Kan du se den skarpe vinkel i en mission til et sort hul? Og drømmer du om at dykke ned i den nyeste klimateknologi, den næste kur mod kræft eller Jordens gloende indre?

Så har vi måske jobbet til dig.

Sideløbende med den traditionelle magasinproduktion står Illustreret Videnskab midt i en spændende digital udvikling og søger en fagligt stærk og velskrivende featurejournalist.

Dine opgaver

Som en del af Illustreret Videnskabs featureredaktion skal du kunne se den gode historie i strømmen af videnskabsnyheder og derefter vinkle og skrive (eller redigere) den lange feature, så den er relevant for læserne – både digitalt og på print i vores fem udgivelseslande. Derudover skal du også have en stærk visuel forståelse, så du kan se de gode billeder og illustrationer for dig – længe inden artiklen overhovedet er skrevet.

Vi forventer

Hvis du søger stillingen, forventer vi, at du:

  • Har erfaring med at skrive længere featureformater.
  • Er sprogligt stærk og skriver fejlfrit dansk.
  • Kan skrive engagerende deletekster og få folk til at klikke på en paywall.
  • Har lyst til at arbejde målrettet og datadrevet med brugerbehov.
  • Kan omsætte kompliceret stof til letforståelige artikler.

Erfaring med formidling af videnskab er selvsagt et plus, men ikke et krav. Vi forventer dog, at du er både nysgerrig og interesseret i Illustreret Videnskabs stofområder.

Hvem er vi?

Bonnier Publications står bag nogle af Nordens mest elskede interessemedier, som engagerer millioner af læsere, lyttere og seere på tværs af platforme. Blandt vores brands finder du udover Illustreret Videnskab, også Historie, Bo Bedre, I Form, Gør Det Selv og mange flere.

Illustreret Videnskab udkommer som magasin 20 gange årligt og leverer desuden dagligt nyheder fra videnskabens verden på vores hjemmesider.

Du bliver en del af en dynamisk og travl redaktion, hvor vi interesserer os for hinanden. Stemningen er afslappet og uformel, men vi er samtidig ambitiøse og går højt op i, at vores indhold er af god kvalitet.

Vi tilbyder

Kolleger, der i ord, grafik og tegninger kan formidle videnskab, så man bliver suget ind i fortællingerne og holdt fast til sidste ord.

Løn og pension efter overenskomst med Dansk Journalistforbund, som også indebærer 6 ugers ferie, fri mellem jul og nytår og en arbejdstid på 35 timer/uge ekskl. frokost.

Du får din dagligdag på Strandboulevarden 130 – tæt på metro, S-tog og bus. Vi nyder hver dag godt af lækker mad fra kantinen, der har fokus på sundhed og økologi. Hvis du har tid og lyst, kan du benytte vores massageordning, træningscenter og deltage i de sociale arrangementer, som laves i samarbejde med medarbejderforeningen. Bonnier Publications er en fleksibel arbejdsplads. Når du er kommet godt ombord – både på redaktionen og i dine opgaver – er der mulighed for hjemmearbejdsdage.

Jobstart er 1. januar 2027 - eller hurtigst muligt derefter.

Ansøgning

Send dit CV sammen med en kort ansøgning – hvor du beskriver, hvordan du vil gribe opgaven an – og eksempler på dine tidligere artikler via linket “ansøg her”.

Som en del af ansættelsesforløbet kan du blive bedt om at løse en opgave.

Ansøgningsfrist er 7.12.2026.

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du kontakte chefredaktør Karen Grubbe på karen.grubbe@illvid.dk eller featureredaktør Morten Kjerside Poulsen på morten.poulsen@illvid.dk.

Om os

Hos Bonnier Publications er vi stolte over at være et af Nordens største og mest inspirerende mediehuse.

Vi står bag populære og elskede brands, som fx Illustreret Videnskab, Costume, Gør Det Selv, Woman.dk, Bo Bedre og iForm. Hos Bonnier Publications skaber vi indhold, der engagerer, uanset om det handler om videnskab, livsstil, byggeprojekter, forbrugerteknologi eller helt andre emner. Vores artikler, interviews, videoer og guides gør en forskel i menneskers hverdag og hjælper dem med at få endnu mere glæde af deres interesser.

Vores indhold lever overalt

Vi når ud til vores publikum via mange platforme. Vores indhold findes i apps, på websites, i nyhedsbreve, på sociale medier, i podcasts og selvfølgelig de klassiske magasiner, som udgives i Danmark, Norge, Sverige, Finland, Tyskland og Holland. Nogle enkelte af dem kommer endda endnu længere omkring. Vi tror på at møde læserne og brugerne, hvor de er – og vi udfordrer os selv og branchen med de nyeste tendenser og tech-løsninger.

Samarbejde – også på tværs af landegrænser
Bonnier Publications’ hovedkontor på Østerbro i København rummer 310 kollegaer fordelt på fem etager og spænder over kreative og tekniske roller, projektledelse, content creation og meget, meget mere. Vi er et sted med plads til både personlig udvikling og tæt samarbejde på tværs af afdelinger, og vi lærer hele tiden af hinanden, når vi skaber fremtidens medier. Uanset om du arbejder med backend-udvikling, rekruttering, design, AI, markedsføring, it-support, logistik eller drømmer om at få en byline i et af vores brands, har du en vigtig plads i vores team.

Bonnier Publications er en del af Bonnier News-familien, som med over 8.000 medarbejdere i ryggen og en stærk vision om at styrke det frie ord, leverer kvalitetsindhold til mere end seks millioner læsere, lyttere og seere hver eneste dag. Det er en kæmpe styrke i vores digitale transformation, at vi er tæt integrerede i Nordens største mediekoncern og har direkte adgang til at dele viden og eksperimenter på tværs af flere forskellige lande.

title: Group Account Supervisor - Pacific Communications Advertising
description:
Pacific Communications, a division of Abbvie, is full-service healthcare communications agency that brings strategy, creativity, and energy to every challenge. We partner with clients to launch and grow brands through innovative technology, marketing, and integrated communications solutions in both Therapeutic and Aesthetic business units. Our goal is to create Brave, Authentic, and Inspiring creative work that connects with audiences, moves brands forward, and makes a meaningful impact. Join a diverse and collaborative team that is passionate about doing great work—and having fun along the way.

As an Account Group Supervisor at Pacific Communications for Allergan, you’ll provide strategic leadership across multiple brands, channels, or major client initiatives. You’ll guide integrated communications strategies, oversee launches and complex programs, build senior-level client partnerships, manage account-level financial performance, and align teams across the agency. You’ll also help develop senior account professionals and strengthen the agency’s broader relationship with clients.

This role is ideal for an experienced account leader who thrives on seeing the big picture while bringing people and ideas together. At Pacific, you’ll help shape high-impact work, lead meaningful client partnerships, and support a culture driven by passion and a commitment to creating Brave, Authentic, and Inspiring creative solutions.

Core Responsibilities

Lead integrated account and brand strategy

  • Develop a deep understanding of assigned brands, disease states, products, audiences, competitors, and market dynamics.
  • Translate client objectives and market opportunities into integrated communications strategies, brand plans, critical issues, key strategic initiatives, creative platforms, and tactical recommendations across channels and brands.

Serve as the senior strategic client partner

  • Act as the primary agency contact for strategic questions, account priorities, and business guidance.
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with key client stakeholders, including executive-level contacts when applicable.
  • Provide proactive partnership, anticipate client needs, and ensure agency recommendations and deliverables are aligned with client objectives and strategies.

Oversee major programs, launches, and communications initiatives

  • Lead new product and indication launches (when appliable), annual marketing plans, competitive initiatives, and major client programs.
  • Guide the development of meeting plans, agendas, content, workshops, mainstage presentations, field advisory boards, and other strategic communications activities.

Direct cross-functional agency collaboration and execution

  • Provide strategic direction to Account Services, Creative, Production, Media, Public Relations, , vendors, and other agency partners.
  • Lead strategic input and review meetings, align resources across workstreams, and ensure projects are executed on strategy, on time, within budget, and meet quality and review requirements.

Oversee account budgets and financial performance

  • Review and oversee annual budgets, estimates, expenditures, forecasts, and financial reporting across assigned brands
  • Provide accurate financial information to clients and agency leadership, establish appropriate budget guidelines, identify risks, and recommend adjustments based on business, market, or competitive conditions.

Lead and develop the account team

  • Set expectations, delegate responsibilities, and promote accountability across the account team. Manage Senior Account Executives, Account Executives, Account Supervisors, and other team members, helping them strengthen their strategic contribution, brand leadership, client-management skills, and readiness for increased responsibility.
  • Foster collaboration, continuous improvement, and high-quality client service.

Education and experience: Bachelor’s degree in advertising, marketing, communications, business, healthcare communications, or a related field, with 8 or more years of relevant agency, healthcare, pharmaceutical, or client-side experience. Equivalent experience may be considered.

Strategic and brand leadership: Demonstrated ability to develop integrated communications strategies, brand plans, creative platforms, tactical recommendations, and launch plans across multiple brands or channels.

Client relationship management: Proven success building trusted relationships with senior/executive-level clients, providing strategic counsel, managing expectations, and strengthening partnerships.

title: Head of Commercial Products
company: Impact Fund Denmark (tidl. Investeringsfonden for Udviklingslande)
description:
As Head of Commercial Products at Impact Fund Denmark, you will turn investment ideas and investor requirements into commercially viable funds and other investment products. You will build the financial models and fund structures that enable Impact Fund Denmark to attract additional private capital for investments in developing and emerging markets.

You will take responsibility for financial structuring and product development, combining hands-on modelling with a visible role in investor discussions. Working closely with the Head of Investor Relations, you will explain product economics, support fundraising and contribute technical expertise to the ongoing investor dialogue for existing funds.

The role is part of Legal, Compliance and Commercial (LCC), led by Frederik Bjørn, General Counsel & Chief Commercial Officer. LCC brings together Legal Corporate, Legal Transactions, Compliance (Non-Financial Risk), and Sales and Investor Relations and consists of around 15 colleagues across Copenhagen and IFDK’s international locations.

You will work in a highly collaborative environment, with close interaction across Investor Relations, Legal, Risk and the wider investment organisation. The team values openness, constructive challenge and strong professional collaboration. You will have considerable ownership of your area while drawing on specialist expertise from colleagues across LCC, Investment, Finance, Risk, Valuation and Strategy & Business Development.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Design and structure investment products, including tranches with different risk and return profiles, risk-sharing arrangements and guarantees.

  • Build and challenge financial models using cash-flow analysis, scenarios and simulations, including Monte Carlo methods, to assess outcomes for investors and IFDK.

  • Assess how funds and products work together, including risk allocation and the implications of different investment and guarantee structures.

  • Develop fee and pricing models that reflect the economics of each product and the resources required to manage it.

  • Develop investor and sales materials and present products alongside the Head of Investor Relations, explaining structures, risks and returns and answering product-specific questions in investor due diligence.

  • Contribute financial analysis to information memoranda and ongoing investor reporting, and participate in Limited Partner Advisory Committee (LPAC) meetings and other investor fora for existing funds.

  • Work with Investment, Finance, Legal, Risk and Valuation colleagues to translate investor and guarantee requirements into clear responsibilities and processes throughout fund and product lifecycles.

YOUR FIRST YEAR

  • A consistent approach to financial modelling and clear investor materials supports product design, fundraising and ongoing investor dialogue.

  • Structuring and pricing options for priority products have been assessed, with clear recommendations on risk allocation and economics.

  • Responsibilities and handovers for key investor and guarantee requirements are agreed with the relevant teams.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

You bring substantial experience in financial structuring and investment products, with the commercial judgement and credibility to take ownership and engage directly with institutional and other private investors. You have:

  • A relevant master’s degree in finance, economics or a related discipline with a strong quantitative foundation.

  • Experience personally building financial models and developing or structuring investment products.

  • A strong understanding of risk, return, cash flows and how financial structures allocate outcomes between different investors.

  • Experience working with institutional investors, supporting institutional clients or working on the investment side of a pension company.

  • Experience presenting complex financial topics to investors or institutional clients, with the ability to turn analysis into clear recommendations and respond confidently to technical questions.

  • Strong written and spoken Danish and English.

You combine technical depth with commercial judgement, take ownership of detailed work and collaborate effectively across specialist functions. Experience with illiquid assets or private-market fund structures would be an advantage.

WHERE THE ROLE SITS

Based in Copenhagen, you will report directly to Frederik Bjørn, General Counsel & Chief Commercial Officer, and work closely with the Head of Investor Relations. You will have analytical support from Strategy & Business Development for product development and investor-related work.

WHY JOIN US

You will shape how IFDK combines institutional investor requirements, financial returns and impact. The role offers ownership of product development, direct exposure to investors and broad collaboration across IFDK, with the opportunity to see your work through from financial design to fundraising and ongoing investor reporting.

PRACTICAL DETAILS

Location: Copenhagen | Position: Full-time | Start date: By agreement

Please apply through IFDK’s recruitment platform with your CV and a short application explaining your interest in the role and relevant experience.

title: Head of Employee Experience
description:
In this Head of Employee Experience role, you'll be…

  • Setting the vision and one roadmap for our Employee Experience across the employee journey, so colleagues experience one Formalize in every office and every new country.

  • Building a scalable, intuitive model where people, systems, processes, IT and offices simply work, so day-to-day operations run smoothly on their own, freeing up your team to give personal, high-touch support when it matters most

  • Setting up one front door for every question on people, workplace and IT, with one ticketing system and a shared knowledge base, solving most questions through self-serve and the rest first time.

  • Leading a team of around ten across People Operations, Workplace and Internal IT with clear ownership, and making your team's time here a real springboard for their HR careers.

  • Owning workplace standards, vendors and budgets, and opening new offices on time and on budget from one playbook.

  • Working with our People Business Partners and Talent Acquisition on journeys that cross teams, such as onboarding and country launches.

Who is the Employee Experience team?

Employee Experience is the team that treats our colleagues like our best customers. We bring People Operations, Workplace, and Internal IT together under one roof because a great workday relies on all three: a contract and conversations that make sense, an office where we celebrate wins together, and a laptop that works from hour one.

Within People Operations, a back office sets standards, systems and automation, while People Operations Partners in the front office are the daily face for colleagues. Our People Business Partners, focused on managers and leaders, work closely with us.

Our principle is high touch where it matters, effortless everywhere else, with one front door for every question and the ambition that colleagues hardly need us.

What you bring

  • Proven leadership experience across the broader employee experience spectrum, combining People Operations with workplace and internal IT, ideally in a scaling international tech company.

  • A builder's instinct. Your energy comes from systems, standards and support models that work every day. Events and celebrations matter but aren't the core, so if confetti is what drives you, this probably isn't your role.

  • You think in models, linking the structural basis to the human interaction it enables, and you know where high personal-touch adds value and where good design does the job better.

  • Strong on digital: people systems, automation and AI are how the team scales, and you're comfortable owning tooling decisions and the budget behind them.

  • A strong sense of fairness and consistency, with standards explicit enough to guide people rather than slow them down.

  • A hands-on leader who builds teams across disciplines and grows people into bigger roles.

  • Clear communication in English, the credibility to partner effectively with our leadership team, and the ability to work from our Copenhagen office (or Aarhus).

What do we offer you?

  • A monthly salary ranging from 65,000 to 70,000 DKK.

  • Continuous development through a clear and transparent career framework, so you always know what the next step looks like, with biannual growth talks and regular check-ins.

  • Thorough pre- and onboarding to set you up for success.

  • A culture of ownership, trust and independence, with the support you need.

  • An office-first culture in a central location in Copenhagen or Aarhus, with benefits including pension, lunch, health insurance and social events.

  • A strong team spirit where we celebrate wins and enjoy time together across offices.

  • Our annual Global Summit, where the whole company meets and connects.

Our recruitment process

  • Send your application and upload relevant information

  • 15–30-minute online interview with our Talent Acquisition team

  • 30-minute interview with our Hiring Manager

  • 30-minute interview with our interim Head of Talent Acquisition

  • Completion of Personality Assessment

  • In-person team workshop in Aarhus with representatives of People Operations, Workplace and Internal IT, where you work on a real case such as our future onboarding

About Formalize

Formalize is a tech company founded in 2021 with offices in Aarhus, Copenhagen, Milan, Munich and Madrid. Currently, we are a team of +200 people from +30 nationalities operating in multiple European markets and are one of the fastest growing SaaS scale-ups. We thrive on ambition, deliver impact through pragmatism, and embrace passion and honesty. We are celebrating our wins, learning from our mistakes, and growing together as a team.

Our journey began within the whistleblowing compliance sector, highlighted by the award-winning Whistleblower Software by Formalize, laying the foundation of our success story. Now, we have extended our expertise to a larger compliance universe, including data compliance, risk, and privacy. Our Formalize product helps companies to effortlessly navigate and stay ahead in the ever-changing landscape of compliance. Our platform adapts to regulatory changes, continuously adapting to meet and foresee the evolving needs of our users, ensuring businesses remain compliant and confident in their operations.

Still curious? Read more about us here: About Formalize.

Ready to apply?

We will hold interviews and hire on an ongoing basis. For more information or questions, please contact the responsible recruiter in the Talent Acquisition team. Apply now with your resume and other relevant information through our Career Page. We look forward to seeing your application!

title: Technical Designer, Sid Mashburn
description:
WHAT IS THE BRAND?

Mashburn is an Atlanta-based apparel and lifestyle brand founded in 2007. The company designs, manufactures, and markets a nationally recognized assortment of menswear (Sid Mashburn) and womenswear (Ann Mashburn), and other high-quality, iconic brands. Mashburn aims to be the best in American style and service... a brand that offers luxury-quality product at accessible prices, delivered with a memorable customer experience, and driven by a deeply personal brand voice that expresses the passion and inspiration of our founders.

WHAT IS THE JOB?

As the Men's Technical Designer, you will oversee the technical development and fit process of the Sid Mashburn line from initial development through production, owning categories, and driving fit decisions.

WHAT ARE THE RESPONSIBILITIES?

  • Be the main touch point for SM Technical Design and Fit.
  • Conduct SM fittings, contributing your experience and knowledge to fit decisions.
  • Identify and resolve fit, pattern and construction issues.
  • Review and approve fit samples and TOPs, clearly communicating fit comments and corrections to overseas vendors.
  • Create and maintain SM tech packs based on Design's vision for style and fit.
  • Partner with overseas vendors to resolve any production issues, and to ensure fit and construction standards are
  • Work cross-functionally with the Design, Production, Raw Materials, and Quality Control teams, and adhere to a Product Development calendar.
  • Work with the Director of Technical Design and Master Tailor on SM fit projects and grade standardization.
  • Measure and inspect fit samples in preparation for fittings.
  • Work in Gerber pattern software to make minor pattern adjustments.
  • Communicate with models about fitting schedules.

WHAT ARE THE ESSENTIAL SKILLS?

  • Degree in Fashion Design/Technical Design, and 5+ years of Technical Design experience (at least 2 years in men's).
  • Strong knowledge of menswear garment construction, fabric, and tech pack creation, across different apparel
  • Extensive experience with fittings, measuring samples, creating fit comments, and communicating with overseas
  • Strong knowledge of garment measurements and grading.
  • Strong understanding of the Product Development process from initial TP development through production.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, follow-through, and organizational skills are critical.

  • Proactive self-starter mindset, with strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.

title: Customer Advisor - 15 Hours
description:
Your role in the JoJo story…

Do you dream of a role where you can make meaningful contributions that finish in days well spent? If you're ready to begin a fabulous adventure and you're passionate about retail, we have the perfect role for you!

Each JoJo store is unique whether that’s trading over two floors, having a quirky layout or being situated in an interesting place. They have a life of their own. Our Unique Selling Point (USP) in this ever-changing retail world is the relationship we build with our customers, many of them loyal to our brand and to their local store team. This is where you come in - you’ll be the face of JoJo providing a fantastic level of customer care and service that we are renowned for and one we pride ourselves in upholding always. You’ll be guiding, informing, and assisting our customers in the correct purchase of our huge range of clothing and products. This could be an expectant parent, an excited grandparent or other friends or family.

Our B Corp principles are so important, and every member of our teams will always uphold them. As we move into a digital retail world, offering an Omni-Channel customer service is expected as this builds on customer loyalty. As such most of our stores offer Ship from Store or Click and Collect options, you will take ownership of preparing and shipping all such orders daily.

A peek into your daily adventures:

  • Assisting our customers in many different and sometimes diverse situations, from bra measuring or discussing our maternity wear, to demonstrating a baby carrier to an intrigued parent.

  • Preparing Omni-Channel orders.

  • Liaising with customers in store or via the phone on Omni-Channel orders.

  • Using our digital or virtual learning platforms to continuously develop your knowledge and retail skills.

  • Embracing new product knowledge or learning to increase sales opportunities.

  • Actively listening to our customers’ needs and working out what the best solution is for them.

  • Taking pride in keeping your store looking immaculate.

A typical week would be 3 x 5 hour shifts however, flexibility is required in line with store requirements.

Skills that make you shine:

  • Previous retail, customer service and sales experience

  • Competent IT skills and excellent systems ability, with an aptitude to pick up new systems quickly.

  • The ability to learn and retain a high level of product information and be able to communicate this effectively to our customers.

  • You’ll need a self-developing mentality and a curiosity to learn new products independently.

  • We don’t like hard sales techniques, but you’ll need to demonstrate a level of sales ability, which includes active listening skills, empathy, and an understanding of our customers’ needs.

  • You’ll be working within a small team; therefore, the ability to work harmoniously and respectfully is important.

  • Working in a retail environment requires a level of flexibility, most of our stores are open 7 days a week.

  • We like to keep our stores looking tip-top, so you’ll have a keen eye for detail and play a key role in maintaining our standard.

Please note: We will only recruit individuals who are 18 or over.

Just to give you a taste of our culture, we’ll be looking for you to:

  • Be a brand ambassador, safeguarding our values and ethos.

  • Demonstrate honesty and respect in every interaction.

  • Foster collaboration and open, active listening

  • Take ownership of all aspects of the role.

Perks and Benefits:

  • Extra day of annual leave for each year you’re with us, up to 38 days.

  • Is it your birthday? Take it off and celebrate!

  • Let’s celebrate JoJo doing well – non-contractual bonus scheme.

  • Helping plan for the future - enhanced pension scheme.

  • Get on the move - cycle to work scheme.

  • Financial wellbeing app - pay yourself 40% of your earned wages whenever you want.

  • Saving scheme with Smart Money Cymru – You do not need to live in Wales!

  • Flexible work options.

  • Enjoy fabulous social events.

  • Give back with volunteer days to support our communities.

  • Prioritise your well-being with our Health and Wellbeing hub.

  • Specsavers voucher – Get a free sight test and contribution towards glasses (T & C’s) apply.

  • We love our products! Enjoy:

    • 40% off JoJo branded lines

    • 25% off full-price NEXT products

    • 10% off NEXT Beauty products

    • Up to 10% off most branded products

  • Embrace an “It’s up to you” learning environment with ongoing training and development opportunities.

Want to know more about JoJo?

We make happy and helpful clothes and products that let children be children – in all their silly, messy, adventurous, noisy, imaginative joy. But we’re not just about selling products; we’re about creating a warm, community-centric environment for our employees and our customers. From 39 locations across the UK and Ireland and a thriving e-commerce platform, we offer a meticulously designed collection of children’s clothing, toys, and essentials designed with love and care: always with children at the forefront of our minds.

As a B Corp, our commitment goes beyond commerce, we strive for a sustainable future and take pride in our responsibilities to the planet and our communities. At JoJo, every role, every task and every day is an opportunity to support, inspire and contribute to the well-being of our teams and our customers.

We embrace and openly welcome people from different cultures, perspectives, and experiences to create a diverse and enriched environment. We work hard to recruit, develop, and retain the most talented people, regardless of background to make sure we grow our company sustainably and with different cultural influences. By encouraging a diverse and inclusive workforce, we aim to create an environment where everyone can thrive and reach their full potential.

title: Extraction Assistant
description:

The Extraction Assistant supports day-to-day operations within the Extraction Department, ensuring efficient, accurate, and compliant production workflows. We are seeking candidates for both first shift and second shift.

Second Shift Hours: Monday-Friday 1pm-9:30pm (1 role to fill)

title: Projekti-insinööri PJP- ja datakeskushankkeisiin
description:
Haluatko työskennellä suurissa ja teknisesti vaativissa PJP-hankkeissa, joissa työsi näkyy konkreettisesti projektinjohdon laatuna, hankinnoissa, aikatauluissa, työmaalla ja koko hankkeen etenemisessä? Haluatko siinä rinnalla kehittää jatkuvasti PJP-hankemallin toimintatapoja, dokumentaatiota ja käytäntöjä?

Etsimme Weladolle projekti-insinööriä projektinjohtopalveluiden eli PJP-hankkeisiin. Toimit osana asiakkaan projektiorganisaatiota ja vastaat omista projektikokonaisuuksistasi. Työssä yhdistyvät käytännön projektinjohto, hankinnat, työmaan ohjaus sekä projektin tiedon- ja laadunhallinta.

Jos haluat ottaa vastuuta, ratkaista projektin arjen haasteita ja kasvaa yhä vaativampien hankekokonaisuuksien johtajaksi, tämä tehtävä voi olla sinulle.

Projekti-insinöörinä Weladolla

Projekti-insinöörinä varmistat, että projekti etenee suunnitellusti ja päätöksenteon tueksi on oikea tieto oikeaan aikaan. Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä asiakkaan, projektipäällikön, suunnittelijoiden, urakoitsijoiden ja toimittajien kanssa.

Tehtäväsi ja vastuusi tarkentuvat kokemuksesi sekä hankkeen tarpeiden perusteella.

Tehtävässä pääset esimerkiksi

  • johtamaan itsenäisesti omia tehtävä- ja projektikokonaisuuksiasi

  • osallistumaan projektin suunnitteluun, toteutukseen, seurantaan ja ohjaukseen

  • valmistelemaan ja toteuttamaan hankintoja, kilpailutuksia ja sopimusprosesseja

  • ohjaamaan suunnittelijoiden, urakoitsijoiden ja toimittajien toimintaa

  • seuraamaan projektin aikataulua, kustannuksia, riskejä ja muutoksia

  • tuottamaan päätöksenteon tueksi tilannekuvaa ja raportointia

  • vastaamaan kokemuksesi mukaisesti työmaavalvonnan ja työmaan johtamisen tehtävistä

  • valvomaan työn laatua, sopimuksenmukaisuutta ja vaatimusten toteutumista

  • kehittämään projektin dokumentaatio-, tiedonhallinta- ja laadunhallintakäytäntöjä

  • varmistamaan tiedonkulun sekä päätösten ja sovittujen toimenpiteiden etenemisen.

Menestyt tehtävässä, jos:

✔️ sinulla on soveltuva korkeakoulututkinto, esimerkiksi insinöörin tai diplomi-insinöörin tutkinto

✔️ sinulla on kokemusta PJP-hankkeista, rakennuttamisesta tai vaativista investointihankkeista

✔️ sinulla on kokemusta hankinnoista, kilpailutuksista, sopimusasioista tai toimittajien ohjauksesta

✔️ tunnet työmaavalvonnan, työmaan johtamisen tai muun työmaalla tapahtuvan projektinjohdon tehtävät

✔️ olet kehittänyt projektien dokumentaatiohallintaa, tiedonhallintaa, laatua tai toimintatapoja

✔️ pystyt johtamaan omia kokonaisuuksiasi ja viemään sovitut asiat määrätietoisesti loppuun

✔️ hahmotat eri toimijoiden, tehtävien ja aikataulujen väliset riippuvuudet

✔️ työskentelet luontevasti asiakkaiden, suunnittelijoiden, urakoitsijoiden ja toimittajien kanssa

✔️ kommunikoit sujuvasti suomeksi ja englanniksi sekä kirjallisesti että suullisesti. Englantia käytetään tehtävässä päivittäin esimerkiksi kokouksissa, dokumentaatiossa, raportoinnissa ja kansainvälisessä sidosryhmäyhteistyössä

Arvostamme erityisesti kokemusta datakeskushankkeista.

Millaista tekijää etsimme? 👀

Etsimme käytännönläheistä ja järjestelmällistä projektinjohdon ammattilaista, joka tarttuu asioihin ja ottaa vastuun niiden etenemisestä.

Sinun ei tarvitse olla valmis projektipäällikkö, mutta odotamme, että pystyt toimimaan itsenäisesti osana laajempaa projektiorganisaatiota. Osaat muodostaa tilannekuvan, tunnistaa tarvittavat toimenpiteet ja nostaa poikkeamat sekä ratkaisuehdotukset avoimesti esille.

Onnistumistasi tukevat tavoitteellinen työote, hyvä kokonaisuuksien hallinta, toimeenpanokyky ja rakentava tapa toimia erilaisten ihmisten kanssa.

Miksi Weladolle töi­hin?💜

Weladolla pääset tekemään merkityksellistä työtä vaativissa hankkeissa ja kasvamaan projektinjohdon ammattilaisena. Saat vastuuta, mutta et jää sen kanssa yksin.

Meillä saat:

  • mahdollisuuden työskennellä suurissa investointihankkeissa

  • vastuullisia tehtäväkokonaisuuksia kokemuksesi ja vahvuuksiesi mukaan

  • kokeneiden projektinjohdon, rakennuttamisen, hankintojen ja valvonnan ammattilaisten tuen

  • mahdollisuuden kehittää projektien johtamista, tiedonhallintaa ja laatua

  • vapauden vaikuttaa oman työn tekemiseen, joustavat työnteon mallit (projektien tarpeet huomioiden)

  • matalan organisaatio

  • työyhteisön, jossa luotamme ihmisiin ja autamme toisiamme onnistumaan, ja välitämme toinen toistemme hyvinvoinnista

  • mahdollisuuden kasvaa yhä vaativampiin projektinjohdon tehtäviin.

Lue lisää Weladosta työpaikkana, ja esimerkiksi henkilöstöeduistamme täältä.

Työskentely ja sijainti 📍

Työhönottopisteesi voi olla mikä tahansa Weladon toimisto (esim. Oulu, Tampere, Helsinki, Kuopio tai Seinäjoki). Työskentelemme joustavasti ja pääosin kukin saa valita itselleen sopivimman paikan työskennellä arjessa. Tehtävä edellyttää kuitenkin läsnäoloa asiakkaan työmailla hankkeisen tarpeiden mukaisesti. Tehtävään sisältyy merkittävissä määrin matkustamista, ja myös hankevaiheittain joustamista päivittäisissä työajoissa.

Työskentelypaikka ja käytännöt sovitaan valittavan henkilön sekä projektin perusteella.

Palkka💰

Palkka muodostuu kokemuksesi, osaamisesi ja tehtävän vastuualueen perusteella. Keskustelemme tehtäväkokonaisuudesta ja palkkauksesta avoimesti rekrytointiprosessin aikana. Kuukausipalkan palkkahaitari on 4200-4800 €.

Mitä seuraavaksi? 📨

Jos tunnistit tehtävästä itsesi, haluamme kuulla sinusta 10.1.2027 mennessä.

Kerro meille kokemuksestasi projektinjohtopalveluissa, hankinnoissa, työmaiden johtamisessa, tiedonhallinnassa tai laadun kehittämisessä. Olemme kiinnostuneita erityisesti siitä, millaisista kokonaisuuksista olet vastannut ja millaisissa hankkeissa haluaisit seuraavaksi työskennellä.

Käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuaikana ja juttelemme hakijoiden kanssa, joten jätä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian.

Jos jokin jäi mietityttämään, voit olla yhteydessä kiinteistörakennuttamisen Tampereen seudun aluepäällikköön, Ville Karjalaiseen (ville.karjalainen@welado.fi, +358401485500).

title: Catering/Food Services Floater
description:
Position: Catering & Food Services Floater – Team Member

Location: Canadore College / Nipissing University – North Bay, Ontario

Department: Campus Food Services & Catering

Work Environment: On-site

Position Overview

The Catering & Food Services Floater is responsible for supporting catering events and providing flexible operational assistance across assigned campus food service locations.

This versatile position combines catering preparation, event setup, food and beverage service, customer service, and daily cafeteria support.

The successful candidate must be adaptable, organized, dependable, and comfortable working in different food service environments based on operational requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Catering Operations and Event Service

  • Assist with the preparation, organization, setup, service, and breakdown of catering events.

  • Follow event instructions and Banquet Event Orders (BEOs) to ensure accurate event execution.

  • Prepare meeting rooms and catering service areas, including tables, linens, buffet stations, beverage stations, and service equipment.

  • Set up and replenish coffee, tea, water, beverages, snacks, breakfast items, lunches, and buffet services.

  • Assist with preparing, assembling, portioning, and packaging sandwiches, wraps, salads, platters, and other catering menu items.

  • Verify catering quantities, service equipment, supplies, and setup requirements before events.

  • Ensure catering orders are delivered and presented according to established service times and standards.

  • Provide professional and attentive service to clients, guests, faculty, staff, and event organizers.

  • Monitor food presentation, replenishment, and service quality throughout events.

  • Complete event breakdown, equipment collection, cleaning, and proper storage of reusable supplies.

  • Communicate shortages, event changes, guest concerns, and operational issues to supervisors promptly.

Food Services Floater Responsibilities

  • Provide operational support at assigned food service locations based on staffing and business requirements.

  • Assist in cafeteria operations, food counters, grab-and-go stations, and other designated service areas.

  • Support food preparation, portioning, packaging, and serving activities within the employee's training and classification.

  • Operate cash registers and point-of-sale (POS) systems when assigned.

  • Replenish food products, beverages, disposables, and service supplies.

  • Assist with opening and closing procedures at assigned stations.

  • Provide temporary coverage for scheduled breaks, absences, peak service periods, and other operational requirements.

  • Adapt efficiently to different food service stations while maintaining consistent service standards.

  • Assist with receiving deliveries, stocking shelves, and organizing storage areas.

  • Support daily cleaning, sanitation, dishwashing, and general food service duties.

Food Safety and Quality Assurance

  • Follow Sodexo's food safety, HACCP, sanitation, and workplace health and safety procedures.

  • Monitor food temperatures during preparation, transportation, and service as assigned.

  • Follow safe food handling practices and prevent cross-contamination.

  • Ensure proper food labelling, date marking, and storage.

  • Follow established allergen management procedures and communicate dietary concerns appropriately.

  • Maintain clean and sanitary food service equipment, workstations, and event areas.

  • Report food safety concerns, unsafe conditions, and equipment malfunctions immediately.

Inventory, Portion Control, and Waste Management

  • Follow standardized recipes, portion guidelines, and catering production requirements.

  • Assist with monitoring catering supplies, service equipment, and inventory levels.

  • Follow FIFO and FEFO inventory rotation procedures.

  • Minimize unnecessary food waste and avoid overproduction.

  • Record product waste and losses according to established procedures.

  • Assist with inventory counts and reporting shortages or damaged products.

  • Return unused food and supplies to designated storage areas when safe and appropriate.

Teamwork and Customer Service

  • Maintain a friendly, professional, and customer-focused attitude.

  • Communicate effectively with supervisors, kitchen staff, catering coordinators, and team members.

  • Work collaboratively to ensure catering events and daily service operations run efficiently.

  • Demonstrate flexibility when moving between assigned work areas.

  • Maintain reliable attendance, punctuality, and professional appearance.

  • Follow supervisor instructions and complete assigned duties within established timelines.

Additional duties may be assigned according to operational requirements, qualifications, training, and applicable job classification.

Education and Experience

  • Previous experience in catering, hospitality, banquet service, food service, restaurants, or cafeterias is preferred.

  • High school diploma or equivalent experience is an asset.

  • Valid Food Handler Certification or willingness to obtain certification according to site requirements.

  • Experience in catering setup, buffet service, and food and beverage preparation is an asset.

  • Basic knowledge of food safety, sanitation, food temperatures, and safe food handling procedures.

  • Experience operating a cash register or POS system is beneficial.

  • Ability to read and follow catering orders, event instructions, preparation lists, and service schedules.

  • Basic organizational, numerical, and recordkeeping skills.

Skills and Personal Attributes

  • Excellent customer service and interpersonal skills.

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple tasks.

  • Flexible, adaptable, and comfortable working at different food service locations.

  • Dependable, punctual, and committed to scheduled shifts.

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively.

  • Strong communication skills and a professional attitude.

  • Willingness to learn new duties, equipment, and operational procedures.

  • Ability to prioritize tasks and meet catering event deadlines.

  • Commitment to cleanliness, food quality, teamwork, and customer satisfaction.

Availability and Flexibility

  • Ability to work assigned shifts based on operational requirements.

  • Availability for occasional early morning, evening, or weekend catering events may be required.

  • Willingness to provide operational coverage at designated campus food service locations.

  • Ability to adapt to changing daily priorities while maintaining service quality.

Physical and Working Requirements

  • Ability to stand and walk for extended periods during scheduled shifts.

  • Ability to bend, reach, carry, push carts, and perform routine catering and food service activities.

  • Ability to lift and move food products, catering equipment, and supplies weighing up to approximately 35 pounds, with appropriate assistance or accommodation where required.

  • Ability to safely transport catering supplies and equipment between assigned service areas.

  • Comfortable working in kitchens, dining facilities, catering venues, and food service environments with varying temperatures.

  • Ability to follow established workplace health and safety procedures.

Reasonable accommodations are available in accordance with applicable legislation.

title: Director of Operations - Rockwall, TX
description:
Why Build Your Career with Prysmian?
Your work at Prysmian helps power and connect the world.
Prysmian, the world leader in solutions for energy and digital connections, strengthen its global team with the 2025 addition of Channell, now part of Prysmian. Founded by the Channell family in 1922, Channell brings a long‑standing legacy of innovation in outside plant infrastructure, serving Telecommunications, Municipalities, Internet Service Providers, Wireless, Water, Power, and CATV markets. Together, Prysmian and Channell team members are combining expertise, craftsmanship, and shared values to deliver a broader portfolio, from advanced cable systems and fiber connectivity solutions to enclosures and below‑grade vaults which support resilient infrastructure, the energy transition, and the growth of digital networks around the world.
When you join Prysmian, you become part of a global team whose work touches millions of lives every day. You’ll help support the energy and digital infrastructure that keeps communities, businesses, and industries moving forward.
For more than 140 years, Prysmian has helped shape the infrastructure that powers progress. From helping illuminate the Statue of Liberty in 1886 and delivering power from Hoover Dam to Los Angeles in 1935, to supporting New York City's rebuilding efforts after September 11, our cables and connectivity solutions have played a role in some of history's most significant milestones.
What You’ll Bring
Experience and Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, operations management, business administration, or related field required; MBA or advanced degree preferred.
  • 10+ years of progressive manufacturing operations leadership experience, including 5+ years leading multiple sites or a multi-plant network.
  • Proven track record managing P&L, capital budgets, and operational KPIs across geographically dispersed facilities.
  • Deep knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or comparable continuous improvement methodologies; certification (Lean/Six Sigma Green or Black Belt) preferred.
  • Strong experience with ERP/MES systems and data-driven decision-making.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead through others, build high-performing teams, and manage change across a diverse, multi-site organization.
  • Working knowledge of OSHA, environmental regulations, and quality systems (ISO 9001 or equivalent).
  • Experience in electronics, cable/connector, or precision component manufacturing a plus.
  • Familiarity with thermoplastic molding - low and high pressure injection molding, rotational molding, and blow molding
  • Willingness and ability to travel regularly (up to 40–50%) between facilities, including international travel as applicable.
  • Executive-level communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence senior leadership and the board.
  • Strong financial acumen, including budgeting, forecasting, and cost analysis.
  • Excellent problem-solving and decision-making skills in a fast-paced, multi-site manufacturing environment.
What You'll Do
The Director of Operations provides strategic and operational leadership across the company's multi-site manufacturing network. This role is accountable for driving safety, quality, productivity, cost, and delivery performance at every facility while building a consistent operating system, talent pipeline, and culture of continuous improvement across locations.
The Director partners closely with Plant Managers, Supply Chain, Engineering, Quality, and HR to ensure each site operates at world-class levels and that capacity, capital, and talent decisions support the company's growth and customer commitments.
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:
  • Develop and execute the multi-site manufacturing operations strategy in alignment with overall business goals, growth plans, and customer demand.
  • Establish and standardize a common operating system (KPIs, daily management, tiered accountability meetings) across all plants to ensure consistent execution and visibility.
  • Set annual operating and capital budgets for all locations; own P&L accountability for manufacturing operations.
  • Drive productivity, throughput, and cost-reduction initiatives while maintaining or improving quality and service levels.
  • Lead capacity planning, footprint strategy, and capital investment decisions across the network, including new equipment, line expansions, or facility consolidations.
  • Directly manage and develop Plant Managers/Site Leaders at each location, setting clear performance expectations and holding sites accountable to targets.
  • Build bench strength and succession plans for critical operations roles across all sites; partner with HR on talent acquisition, development, and retention strategies.
  • Foster a culture of engagement, accountability, and continuous improvement; conduct regular site visits and gemba walks.
  • Standardize best practices across facilities and lead cross-site knowledge sharing to eliminate performance variability between plants.
  • Champion an EHS-first culture; ensure all locations meet or exceed OSHA and applicable regulatory requirements, with measurable reduction in incident rates.
  • Ensure consistent adherence to quality management systems (e.g., ISO 9001) and customer quality requirements across all sites.
  • Oversee compliance with environmental, labor, and applicable trade/export regulations at each facility.
  • Lead deployment of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and/or Continuous Improvement methodologies across all locations.
  • Drive standardization of processes, work instructions, and systems (ERP/MES) to improve consistency, data integrity, and decision-making across sites.
  • Identify and lead major process improvement, automation, and cost-savings projects with measurable ROI.
  • Partner with Supply Chain/Planning to align production schedules with demand, inventory targets, and on-time delivery goals.
  • Collaborate with Engineering on new product introductions, process qualifications, and manufacturability improvements.
  • Work with Finance on cost accounting, standard costs, and margin improvement initiatives.
  • Partner with HR on workforce planning, labor relations, compensation strategy, and organizational design across sites.
  • Serve as a key member of the senior leadership team, reporting operational performance and strategic recommendations to executive leadership and/or the board as needed.
You’ll have the opportunity to make an impact, build strong partnerships, and grow your career in a business that values ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Total Rewards Designed for You
We believe great people deserve great rewards. That’s why Prysmian offers a total rewards package designed to support your financial, physical, and personal well-being now and as your career grows.
  • Competitive salary that recognizes your skills, experience, and contributions
  • Performance-based incentives that reward your results and impact (where applicable)
  • Comprehensive health coverage with medical, dental, and vision plan options to fit your needs
  • 401(k) retirement savings plan with a competitive company match to help you invest in your future
  • Paid maternity and bonding leave, plus adoption assistance to support you and your growing family
  • Generous paid time off and company holidays so you can rest, recharge, and spend time on what matters most
  • Life and disability insurance for added peace of mind
  • Wellness programs and supplemental insurance options to support your overall health and well-being
At Prysmian, you’ll be supported at work, at home, and throughout every stage of your career.

title: CRE Risk Analyst
description:
CRE Risk Analyst

Who We Are

Renovo Financial is a dynamic and fast-growing private lender and mortgage servicer based in Chicago, dedicated to partnering with real estate investors who acquire and renovate single and multi-family residential properties. We take pride in delivering exceptional support to our clients, guiding them seamlessly from loan application to pay off with a commitment to unparalleled service. Our focus on reliability and a “win-win” approach has earned us an industry-leading repeat and referral rate, reflecting the strong relationships we build with our clients.

Position Summary

The CRE Risk Analyst supports the ongoing oversight and risk management of Renovo’s Residential CRE loan portfolio across bridge and term loan products. This role is responsible for monitoring loan compliance, borrower performance, and asset-level risk, ensuring adherence to credit policy and loan structure throughout the life of each loan.
The CRE Risk Analyst conducts asset and portfolio level analysis, supports underwriting and loan modifications, and serves as a primary point of contact for performing borrowers. Working closely with Asset Management and internal stakeholders, this position helps identify, assess, and mitigate emerging risks across the portfolio.

Responsibilities

  • Manage ongoing oversight of the full Residential CRE loan portfolio (bridge and term), ensuring adherence to credit policy, loan structure, and risk parameters
  • Work directly with borrowers to complete covenant monitoring and compliance tracking, including financial reporting requirements, liquidity tests, completion milestones, and performance triggers
  • Conduct asset-level and borrower-level analysis, evaluating project progress, sponsor performance, operating trends, and emerging risk factors
  • Prepare portfolio-level risk analysis and reporting, including concentration analysis, exposure monitoring, trend identification, and risk escalation
  • Support loan underwriting and modification activity, including extensions, amendments, and refinance evaluations
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for performing borrower communication, providing project updates, monitoring construction progress, and coordinating resolution of issues
  • Review and analyze construction draws in close partnership with the Asset Management team to ensure budget adherence, completion status, and risk mitigation
  • Review borrower concentration and exposure considerations for accounts that have Residential CRE exposure in addition to other non-CRE products
  • Perform ongoing third-party surveillance of key accounts including lien searches, credit monitoring and review of servicing information such as taxes and insurance compliance

What We Look For

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Real Estate, Accounting, Economics, or a related discipline
  • 5+ years of experience in portfolio management, credit analysis, asset management, or real estate lending, preferably within RTL, multifamily, or construction focused lending
  • Strong understanding of credit risk metrics, including LTV, LTC, DSCR, debt yield, sponsor liquidity, and covenant structures
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze financial statements, borrower financials, project budgets, and construction schedules
  • Experience with loan extensions, modifications, and ongoing asset surveillance across active portfolios
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interact directly with borrowers and internal stakeholders
  • Proficiency in Excel and Microsoft Office, with experience using loan servicing systems or CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce) preferred

At Renovo, we’re building a team that reflects a wide range of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills because we believe diverse voices make us stronger. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants of all identities and experiences.

title: Head of Risk
description:
About InvestEngine

InvestEngine is everything the modern investor should need: unbeatable value, market-leading automation, and a platform built for easy, long-term investing.

We’ve built a strong foundation, with over £3.5 billion invested, award-winning service, and a passionate team. We’re an FCA-regulated investment platform growing fast — and our approach to risk needs to scale with us.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Head of Risk to lead our second line of defence. This is a senior, hands-on role in a lean team: you’ll build and improve things yourself rather than oversee a large function.

Your mission is to build, maintain and continuously improve a proportionate enterprise risk management framework that genuinely works for an investment platform — and to turn it into clear, practical ways for business teams to identify, own, manage and evidence their risks and controls. At the same time, you’ll provide independent challenge and decision-useful risk insight to senior management, the Audit & Risk Committee and the Board.

You’ll report to our Chief Risk & Compliance Officer and work closely with Product, Operations, Technology and Finance.

What You’ll Do

  • Assess our existing ERMF, methodology and registers, keep what works, and agree a prioritised, risk-based improvement plan in your first 90 days

  • Turn the framework into practical workflows, templates, guidance and training that busy first-line teams can actually use — covering RCSAs, controls, events and escalation

  • Embed clear ownership: make sure priority processes have named process, risk and control owners who understand and evidence their responsibilities

  • Raise the quality of risk assessments, risk statements and control evidence, and challenge unsupported conclusions

  • Lead the enterprise-wide risk assessment (EWRA), bringing together owner views, second-line challenge, evidence gaps and material interconnections

  • Design and deliver a proportionate risk-based assurance plan, with clear KRIs, monitoring and escalation of material issues

  • Chair the Executive Risk Committee as a second-line forum overseeing risk appetite and functional risks

  • Provide the Audit & Risk Committee and Board with accurate, timely MI and metrics on exposures against appetite, trends, control weaknesses and actions

  • Provide independent risk input and challenge to our Finance-led ICARA, linking material harms and scenarios to the enterprise risk profile

What We’re Looking For

  • You have personally built an ERMF or material parts of one, and improved an existing framework — connecting taxonomy, appetite, assessments, controls, KRIs, events and assurance

  • A track record of translating policy into workflows and training that first-line teams adopt, without taking over their ownership

  • Strong risk and control judgement: cause–event–impact thinking, inherent and residual risk, design and operating effectiveness

  • Confidence to challenge senior stakeholders constructively while building trust and protecting second-line independence

  • Experience running risk governance and producing clear, decision-useful reporting for committees and the Board

  • Solid understanding of FCA risk and systems-and-controls expectations for a UK regulated firm, including customer harm, CASS, operational resilience, technology and third-party risk

  • Comfortable in a fast-moving, lean environment: you prioritise, deliver proportionate solutions and use modern tools — including AI — to work smarter

  • English fluency at C1 level or above — we are a UK-based company and the role involves regular communication across the business

Nice to Have

  • Practical experience of MIFIDPRU / IFPR and ICARA: material-harm assessments, stress and reverse-stress scenarios, wind-down planning, or independent challenge of a Finance-led ICARA

  • Experience at a growing UK investment platform, execution-only or managed investment services, or a similarly regulated fintech

How We Work

We’re a lean, fast-moving team that values clarity, ownership and transparency.

You’ll have the freedom to improve how things work, the responsibility to follow through, and the backing of a team that values clear thinking and open dialogue. We believe in solving problems at the root rather than simply treating the symptoms.

What We Offer

Impact from day one
You’ll shape how risk is understood and managed across the whole business, with direct visibility to the Board.

Room to grow
As InvestEngine scales, you’ll help shape how risk management develops across the company.

Transparent and open culture
We share information openly, keep communication clear and encourage collaboration across the business.

Supportive, high-calibre team
You’ll work alongside talented people who care about both the quality of their work and the success of the wider team.

Hybrid working
Our office is in Southwark, London, and we work in a hybrid way.

Our Hiring Process

  • Introductory call with our Talent team

  • Interview with the hiring manager

  • Practical exercise: a short risk scenario, presented back

  • Final interview with our CEO

We aim to keep the process straightforward, transparent and efficient.

title: Product Design Lead
description:
Over 300,000 Danish small businesses rely on e-conomic. As AI reshapes software delivery, our challenge is no longer speed – it is quality and trust at speed. Ensuring our product feels coherent across 10 product teams and autonomous agents requires a written, codifiable design standard.

We are hiring our most senior individual contributor: a Design Lead. This is a leverage role, not a delivery role. You set the design direction and principles that shape how e-conomic’s products look, feel and work, so that every team, human or AI, can make great design decisions.

THE TEAM

You partner with 1 Design Manager, 12 product designers, three of whom work in AI enablement and design systems, and work alongside a Design System team of 5. Together we serve 4 value streams and 10 product teams. Guided by our Beaver Manifesto (craft, adaptability, systems thinking), design operates as an equal peer to Product and Engineering.

You step into an established practice with active crits and a design system with a solid foundation, but you will codify the missing piece: the principles, metrics, processes and quality bar that govern them. You decide direction, standards, and trade-offs; the Design System team owns components and tokens; together, you define new patterns.

YOUR IMPACT

Design at e-conomic is embedded in product trios. We need a senior design practitioner to set the standard those decisions are made against and hold accountability for overall product quality.

  • How design works: Establish one clear decision-making framework from validated idea to launch. Own design reviews, crits, decision rights, deviation rules, and design debt tracking – ensuring quality issues are caught before shipping.

  • Design direction and principles: Define interaction and trust principles written so designers, PMs, engineers, and LLMs can all evaluate a screen and resolve trade-offs without you in the room.

  • The quality bar and its metrics: Define what "good" looks like and how to measure it (one-off patterns, design debt, design system adoption). When compromises occur, ensure gaps are tracked with explicit ownership and deadlines.

  • Design in strategy: Partner with Product Leads during value stream planning. Bring usability and trust into scope before solutions are framed, making experience quality a deliberate priority rather than a post-launch fix.

  • An agentic way of designing: Translate rationale and patterns into composable rules that agents can build with, embedding design intelligence directly into our system so humans and AI ship consistent work faster.

  • Depth when it matters: Help designers hold the quality argument with their Product Leads and teams, and set new standards through reference designs.

YOUR PROFILE

Someone who can lead from both ends of the table: carry the quality argument with Product Leads and leadership in their language, and carry the craft discussion with designers and engineers, and hold the two together when speed and quality pull apart.

  • A proven experience at this level: Experience operating as a Staff or Principal Designer, Design Lead, Design System Lead or similar in an organisation where your frameworks and decisions had to hold without you there to defend them.

  • A track record of changing how design works, not just what it shipped: Direction, standards or process that other teams actually adopted, and you can tell us what people did differently afterwards.

  • Outcome-first: You have set outcomes for design work, aligned them to the strategic direction of the business, sequenced the work against them, made the trade-offs visible when capacity or speed forced a choice, and answered for what moved.

  • AI-native practice: You prototype with AI and in code, you have shipped or seriously tested AI-assisted or agentic experiences, and you have a view on where agents change the designer's job and where they do not yet.

  • Design systems, deeply: Help designers hold the quality argument with their Product Leads and teams, and set new standards through reference designs.

  • Credibility at both ends of the table, in the same week: Writing a principle in the morning, reviewing a pattern in the afternoon, and in between saying no to a Product Lead with a better reason than taste, making the trade-off visible, and changing your mind when the evidence says so.

  • Language: Fluent professional English.

Nice-to-have: Danish, Norwegian or Swedish · B2B SaaS, fintech or another domain where trust is the product.

YOUR E-CONOMIC BENEFITS

🦋 Flexible Work Life: Adapt your work environment and hours to suit your lifestyle, with hybrid options available.

🤧 Family First: Unlimited child sick days.

🌍 Global Vibes: An international workplace with +30 nationalities.

💆🏻‍♀️ Well-being: Access a range of services to support your physical and mental health.

🏥 Security: Comprehensive health insurance and company-paid pension.

👩‍💻 Tech Choice: Select your preferred gear, be it Mac or Windows.

🏬 Prime Location: Located in Carlsberg Byen, equipped with the latest facilities.

THE RECRUITMENT PROCESS

If this role aligns with your career aspirations, please submit your CV and answer the application questions below – no cover letter or personal details are required. Please check your inbox and spam folder for a confirmation email.

First, hit that apply button and let's kickstart your e-conomic experience!

The Interview Process

Applications are reviewed continuously, and we invite candidates for interviews as we go.

Initial screening: Conversation with Diana (Talent Partner) to learn more about your motivation and assess fit against the role's defined success criteria.

1st interview: Meet up with Jessica (Design Manager) and Kim (Design System Manager), where we’ll learn more about you, and you’ll get to know the role more in depth. Duration: ~60 min.

2nd interview: A case presented to Jessica , Tue (Senior Product Designer) and the hiring team. You receive the case and a personality assessment in advance. We dedicate at least one hour to the case and the discussion that follows, and we will argue with you a little.

If all interviews align, we typically follow up with two short reference calls as part of the process.

Got questions?

Reach out to Jessica jessica.thomsen@visma.com , Kim kim.johannesen@visma.com or our People & Culture partner Diana diana.rose@visma.com
