title: Internship Rotazionale (UD)
description:
R-261550 Intern - Rotating (UD)

Luogo – Clinica Veterinaria Gaspardis, Visco (UD)
Orario – In regime di libera professione, valutiamo una collaborazione principale (con un impegno indicativo e flessibile di circa 40 ore settimanali). La pianificazione delle attività sarà concordata in modo flessibile in base alle reciproche disponibilità.

Perché unirsi a noi?

  • Parteciperai a un Rotating Internship della durata da 6 a 12 mesi, progettato per accompagnare i medici veterinari neoabilitati nello sviluppo di competenze cliniche solide e trasversali.

  • Avrai l'opportunità di ruotare all'interno dei diversi reparti specialistici della struttura, confrontandoti con un'ampia varietà di discipline e casistiche e comprendendo quando coinvolgere gli specialisti nelle situazioni più complesse.

  • Sarai affiancato dai responsabili dei reparti e da professionisti esperti, ricevendo una supervisione costante che favorirà la tua crescita clinica e decisionale.

  • Avrai accesso a InfoCura, la piattaforma AniCura dedicata alla formazione continua, con contenuti multidisciplinari, webinar e risorse di aggiornamento per supportare il tuo percorso professionale.

Il team

La Clinica Veterinaria Gaspardis, situata nella Bassa Friulana, è un punto di riferimento per la medicina veterinaria specialistica, con particolare esperienza in Ortopedia, Neurologia e Diagnostica per Immagini.

La struttura offre un'ampia gamma di servizi specialistici, tra cui Risonanza Magnetica, Tomografia Computerizzata (TC), Endoscopia rigida e flessibile, Chirurgia dei tessuti molli, Neurochirurgia, Laparoscopia e Toracoscopia. È inoltre presente un reparto dedicato alla Fisioterapia, dotato di underwater treadmill, per supportare il recupero funzionale dei pazienti.

Con un team di circa 20 professionisti, tra medici veterinari, tecnici veterinari e personale di customer care, la clinica garantisce un servizio di reperibilità 24 ore su 24 e gestisce un'ampia varietà di casistiche, dalla medicina di base ai casi specialistici di referenza.

Entrare a far parte della Clinica Veterinaria Gaspardis significa lavorare in un ambiente collaborativo, multidisciplinare e orientato alla qualità delle cure, con l'opportunità di confrontarsi quotidianamente con casistiche diversificate e tecnologie diagnostiche avanzate.

Cosa cerchiamo

  • Laurea in Medicina Veterinaria e regolare iscrizione all'Ordine dei Medici Veterinari, con abilitazione all'esercizio della professione.

  • Possesso di Partita IVA o disponibilità ad attivarla.

  • Capacità di lavorare in team e di collaborare efficacemente con professionisti appartenenti a diverse discipline specialistiche.

  • Forte motivazione all'aggiornamento continuo, alla formazione avanzata e allo sviluppo delle proprie competenze professionali.


Cosa offriamo

  • Collaborazione in P. Iva.

  • Percorso formativo di Internship Rotazionale della durata da 6 a 12 mesi.

  • Possibilità di usufruire di sconti dedicati sui servizi clinici AniCura e presso partner selezionati, tra cui Royal Canin.

  • Accesso alla piattaforma di convenzioni, che offre sconti e offerte speciali su un'ampia gamma di prodotti e servizi.

  • Opportunità di partecipare a seminari e conferenze che favoriscono il continuo aggiornamento professionale e consentono di mantenere le proprie competenze costantemente aggiornate.

  • Formazione continua attraverso programmi di e-learning e percorsi formativi dedicati.

  • Supporto psicologico.

Pronto per il tuo prossimo passo? Candidati oggi e diventa parte della creazione di UN MONDO MIGLIORE PER GLI ANIMALI DOMESTICI.

Chi siamo

AniCura è uno dei principali fornitori europei di cure veterinarie, che riunisce una rete di cliniche e ospedali veterinari dedicati alla salute e al benessere degli animali da compagnia. La nostra ambizione è plasmare il futuro della medicina veterinaria attraverso la collaborazione continua, la condivisione delle migliori pratiche e l'impegno verso i nostri valori fondamentali.

Facciamo parte di Mars Veterinary Health, la più grande azienda veterinaria a conduzione familiare al mondo. Come parte di questa rete globale connessa, ogni anno aiutiamo a curare milioni di animali domestici e sosteniamo le persone che li amano. Essere di proprietà privata ci consente di rimanere concentrati sul nostro Scopo - UN MONDO MIGLIORE PER GLI ANIMALI DOMESTICI - e di investire nell'erogazione di cure veterinarie di alta qualità in ogni fase.

In AniCura, prendersi cura degli animali inizia dal prendersi cura delle nostre persone. Siamo orgogliosi di una cultura basata sulla collaborazione, sull'apprendimento e sul supporto, in cui i colleghi sono incoraggiati a svilupparsi sia personalmente sia professionalmente. Le nostre persone sono al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo e sono ciò che ci distingue davvero. Quando ti unisci ad AniCura, diventi parte di qualcosa di più grande: un'organizzazione internazionale in crescita che sta contribuendo a creare un futuro prospero per le cure veterinarie e per i professionisti che le rendono possibili.

AniCura è un datore di lavoro che garantisce pari opportunità e tutti i candidati qualificati saranno presi in considerazione per l'assunzione indipendentemente da razza, colore, religione, sesso, orientamento sessuale, identità di genere, origine nazionale, stato di disabilità, appartenenza alle categorie protette o qualsiasi altra caratteristica protetta dalla legge. Se hai bisogno di assistenza o di un adattamento durante il processo di candidatura a causa di una disabilità, tale assistenza è disponibile su richiesta scrivendo a giada.malerba@anicura.it. AniCura è lieta di fornire tale assistenza e nessun candidato sarà penalizzato a seguito di tale richiesta.

title: Proposal & Contracts Coordinator
location: BlueOps - Fort Pierce - Fort Pierce, FL 34946-7331
description:
Position Summary

The Proposal Coordinator supports the end-to-end proposal development lifecycle by coordinating schedules, compliance, documentation, and cross-functional inputs in accordance with the Shipley proposal management methodology. This role is critical to ensuring high-quality, compliant, and on-time proposal submissions across federal, DoD, and commercial solicitations.

This position serves as the operational backbone of the proposal team—tracking actions, managing artifacts, enforcing deadlines, and supporting color team reviews to enable the organization to respond quickly and competitively.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Proposal Execution & Compliance

  • Support the Proposal Manager in executing proposals using the Shipley lifecycle (Capture → Proposal Planning → Development → Review → Submission).
  • Create and maintain proposal schedules, compliance matrices, outlines, and deliverable trackers.
  • Analyze RFPs and related solicitation documents to identify requirements, deliverables, and deadlines.
  • Track RFP Q&A, clarifications, and version control.
  • Ensure all proposal volumes meet formatting, page count, and submission requirements.
  • Manage proposal artifacts including outlines, storyboards, win themes, and compliance maps.
  • Monitor SAM.gov, GovWin, and PIEE daily to identify new solicitation opportunities and notify the capture/proposal team.
  • Perform other related duties and projects as assigned.

Team Coordination

  • Coordinate with SMEs, engineering, finance, legal, contracts, and leadership to collect inputs.
  • Track action items, deadlines, and review cycles.
  • Prepare and distribute proposal calendars, meeting agendas, and review materials.
  • Support team reviews (Pink, Red, Gold, etc.) and capture feedback.

Content & Document Management

  • Maintain proposal library, boilerplate content, past performance, resumes, and templates.
  • Manage SharePoint/Teams/Drive folder structures and file naming standards.
  • Ensure version control and submission readiness.

Process & Continuous Improvement

  • Enforce proposal standards, checklists, and quality gates.
  • Support post-submission debrief capture and lessons learned.
  • Help maintain capture/proposal metrics and reporting.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Communications, Technical Writing, or related field.
  • 1–3 years of relevant professional experience in proposal coordination, preferably in the federal or defense proposal environments
  • Working knowledge of FAR/DFARS/FMS and DoD acquisition processes.
  • Strong organizational, multitasking, and deadline-driven work habits.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and SharePoint/Teams.

Additional Desired Qualifications

  • Experience with DoD RFPs, RFIs, OTAs, IDIQs, and BOAs.
  • Familiarity with compliance matrices, storyboarding, and win theme development.
  • Shipley proposal training or certification (Foundation or higher).
  • Experience supporting color team reviews.
  • Knowledge of proposal submission portals (PIEE, SAM.gov, etc.).
  • Basic understanding of pricing and contracts volumes.

Physical Requirements and Working Conditions

  • Must be able to walk, stand, and navigate large indoor and outdoor facilities for extended periods of time.
  • Ability to lift, carry, and move materials and equipment weighing up to 25 lbs on a regular basis.
  • Use of personal protective equipment (PPE) may be required in designated areas or when performing specific tasks, in accordance with safety protocols and company policy.
  • May be required to climb ladders, stoop, kneel, or crouch during inspections, maintenance walk-throughs, or emergency response situations.
  • Regular exposure to facility operations including noise, dust, temperature fluctuations, and industrial equipment.
  • Occasional off-hours or weekend work required for emergency facility responses or projects as needed
  • Requires frequent use of a computer and other standard office equipment for documentation, communication, and coordination tasks.

Background Check

This position will require successfully completing a post-offer background check. Qualified candidates with a criminal history will be considered and are not automatically disqualified, consistent with federal and state law.

EEO and ITAR/EAR Work Authorization Disclosure

Red Cat Holdings provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This position requires direct or indirect access to hardware, software, technology or technical data controlled under the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). Successful candidates for positions subject to ITAR/EAR restrictions must provide proof of U.S. Citizenship or Permanent Residence and must not require sponsorship for export-restricted work authorization.

title: Business analyst (senior) for Regulatory Reporting
description:
Would you like to join the Regulatory Report team in Reporting Solutions, responsible for several critical business solutions and reporting processes within Credit and Financial Risk? Do you want to participate in the data tech transformation in BEC, soon to be Nykredit Financial Technologies?

BEC is looking for a Senior Business Analyst to join the Reporting Solutions domain. The position will be based at our friendly office in Roskilde or Warsaw.

Reporting Solutions plays a vital role in ensuring compliance of BEC’s member banks by managing a portfolio of 40+ business solutions within the business areas of Credit Risk and Finance Solutions, including several business-critical data hubs that support banks' business processes, internal reporting, and obligations in regulatory reporting.

You will join the Regulatory Reporting team with responsibility for both maintenance and development of a portfolio of business solutions that ensure accurate, reliable, and traceable data for our Credit Risk - Standardized Approach (SA-CR) provided by NASDAQ (Axiom), Unlikeliness to Pay, ESG and other applications within Regulatory Reporting.

You will join a high‑performing, cross‑functional team, combining solid business knowledge with strong software engineering practices. The team works with NASDAQ Axiom, Mainframe, Netezza, and Databricks platforms. The team is currently situated in Herning but will transition and consolidate in Roskilde and Warsaw by end of 2027.

This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the forefront of BEC’s data tech transformation, using modern, Cloud-based technologies and event‑driven architectures to build scalable data products to substitute for current business solutions. This will give banks easier access to trusted, consistent data, whether for self-service analytics, reporting, regulatory requirements, or operational processes.

**Primary tasks and responsibilities include:

**

  • Manage incidents and problems effectively in close collaboration with colleagues and clients
  • Explore and analyse complex credit risk datasets to identify patterns, anomalies, and opportunities. for improvement of business solutions and reporting processes
  • Translate business and regulatory requirements into analytical use cases and communicate insights to stakeholders both internally in BEC and clients
  • Collaborate closely with Business Analysts, Software Engineers, and Architects in Reporting Solutions to ensure high-quality, reliable, and well‑governed data foundations
  • Build analytical data products and models that support regulatory reporting and decision‑making across the credit risk domain
  • Participate in the tech and data transformation in BEC towards a modern data platform using Azure and Databricks
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of the development process and client engagement

**To succeed you will have:

**

  • 5+ years’ work experience as Business Analyst from Banking or financial IT
  • Regulatory work experience from the banking sector in Denmark
  • Extensive knowledge of the regulations: BASEL III, COREP (SA-CR), ESG, FINREP and other Regulatory reports
  • Extensive experience working with large and complex datasets
  • Understanding of data modelling concepts and data governance principles
  • Experience of working in agile setups like Scrum or SAFe.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Fluency in Danish and English, written and spoken.

**It’s nice-to-have:

**

  • A relevant Master degree
  • Working experience with NASDAQ Axiom platform
  • Programming skills in SQL, Python or Power BI
  • Work experience with modern platforms such as Databricks.

As a person, you are ambitious, goal oriented, and persistent. You have a curious and analytical mindset. You are a team player who is proactive and takes responsibility. You are service minded towards both clients and colleagues.

**Be your best self with BEC's benefits!

**We offer a diverse range of benefits for our employees. Here are just a few of them.

  • Professional development budget
  • Healthy, varied lunch and fruit in the canteen
  • Active staff associations: yoga, cycling, go-karting, games, bowling etc.
  • Pension scheme
  • Health and dentist insurance
  • Referral bonus

**What does the recruitment process look like?

**

  • Send us your CV: We want to get to know you
  • Screening call: Let's chat and see if we're a match
  • Meet your future manager and team: See who you'll be working closely with.
  • Personality and cognitive test: Let's learn more about you.
  • Meet our talent partner and your future manager once more: Get feedback on your test results.
  • Time to sign the contract: We're ready to welcome you to BEC!

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Talent Attraction Partner Anders Rud Skak-Arnstrup at rud@bec.dk

BEC is in the process of being acquired by our largest customer and co-owner, Nykredit, which is Denmark's largest mortgage provider and third-largest bank. We will become part of a new and larger organization called Nykredit Financial Technologies. In the transition phase, we are recruiting for roles that we expect to be highly needed in our future organization.

title: R&D Cybersecurity - Digital Assurance, Onsite
description:
About Sandia

Sandia National Laboratories is the nation’s premier science and engineering lab for national security and technology innovation, with teams of specialists focused on cutting-edge work in a broad array of areas. Some of the main reasons we love our jobs:

  • Challenging work with amazing impact that contributes to security, peace, and freedom worldwide
  • Extraordinary co-workers
  • Some of the best tools, equipment, and research facilities in the world
  • Career advancement and enrichment opportunities
  • Flexible work arrangements for many positions include 9/80 (work 80 hours every two weeks, with every other Friday off) and 4/10 (work 4 ten-hour days each week) compressed workweeks, part-time work, and telecommuting (a mix of onsite work and working from home)
  • Generous vacation, strong medical and other benefits, competitive 401k, learning opportunities, relocation assistance and amenities aimed at creating a solid work/life balance*

World-changing technologies. Life-changing careers. Learn more about Sandia at: http://www.sandia.gov


*These benefits vary by job classification.

What Your Job Will Be Like

Are you interested in defending and protecting our national security systems against advanced cyber threats? Would you like to contribute to the development of Sandia's digital assurance and risk management requirements and policies for national security systems? Are you up for the challenge to help enact a new vision for implementing digital systems security engineering?

If so, the Digital Systems Security Engineering team has multiple openings for highly motivated and hardworking Systems Security Engineers (job title: R&D Cybersecurity) passionate about the security and assurance of non-traditional digital systems for our nuclear deterrent mission. Come join our team and make a national impact!

On any given day, you may be called on to:

  • Develop systems security requirements and digital assurance plans
  • Support implementation of digital assurance, risk assessment, and security plans
  • Conduct system-level security risk assessment and provide guidance and recommendations
  • Identify digital assurance and security gaps and vulnerabilities
  • Derive and translate security requirements for system/product design and engineering team
  • Coordinate digital assurance and systems security engineering activities
  • Develop innovative security solutions with acceptable risk tolerance
  • Develop applicable Nuclear Deterrent Program level digital assurance policies and requirements
  • Support risk management framework activities for Nuclear Deterrent digital systems
  • Develop test tools and strategies for digital assurance and cybersecurity testing
  • Document and communicate analysis results effectively to technical and non-technical user groups in written and oral formats
  • Gather, organize and present information requested for internal and external security data calls.
  • Champion security best practices and serve as a security subject matter expert for digital system teams

Due to the nature of the work, the selected applicant must be able to work onsite.

Applicants on this requisition may be interviewed by multiple organizations at Sandia National Laboratories.

Salary Range

$121,900 - $237,800

*Salary range is estimated, and actual salary will be determined after consideration of the selected candidate's experience and qualifications, and application of any approved geographic salary differential.

Qualifications We Require

  • A Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline, or an equivalent combination of directly relevant education and engineering or scientific experience that demonstrates the knowledge, skills, and ability to perform independent research and development
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a DOE Q-level security clearance

Qualifications We Desire

The ideal R&D S&E Cybersecurity candidate for Sandia National Laboratories will in addition possess the following:

  • Graduate degree in Computer Science/Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Information Systems, Computer Forensics, Mathematics or a directly related field where an independent research project was a graduation requirement (e.g., independent project, thesis, or dissertation)
  • Experience in one or more of the following: reverse engineering, software vulnerability assessment, web application assessment, computer networking, computer architecture, compilers, or similar computer security topics
  • Proficiency in scripting or high-level programming
  • Familiarity with secure-system design principles and information assurance principles
  • Excellent communication skills and a demonstrated ability to develop technical ideas and results and present them in oral and written form in a concise manner

Also, for this posting we are seeking individuals with the following experience:

  • Experience with Systems Security Engineering concept and have digital assurance experience, preferably with DoD platform security, hardware design and embedded systems security
  • Experience in developing security plans and/or performing cyber security assessments for non-traditional (non-IT) digital systems.
  • Experience with the development and/or testing and evaluating of digital systems for security and reliability
  • Knowledge and experience of DOE/NNSA and/or DoD cyber security orders and policies; relevant federal and private standards and requirements (e.g., NIST, ISO, CNSS, etc.); and understanding of the Risk Management Framework (RMF) as documented in various NIST publications
  • Experience with security requirements implementation for hardware, software or firmware
  • Familiarity with security best-practices, standards and guides in defense, automotive, or aviation industries
  • Experience with Model-Base Systems Engineering process and tools
  • Experience in hardware systems engineering, hardware/software security architecture, platform security, hardware development, applied cryptography, authentication and protocols, systems engineering
  • Excellent self-initiative and self-motivation with the ability to work under minimal supervision
  • Active DOE Q-level security clearance or equivalent DOD Top Secret level security clearance

About Our Team

The Cyber & Digital Assurance Group is composed of four cyber security departments that conduct research, develop tools and methods, and work closely with customers to assure verification of high-consequence digital systems and to support cybersecurity of enterprise and weapons systems. We serve as local domain experts for Sandia/CA nuclear weapon system and component organizations, and as Sandia resources for cybersecurity operations, as well as for digital formal verification, rigorous cyber experimentation, and cyber risk assessments. We engage throughout the design-to-retirement lifecycle, and actively manage research collaborations with academic institutions. We are dedicated to supporting cybersecurity of Sandia and government systems, and digital assurance of a flexible and responsive nuclear deterrent that remains robust to an evolving environment.

Posting Duration

This posting will be open for application submissions for a minimum of three (3) calendar days, including the 'posting date'. Sandia reserves the right to extend the posting date at any time.

Security Clearance

Sandia is required by DOE to conduct a pre-employment drug test and background review that includes checks of personal references, credit, law enforcement records, and employment/education verifications. Applicants for employment need to be able to obtain and maintain a DOE Q-level security clearance, which requires U.S. citizenship. If you hold more than one citizenship (i.e., of the U.S. and another country), your ability to obtain a security clearance may be impacted.

Applicants offered employment with Sandia are subject to a federal background investigation to meet the requirements for access to classified information or matter if the duties of the position require a DOE security clearance. Substance abuse or illegal drug use, falsification of information, criminal activity, serious misconduct or other indicators of untrustworthiness can cause a clearance to be denied or terminated by DOE, resulting in the inability to perform the duties assigned and subsequent termination of employment.

EEO

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status and any other protected class under state or federal law.

NNSA Requirements for MedPEDs

If you have a Medical Portable Electronic Device (MedPED), such as a pacemaker, defibrillator, drug-releasing pump, hearing aids, or diagnostic equipment and other equipment for measuring, monitoring, and recording body functions such as heartbeat and brain waves, if employed by Sandia National Laboratories you may be required to comply with NNSA security requirements for MedPEDs.

If you have a MedPED and you are selected for an on-site interview at Sandia National Laboratories, there may be additional steps necessary to ensure compliance with NNSA security requirements prior to the interview date.

title: Employer Relations Coordinator
description:
Hiring Department

Dean of Engineering

Job Description

The Office of Engineering Career Services (ECS) invites applications for a self-motivated and student-focused professional for the position of Employer Relations Coordinator. The Office of Engineering Career Services works collaboratively to provide professional development and employment opportunities for students and represents the College of Engineering to employers (including alumni) seeking to recruit Engineering students.
Under the supervision of the Associate Dean and Director of Recruitment and Retention, the Employer Relations Coordinator will be the first point of contact for employer relationships impacting Engineering students’ professional development, including but not limited to internship, co-op support, and full-time positions, employer recruitment consultation, and events related to employment for Engineering students.

Responsibilities:
• Coordinates and executes two large-scaled career fairs of more than 300 employers per year.
• Coordinates marketing efforts to increase employer and student attendance.
• Lead on planning, implementing, and evaluating employer engagement events (tabling meet and greets, info sessions, site visits, classroom visits, etc.).

title: Deputy Program Manager for Zoning
description:
General Job Information

Job Summary

This position is located in the Office of Zoning Administration (OZA), Office of the Director, Department of Buildings (DOB). This office has the lead responsibility for ensuring that land use and building construction in the District of Columbia complies with zoning regulations, the D.C. Code, and other applicable laws. The mission of the District of Columbia Department of Buildings is to protect the safety of residents, businesses, and visitors and advance the development of the built environment through permitting, inspections, and code enforcement.

This position functions as the Deputy Program Manager for Zoning and is, responsible for and provides the day-to-day supervision of the OZA team (comprised of zoning plan reviewers, zoning enforcement staff, program analysts, and program support staff) within the program.

Duties and Responsibilities

Incumbent plans, organizes, and supervises the operation of a program(s) and its activities in accordance with the mission and goals of the agency; develops new programs to support the strategic direction of the agency; advises and consults with administration/division managers; meets with appropriate staff to identify and resolve problems or conflicts; makes or recommends final decisions regarding policy, operations, and administrative procedures of the program. Establishes and manages long- and short-term program goals; develops, analyzes, and evaluates new or modified program/management policies, regulations, goals, or objectives. Develops, implements and maintains complex procedures, administrative monitoring practices and controls in order to obtain smooth and effective operation of a program(s); coordinates work activities of the program to prevent delays in required actions or to improve programs or services; identifies , develops and implements departmental goals, objectives, policies, and priorities; determines resource allocation and levels of service according to established policies; plans and writes grant applications and manages grant-funded projects. Develops and analyzes program reports; directs the preparation of monthly and annual reports; directs the gathering and analysis of information and reports necessary to document and evaluate processes. Directs the allocation of resources to achieve timely outcomes and measurable goals within budget; adjusts plans and programs to meet emerging or new programs, while continuing to address major program priorities.

Directs the identification of service gaps, problems and deficiencies, and the development of new program and service strategies to improve, refine or broaden program areas in response to the needs of the District and the community. Develops plans and strategies to monitor and evaluate program efficiency and effectiveness based on established goals, outcomes, and benchmarks. Sets performance measures for program area. Analyzes program data and performance measures in relation to agency, local/state and national objectives for the program area. Tracks industry trends, local and regional program area issues, and District policy to ensure integration of program initiatives. Serves as a liaison between the agency and/or division, community agencies, citizen groups, developers, property managers, committees and commissions, federal, state, and local agencies, authorities, and task forces concerning agency program needs, new programs, policies, and procedures and to facilitate progress on specific projects.

Qualifications and Education

Specialized experience is experience that equipped the applicant with the knowledge, skills, and abilities to successfully perform the duties of the position, and that is typically in or related to the position to be filled. To be creditable, one (1) year of specialized experience must have been equivalent to at least the next lower grade level in the normal line of progression.

Licenses and Certifications

None

Working Conditions/Environment

The work is performed in an office setting.

Other Significant Facts

title: Grill/Prep
description:
Position: Grill & Food Preparation Team Member

Location: Canadore College / Nipissing University – North Bay, Ontario

Work Environment: On-site, Campus Food Services

Position Overview

The Grill & Food Preparation Team Member is responsible for preparing, cooking, assembling, and serving high-quality meals while maintaining excellent standards of food safety, cleanliness, portion control, and customer service.

The successful candidate will work primarily at the grill and food preparation stations, supporting daily food service operations and ensuring meals are prepared consistently according to approved recipes, presentation standards, and customer expectations.

Key Responsibilities

Grill and Cooking Operations

  • Prepare and cook menu items such as burgers, chicken, sandwiches, breakfast items, and other grilled foods.

  • Operate commercial grills, flat-top cooking equipment, fryers, ovens, and other kitchen equipment safely.

  • Follow standardized recipes, cooking instructions, and approved portion sizes.

  • Ensure food is cooked to the required internal temperatures and served promptly.

  • Monitor product quality, freshness, presentation, and consistency.

  • Maintain an organized and properly stocked grill station throughout service.

  • Coordinate food preparation to minimize customer waiting times during busy periods.

  • Communicate with team members to maintain smooth and efficient service.

Food Preparation

  • Wash, cut, portion, and prepare vegetables, proteins, and other ingredients.

  • Prepare sandwiches, wraps, salads, sauces, and grab-and-go products as assigned.

  • Complete daily preparation lists based on production requirements.

  • Label, date, and store prepared ingredients properly.

  • Follow First-In, First-Out (FIFO) and First-Expired, First-Out (FEFO) rotation procedures.

  • Monitor ingredient levels and communicate replenishment requirements to supervisors.

  • Assist with receiving, organizing, and storing food deliveries.

Food Safety and Sanitation

  • Follow Sodexo food safety, HACCP, and workplace health and safety procedures.

  • Check and record food temperatures during cooking, holding, cooling, and reheating as applicable.

  • Prevent cross-contamination by following appropriate food handling, handwashing, and sanitation practices.

  • Follow allergen management procedures and communicate allergy concerns appropriately.

  • Maintain clean and sanitized food preparation areas, workstations, utensils, and equipment.

  • Complete daily cleaning and sanitation responsibilities.

  • Report equipment issues, unsafe conditions, or food safety concerns immediately.

Inventory, Portion Control, and Waste Reduction

  • Follow standardized recipes and portion sizes to maintain product consistency and control food costs.

  • Monitor production quantities to avoid unnecessary overproduction.

  • Record food waste and product losses using established procedures.

  • Use ingredients efficiently while maintaining food quality.

  • Assist with stock counts and inventory rotation.

  • Identify slow-moving or excess products and report them to supervisors.

Customer Service and Teamwork

  • Provide friendly, respectful, and efficient service to students, faculty, staff, and visitors.

  • Answer basic menu questions and direct allergy-related inquiries according to established procedures.

  • Work collaboratively with kitchen staff, cashiers, food service workers, and supervisors.

  • Support other food service stations during peak periods when assigned.

  • Maintain professional conduct and reliable attendance.

Additional duties may be assigned according to operational requirements and the employee's training and classification.

Education and Experience

  • Previous experience in grill cooking, food preparation, quick-service restaurants, cafeterias, or commercial kitchens is preferred.

  • High school diploma or equivalent experience is an asset.

  • Valid Food Handler Certification or willingness to obtain certification according to site requirements.

  • Knowledge of food safety, sanitation, temperature control, and safe food handling practices.

  • Experience operating commercial grills, fryers, ovens, and other kitchen equipment is an asset.

  • Ability to follow recipes, preparation instructions, and portioning guidelines.

  • Basic understanding of inventory rotation, food waste reduction, and kitchen organization.

Skills and Personal Attributes

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

  • Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced food service environment.

  • Reliable, punctual, and committed to scheduled shifts.

  • Positive attitude and willingness to support team operations.

  • Ability to communicate professionally with customers, coworkers, and supervisors.

  • Ability to manage several tasks while maintaining food quality and safety standards.

  • Commitment to cleanliness, teamwork, and customer satisfaction.

  • Willingness to learn and work at different food preparation stations as required.

Physical and Working Requirements

  • Ability to stand and walk for extended periods during scheduled shifts.

  • Ability to bend, reach, and perform repetitive food preparation activities.

  • Ability to lift and move food products and supplies weighing up to approximately 35 pounds, with appropriate assistance or accommodation where required.

  • Comfortable working around commercial cooking equipment and in environments with varying temperatures.

  • Ability to follow all workplace health and safety policies and use required personal protective equipment.

Reasonable accommodations are available in accordance with applicable legislation.

title: BIM Consultant - Electrical
description:

    • Group health insurance with nominal employee contribution

    • Employer match of employee HSA contributions, dollar-for-dollar up to the IRS limit
  • 401(k) with company match of up to 4% of base salary

Symetri is an Equal Opportunity Employer as to all protected groups, including protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. We embrace diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Program Assistant  (Graveyard)
description:

Established in 1891, URM is now one of the largest rescue missions of its kind in the United States and the oldest in Los Angeles. Join us at Union Rescue Mission as we bring hope and share the compassion of Christ to those devastated by homelessness.

The Program Assistant will assist management, monitor guests, and promote a safe and secure environment.

Colossians 3:23 is the foundation of URM’s standard for employment, “Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as though you were working for the Lord and not for people.” and Galations 5:13 “Serve one another humbly in love.” The goal for each employee is to enrich and sustain a humble heart attitude; to enrich and sustain a mindset of serving others, treating them with kindness and truth; and to enrich and sustain a zealous desire for achieving work objectives without any ulterior motives or agendas.

  • Conduct other duties as assigned by the direct supervisor.
  • Commitment to URM (Union Rescue Mission) mission, vision, and core values.

title: Refrigeration Specialist
description:
At Maersk Container Industry (MCI), we are looking for a skilled and passionate Refrigeration Specialist to join our innovative engineering team.

In this role, you will combine deep technical expertise with creative problem-solving to design and optimize reliable, cost-effective refrigeration solutions. Your work will contribute directly to the development of industry-leading reefer technology that supports global trade.

  • A high degree of independence and flexibility in your daily work

  • Collaboration with international colleagues from diverse backgrounds

  • Calculating and dimensioning refrigeration components and systems to ensure optimal performance

Personal qualities

We are looking for someone who:

  • Takes a structured and analytical approach to problem-solving

  • Works well both independently and as part of a team

  • Has a solution-oriented and results-driven mindset

  • Can balance being a technical specialist and pragmatic project leader

Location

This position is based at MCI’s headquarters in Tinglev, Denmark.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact our HR department at: 📧 hr@mcicontainers.com

We review applications on an ongoing basis and encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

title: CSM Professional I - Plant Research and Greenhouse Operations Professional
description:
Hiring Department

Plant Growth Facilities

Job Description

The University of Missouri Plant Growth Facilities is seeking a Plant Research and Greenhouse Operations Professional to provide specialized plant care and research support for faculty, research staff, postdoctoral fellows, and students.

This position plays an important role in supporting plant biology and agricultural research by maintaining healthy plant populations, monitoring growing conditions, coordinating pest management activities, and helping ensure that greenhouse operations meet research and compliance requirements. The successful candidate will work in a collaborative research environment supporting multiple research projects and helping protect valuable plant materials and the integrity of ongoing experiments.

Successful candidates will be comfortable working independently while also collaborating closely with researchers and facility users. Strong candidates will bring excellent attention to detail, sound judgment, and a proactive approach to identifying plant health or environmental concerns before they affect research outcomes.

Because this facility supports multiple investigators and research programs, the ability to balance competing priorities and communicate effectively with researchers will be particularly important.

Key Responsibilities
In this role, you will:
• Collaborate with faculty, research staff, postdoctoral fellows, and students to develop and implement plant production plans that support experimental protocols and research timelines.
• Monitor plant health, growth, and environmental conditions and identify concerns related to pests, diseases, nutrient deficiencies, or environmental stress.
• Implement and recommend appropriate plant care and corrective strategies to support healthy plant growth and successful research outcomes.
• Coordinate integrated pest management activities, including preventative practices, pest monitoring, and appropriate control measures.
• Support compliance with university policies, biosafety protocols, permitting requirements, and applicable requirements associated with plant research.
• Develop and implement standard operating procedures related to plant production, greenhouse research support, and experimental plant management.
• Train and provide guidance to students, researchers, and laboratory personnel on greenhouse procedures, plant care practices, pest prevention, and research compliance.
• Coordinate greenhouse space utilization and plant placement to accommodate multiple concurrent research projects.
• Maintain accurate records related to greenhouse activities, plant materials, and space utilization.
• Coordinate inventory and procurement of seeds, growing media, fertilizers, plant care supplies, and other greenhouse research materials.
• Communicate plant health concerns and recommendations to investigators and research personnel.
• Perform other job-related duties as assigned.

Shift

Monday-Friday, 8am-5pm; with flexibility for weekend/evening hours as required for experiment needs.

Minimum Qualifications

Associate's degree or an equivalent combination of education and experience and at least 3 years of experience from which comparable knowledge and skills can be acquired is necessary

Preferred Qualifications

We are seeking candidates who have experience or education related to plant growth, greenhouse operations, agriculture, or biological research. Preferred qualifications include:
• Bachelor's degree in plant science, horticulture, agronomy, biology, plant pathology, entomology, agriculture, or a related field.
• Experience working in a greenhouse, growth chamber, agricultural research, university research, or similar environment.
• Knowledge of plant production, plant nutrition, pest and disease identification, and environmental stress management.
• Experience with integrated pest management (IPM), including pest scouting, prevention, and control strategies.
• Experience supporting research experiments or working with research faculty, staff, or students.
• Strong organizational and recordkeeping skills and the ability to coordinate multiple research projects and priorities.
• Ability to communicate effectively and work collaboratively with individuals from a variety of scientific and technical backgrounds.
• Experience developing or implementing standard operating procedures.
• Pesticide applicator certification or the ability to obtain applicable certification, for assigned duties.

Salary Range: $24.00 - $32.00 hourly
Grade: Salary Plan # GGS 008

title: Parts Administrator
description:
The Parts Administrator supports the daily parts operations of the National Service Garage by maintaining accurate parts inventory, receiving and processing parts, supporting technicians with parts needs, processing returns, and ensuring parts are available to keep vehicle repairs moving efficiently.

This position requires strong organization, attention to detail, computer skills, and the ability to manage multiple parts related processes in an automotive service environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Receive incoming parts and accurately enter receipts into Tekion, including order numbers, part numbers, quantities, and applicable vehicle brands.
  • Maintain accurate parts inventory and assist with inventory adjustments and reconciliation.
  • Review and process daily parts reports, including backorders, packing lists, and credit memos.
  • Monitor backordered and special-order parts and follow up as necessary to support vehicle repair completion.
  • Process OEM parts returns and return claims through WebDCS, including preparing documentation and organizing parts for shipment or delivery.
  • Research and identify correct parts for repair orders and assist technicians with parts availability.
  • Research tire applications and availability and enter required tire parts into Tekion.
  • Maintain appropriate stocking levels for commonly used parts and tires.
  • Verify receiving paperwork against actual parts received to help maintain inventory accuracy.
  • Maintain an organized, clean, and efficient parts storage area.
  • Coordinate with technicians, service personnel, vendors, and other departments regarding parts needs, shortages, returns, and order status.
  • Follow company, OEM, safety, and parts-handling procedures.
  • Assist with other parts and service administrative responsibilities as needed.
  • Monitor inventory levels and maintain an adequate supply of oil, tires, filters, and other commonly used shop items to support daily service operations.
  • Automotive parts, dealership, service department, warehouse, or inventory experience preferred.
  • Familiarity with automotive parts and terminology preferred.
  • Experience with dealership management or inventory systems is a plus.
  • Experience with Tekion, WebDCS, or similar automotive systems is highly desirable.
  • Strong computer and data-entry skills.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple tasks and work independently.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with technicians and other members of the service operation.

title: Outlet Store Supervisor
description:
The Outlet Supervisor is responsible for assisting with the supervision of outlet operations, and completing assigned operational tasks with management guidance. Motivates the team to ensure that customer satisfaction and production standards are being met to achieve organizational objectives.

RESPONSIBILITY LEVEL:

Implements strategies to achieve the goals for the organization and outlet store operations. Implements, revises, and sustains policies, procedures and programs. Typically works on projects and initiatives that span 3 - 12 months.

PRINCIPAL DUTIES:

1. Project and Change Management: Effectively plans and manages own work to reliably complete routine job responsibilities and special assignments. May serve as a team member or subject matter expert on formal projects or within the department. Effectively engages in change affecting her/him, communicating appropriately with supervisor. Follows through on learning, skill building, and practice necessary to adapt to change.
2. Problem Solving: Light supervision; works independently. Periodic review of work by manager or senior coworker. Solves problems of moderate to advanced complexity; able to identify root cause, interpret data and resolve issues.
3. Technical Skill: Understands and applies professional principles and skills within area of specialization to modify processes to resolve situations.
4. Community Engagement: Champions Goodwill's community engagement initiatives and serves as an ambassador for Goodwill in the wider community.
5. Maximizes the value of donated goods from salvage through strategic pricing methods, while managing different types of salvage commodities.
6. Coordinate the proper rotation of goods in the outlet to ensure a continuous flow of new merchandise.
7. Train and coach all employees to reach their potential as a highly productive and collaborative member of the team. Oversee and ensure adequate coverage at POS, sales floor and production.
8. Assist with hiring process of associates, new hire orientations and training as needed.
9. Function as a customer service manager (CSM); operate register, assign tills, maintain efficient customer flow, sales staff productivity and proper cash controls.
10. Maintain a safe and orderly work environment; ensure employees operate equipment safely and follow safe work practices.
11. Work with Outlet Management to conduct apprehensions following established loss prevention policies and procedures.
12. Accurately complete data entry of required reports on time. Share with leadership insight or concerns found in report data or other documentation
13. Plan and organize work assignments to increase customer service and protect assets.
14. Provide hands on leadership to motivate employees to increase employee satisfaction.
15. Responsible for completing other duties/responsibilities as assigned.

REQUIREMENTS:

1. Two years of supervisory experience preferred.
2. Forklift certification.
3. Ability to work flexible schedule as business warrants; including nights and weekends.
4. Must have working phone that allows for communication accessibility.
5. Ability to operate heavy machinery.

CORE CULTURAL COMPETENCIES:

1. Customer Focus: Independently anticipate and meet customer needs, while searching for ways to improve customer service. Internalize customer feedback, and follow up with customer to ensure problems are solved by providing innovative ideas to meet their future needs.
2. Values Differences: Seeks out the diverse perspectives and talents of others, striving to work effectively with others who have different perspectives, backgrounds or styles. Behave with sensitivity towards differences in cultural norms, expectations, and ways of communicating. Challenge stereotyping or offensive comments.
3. Communicates Effectively: Shares information and updates with others, while ensuring a clear, concise and professional communication through reports, documentation, written and other communications. Listens with interest to what others have to say.
4. Situational Adaptability: Demonstrates flexibility of responses to different situations through adapting to the changing needs, conditions, priorities or opportunities. Monitors how well an approach is working to see if a change is needed, recognizing cues that suggest a change in approach or behavior is needed.
5. Drives Results: Demonstrates a strong drive to achieve meaningful results, through driving tasks to successful completion and closure. Sets high standards for own performance, showing determination in the face of obstacles and setbacks.
6. Ensures Accountability: Takes responsibility and ownership for successes and failures in own work. Monitors progress of performance and changes approach accordingly, following through on commitments.

PHYSICAL/SENSORY DEMANDS:

Regularly lifts and/or moves up 10 pounds, frequently lifts and/or moves up to 20 pounds, occasionally lifts and/or moves up to 50 pounds. Moves about to accomplish tasks. Lift: Raises objects from lower to higher position or moves objects horizontally. Stoop, kneel crouch or crawl: Positions self to retrieve objects. Reach: Extending upwards or downwards to retrieve objects. Worker is subject to weather conditions (hot, humid, dry, cold etc.). Worker is subject to human blood, body fluids or tissue. Worker is subject to hazards: proximity to dangerous machinery, moving vehicles, electrical currents, chemicals, or high places. Required to stand for long periods of time, Required to hear and respond to warning devices on equipment, vision Required for while using computer keyboard and work with written and electronic information and to assess store and warehouse operations.

title: Scientist, Formulation Chemistry
description:
Eurofins PSS is seeking a highly motivated scientist to support the client’s Early Formulation Science and Drug Delivery group. The candidate will work directly on a client site in Cambridge, MA and the role requires daily onsite presence, five (5) days per week.

This position will collaborate directly with group project leads and, in some cases, client Pharmacology/Biology scientists. This scientist will support the development of stage-appropriate traditional and enabled formulations for pre-clinical studies. This role will also be responsible for conducting basic in vitro experiments and basic in silico predictions, in addition to basic material science and physicochemical properties assessments of early drug candidates. This role includes both laboratory measurements and basic data interpretation to inform bio-performance and stability risks for development of oral small molecule drug candidates.

ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Prediction and experimental evaluation of physicochemical properties of potential small molecule drug candidates (solubility and chemical/physical properties)
  • Contribute to the development and evaluation of fit for purpose, standard and enabled formulations for preclinical studies (oral, subcutaneous, intravenous, etc)
  • Perform dissolution / precipitation/ flux studies of drugs in biorelevant conditions
  • Support laboratory experiments for novel research efforts in the area of pharmaceutics and biopharmaceutics.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • MS with 2-4 years of experience, or BS with 3-6 years of experience in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Physical Chemistry, Physics, Physical Organic Chemistry, Pharmaceutics, or Pharmaceutical Sciences.
  • Experience working in a pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or related R&D environment supporting drug discovery or early development programs.
  • Hands-on experience working with small molecule drug candidates and associated physicochemical characterization.
  • Practical experience operating and troubleshooting HPLC systems for analysis of small molecule compounds.
  • Experience working independently and collaboratively in a laboratory environment

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience in conducting hypothesis driven laboratory experiments and detailed capture of experimental details and observations in electronic laboratory notebook systems.
  • Experience with application of fundamental principles of general chemistry
  • Experience with basic data structuring and capture
  • Experience with basic AI prompting
  • Experience with formulation design for preclinical studies
  • Experience supporting early-stage formulation, pharmaceutics, or drug delivery research within an R&D setting.
  • Knowledge of chromatographic method development, sample preparation, and analysis using HPLC and related analytical techniques.
  • Strong organizational skills, interpersonal skills, teamwork skills, strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects and activities while managing tight timelines
  • Authorization to work in the United States indefinitely without restriction or sponsorship

The position is full-time, Monday-Friday, 8:00am-5:00pm, with overtime as needed. Candidates living within a commutable range of Cambridge, MA are encouraged to apply.

  • Comp: $32-36/hr
  • Excellent full time benefits including comprehensive medical coverage, dental, and vision options
  • Life and disability insurance
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Paid vacation and holidays

title: Driftstekniker

Newsec skal styrke teamet med en driftstekniker som trives med praktiske oppgaver, har orden i verktøykassa og liker å levere god service. Hos oss får du en variert arbeidshverdag, tydelig ansvar og engasjerte kolleger som støtter deg.

Newsec tilbyr eiendomsbesittere, investorer og leietakere et bredt spekter av tjenester innen eiendomsforvaltning.

Våre 330 ansatte forvalter ca. 4 millioner kvadratmeter med næringseiendom til en verdi på ca. 68 milliarder NOK. Hovedkontoret i Norge er i Trondheim.

Newsec ble grunnlagt i 1994 og er i dag et partnereid selskap med over 2 600 medarbeidere i Norden og Baltikum. Vi er i dag Nord-Europas største forvalter av næringseiendom, og takket være store volumer, lokal tilstedeværelse og inngående forståelse av bransjen, har vi en unik kunnskap om eiendomsmarkedet i Norge og Nord-Europa.

title: Product Engineering Manager
description:
At Visma e-conomic, more than 300,000 businesses rely on our software to run their operations every day. Within e-conomic, The Business Hub serves as our dedicated value creation engine for a fast-moving portfolio of distinct products. Each product arrives with its own history and potential, and the Hub is where that potential is turned into lasting, sustainable growth in a market rapidly reshaped by AI and evolving business models.

Rackbeat is a core part of this portfolio. We develop and run a modern cloud inventory and warehouse management platform built for small and mid-sized businesses across the Nordics. Having recently navigated a key stabilization phase, Rackbeat is entering its next growth chapter within the Hub, with a clear ambition to be the inventory system businesses trust: simple to start with, strong enough to grow with.

We are looking for a Product Engineering Manager to head the Rackbeat product and engineering team. Reporting directly to the Director of Product and Engineering of the Business Hub, you will translate strategic business goals into clear execution, nurture a healthy engineering culture, and champion the adoption of AI across our platform and daily workflows.

The Team & Environment

You will operate with the speed and autonomy of a focused product unit, backed by the stability, resources, and career pathways of e-conomic and Visma. Rackbeat owns its entire product end-to-end: web application, mobile apps, integrations, and cloud infrastructure.
You will lead an integrated, cross-functional team of 11 specialists:

  • Product & Design: 2 Product Managers, 1 UX Designer

  • Engineering: 1 Tech Lead, 4 Developers, 2 Mobile Developers

  • Quality: 1 QA Engineer

Key Responsibilities

  • People Leadership: Conduct regular 1:1s, support individual career growth, give candid feedback, and manage hiring to keep the team engaged and motivated.

  • Delivery Operations: Establish a predictable planning rhythm across web and mobile releases, keeping commitments realistic and stakeholders informed.

  • Architecture & Quality: Partner with the Tech Lead and QA to evaluate technical trade-offs, manage technical debt pragmatically, and uphold Visma security standards.

  • Product Alignment: Work with Product Managers and UX to ensure development priorities directly address customer pain points and business objectives.

  • AI Adoption: Guide the practical adoption of AI tools within development routines and assess strategic AI opportunities inside the product.

  • Ecosystem Collaboration: Maintain constructive relationships with e-conomic platform teams, integration partners, and external vendors.

Why this is unique

  • Full Product Ownership with Commercial Partnership: Drive the entire product vision, strategy, and execution for an end-to-end SaaS business. Rather than managing a siloed feature slice in a corporate machine, you will lead the complete product organization in close lockstep with the Commercial Director to turn platform capability into scalable revenue.

  • Ideal Timing: Join at the start of a new chapter right after stabilization, with direct influence on technical strategy and execution methods.

  • Speed Meets Stability: Enjoy the autonomy and tight feedback loops of a startup-style unit, supported by the security, peer network, and career pathways of Visma.

  • Active Leadership Support: Step into a management position supported by structured executive training and leadership programs.

What you bring

  • Engineering Management Experience: Proven track record leading software teams with direct people management responsibilities (performance reviews, career coaching, and team dynamics).

  • Software Development Background: Solid foundational experience as a developer, enabling you to hold credible architectural discussions, evaluate technical risks, and balance speed against debt.

  • Production SaaS Track Record: Experience shipping and running live cloud software, including incident management, release hygiene, and quality control. Exposure to our tech stack (PHP, Laravel, AWS, Git, Mobile) is an advantage.

  • Cross-Functional Fluency: Skilled at collaborating with product, design, and commercial stakeholders to turn business problems into executable roadmaps.

  • Curiosity for AI: Practical interest in AI fundamentals and active experience leveraging AI tools in modern software environments.

  • Language Skills: Professional working proficiency in English (daily team language). Danish is a bonus, but not required.

Your e-conomic benefits

🦋 Flexible Work Life: Adapt your work environment and hours to suit your lifestyle, with hybrid options available.

🤧 Family First: Unlimited child sick days.

🌍 Global Vibes: An international workplace with +30 nationalities.

💆🏻‍♀️ Well-being: Access a range of services to support your physical and mental health.

🏥 Security: Comprehensive health insurance and company-paid pension.

👩‍💻 Tech Choice: Select your preferred gear, be it Mac or Windows.

🏬 Prime Location: Located in Carlsberg Byen, equipped with the latest facilities.

The recruitment process

If this role aligns with your career aspirations, please submit your CV and answer the application questions below, no cover letter or personal details are required. Please check your inbox and spam folder for a confirmation email.

First, hit that apply button and let's kickstart your e-conomic experience!

The Interview Process

Applications are reviewed continuously, and we invite candidates for interviews as we go.

  1. Initial screening: Initial chat to learn more about your motivation and align on expectations together with Juliette Guillemaille, Talent Acquisition Partner. Duration: ~20-30min.

  2. 1st interview: Meet with Mark Kevings, Hiring Manager, Director of Product and Engineering of the Business Hub, to discuss your leadership philosophy, technical background, and get to know the role and team context in depth. Duration: ~45–60 min.

  3. 2nd interview & Case presentation: You will receive a leadership and delivery case study in advance, along with personality and ability assessments. This session includes an interactive case discussion with the team as well as test feedback facilitated by Juliette Guillemaille, Talent Acquisition Partner. Total prep time: ~4 hours | Interview duration: ~120 min.

If all interviews align, we follow up with short reference calls before presenting an offer.

Got questions?

Reach out to Mark Kevings (Hiring Manager) at mark.kevings@visma.com or Juliette Guillemaille (Talent Acquisition Partner) at juliette.guillemaille@visma.com

title: UI/UX and Full Stack Engineering Manager
description:
Job Title: UI/UX and Full Stack Engineering Manager
Location: 100% Remote (India Based Only)
Hiring Manager: Director of Engineering
Estimated salary range: INR 6,000,000 to INR 7,500,000
  • The salary offered for this position will be based on a candidate’s experience and skill demonstrated during interviews and other evaluations

Position Overview:
The Engineering Manager, UI/UX & Full-Stack leads a team of UI/UX and full-stack engineers at Ocient, responsible for end-to-end web engineering delivery (front-end experiences, REST APIs, and back-end services in Java or C++), team development, and cross-functional product alignment across Ocient’s product surface areas. This player/coach role balances hands-on technical engagement with people management — setting team direction, developing engineering talent, and ensuring the team delivers high-quality, scalable product experiences with technical rigor and strong design partnership. This manager champions AI-assisted engineering, setting the standard for how the team uses AI tools and coding agents (Claude) across architecture, design, development, and workflow management. The Engineering Manager, UI/UX & Full-Stack is a trusted technical and organizational partner to Product, Design, and Engineering leadership, and a champion for web engineering excellence at Ocient.

Responsibilities:
  • Lead and manage a team of UI/UX and full-stack engineers, supporting individual career goals through regular 1:1s, performance evaluations, and structured technical development planning.
  • Own the full-stack engineering delivery model for assigned product areas, ensuring consistent, high-quality implementation from UI through API and back-end services across Ocient’s product surface.
  • Drive front-end and API architecture, coding standards, REST API contract design, and design system governance in close partnership with Staff and Senior engineers, engaging hands-on with the most complex engineering challenges.
  • Partner with Product Management and Design to define UI/UX requirements, align on product direction, and deliver product experiences that meet customer needs and business goals.
  • Drive adoption of AI-assisted development across the team, establishing practices, structured prompts, and context files for using AI tools and coding agents (Claude) to improve efficiency and quality in architecture, design, development, and workflow management.
  • Identify, communicate, and manage technical risk on large, complex full-stack initiatives, balancing quality, velocity, and long-term maintainability.
  • Hire, onboard, and develop UI/UX and full-stack engineering talent, building a high-performing, technically rigorous engineering team.
  • Provide regular engineering health, delivery, and product quality reporting to senior Engineering and Product leadership.

Ideal Qualifications:
Experience:
  • 7+ years of UI/UX, front-end, or full-stack engineering experience with at least 2 years of direct engineering management experience leading front-end or full-stack engineers.
  • Demonstrated track record of leading front-end or full-stack engineering delivery for complex, data-intensive enterprise software products.
Functional/Technical Skills:
  • Expert proficiency in TypeScript and React.js with the technical depth to engage meaningfully in front-end architecture and code quality discussions, and working knowledge of back-end development in Java or C++ sufficient to guide architecture and code reviews across the stack.
  • Demonstrable experience using AI tools and agents to produce quality designs and software using structured prompts and context files, and guiding a team in adopting these practices effectively.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
The Senior UX/UI Designer is the team's strongest executor and a rising strategic voice — someone who takes the Manager's direction and vision and turns it into exceptional, well-reasoned design outcomes. While the Manager owns strategy and prioritization, the Senior Designer owns the craft: leading complex projects with confidence, raising the quality bar for the whole team, and proactively identifying opportunities to improve the digital experience. This role applies AI-assisted methods to complex product-design challenges and helps explore AI-enabled experiences through rapid, testable prototypes. At a growing company like Brightspeed, this person is a force multiplier — someone who elevates every designer around them simply by how they work.

IMPACT

Execution & Craft

  • Own complex UX/UI design projects end-to-end, from discovery and wireframing through high-fidelity delivery and developer handoff, across the website, eCommerce experience, and customer account platform.

  • Set the quality standard for the team's output, demonstrating what excellent design looks like at every level of fidelity.

  • Make well-reasoned trade-offs between speed, quality, and scope, and communicate those decisions clearly to the Manager and stakeholders.

  • Produce meticulous, well-organized Figma files that are easy for the team to build on and maintain.

Strategic Contribution

  • Translate the Manager's strategic direction into concrete design approaches, proactively filling in the gaps between high-level goals and execution details.

  • Identify appropriate opportunities for AI-enabled experiences and use AI-assisted or agent-building tools to create and evaluate prototypes in partnership with product, content, and engineering.

  • Bring forward well-developed, data-informed design recommendations, not just solutions, but the reasoning behind them.

  • Partner with analysts, product owners, and strategists to interpret data, identify experience gaps, and propose design-led improvements.

  • Stay ahead of industry trends in UX, UI, and eCommerce design, and introduce relevant ideas to the team.

Team Elevation

  • Actively raise the craft of the team through thoughtful critique, generous knowledge-sharing, and modeling strong design thinking.

  • Provide clear, constructive feedback to junior designers, helping them grow without undermining their ownership.

  • Contribute to a team culture where curiosity, quality, and collaboration are the norm.

Research & Validation

  • Plan and facilitate usability testing, design reviews, and research sessions, synthesizing findings into clear, actionable recommendations.

  • Champion user-centered decision-making across the team and with cross-functional partners.

May perform other duties as assigned.

YOU WILL THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU

  • Hold a bachelor’s degree in design, UX, HCI, or a related field.

  • Bring 5+ years of experience in UX/UI design, with a portfolio that demonstrates both strategic thinking and exceptional craft across complex digital products.

  • Are genuinely invested in the growth of the people around you and bring a collaborative, low-ego energy to the team.

A PLUS IF YOU HAVE

  • Experience in eCommerce, telecommunications, or other high-volume digital consumer products.

  • Familiarity with front-end development workflows and developer handoff best practices.

English required. Bilingual (Spanish) a plus.

Work is primarily sedentary, performed indoors from a home or company office while operating a computer and standard office productivity tools. Occasional additional hours may be required to meet project deadlines.

title: Investment Director - Public Infrastructure
company: Impact Fund Denmark (tidl. Investeringsfonden for Udviklingslande)
description:
Public Infrastructure, is Denmark’s primary instrument for supporting large‑scale public infrastructure in developing countries. Fully integrated into Impact Fund Denmark, it remains a central component of Denmark’s development cooperation under the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Danida).

High‑quality infrastructure is essential for sustainable and inclusive economic and social development. Yet in many low‑ and middle‑income countries, project preparation and access to capital are limited. Public Infrastructure addresses this gap by providing concessional financing and technical expertise for non‑commercial public infrastructure projects in emerging markets and fragile states. Through this work, it contributes to the UN 2030 Agenda, the Sustainable Development Goals, and Denmark’s development strategy.

Public Infrastructure supports projects across the full lifecycle - from early project definition and feasibility, through construction, to handover and monitoring of development results for up to five years after completion.

The Role

We are seeking an Investment Director with deep insight and a well-developed understanding of the possibilities, trends and instruments with concessional or blended finance, e.g. from multilateral development banks, EU or other institutions with a development mandate in concessional or blended finance. The role requires mastery of the full investment processes for public infrastructure projects, including financial analysis and structuring, assessment of development and climate impact, ESG evaluation, legal review, project scoping, due diligence, and negotiation of agreements.

The Investment Director will carry out deal sourcing, networking, management of all key aspects of the investment process, including financial analysis and structuring, development, and climate impact, environmental, social and governance, legal, scoping and carrying through due diligence, negotiating agreements. Furthermore, the Investment Director will undertake management of portfolio through project development, feasibility, design and tendering.

The Team

The Public Infrastructure team consists of 10 colleagues that are based in Copenhagen, Johannesburg and Nairobi. The open position is a replacement for a colleague that is retiring at the end of the year, and will be based at our Headquarter in Copenhagen.

Qualifications & demonstrated capabilities

  • Minimum 15+ years of relevant experience

  • Possess a university degree in a relevant field, for example in Economics or Finance

  • Strong understanding of concessional and blended finance instruments from MDBs, the EU, and similar institutions

  • Proven ability to manage all aspects of the public infrastructure investment process, including financial analysis, structuring, climate and development impact, ESG, legal review, due diligence, and negotiations

  • Deal sourcing and networking with various stakeholders.

  • Management of all key aspects of the investment process, including financial analysis and structuring, development, and climate impact, environmental, social and governance, legal, scoping and carrying through due diligence, negotiating agreements.

  • Management of portfolio through project development, feasibility, design and tendering.

  • Capacity to work independently, lead processes and project teams on your own and be a resource for others/ mentor others through challenging decision-making processes.

  • Operational experience with managing infrastructure projects, e.g. water and sanitation, waste, energy or other.

  • Successful project management with demonstrated ability to drive things forward in an often complex and political environment. The right candidate demonstrates patience, drive, pro-activity, and great structure.

  • Effective and timely dialogue with relevant stakeholders.

  • Professional sourcing and management of external consultants.

  • Demonstrates precise and high-quality business writing.

Your application

Please submit your application as soon as possible and no later than 29 November. We conduct interviews on a rolling basis.

title: Casting Finisher - 3rd Shift
description:
Function Summary

Help Prepare Quality Castings for Production

As a Casting Finisher, you'll play an important role in preparing cast products for the next stage of production. This hands-on position focuses on grinding, cleaning, finishing, and staging castings while supporting safe and efficient manufacturing operations.

We're looking for someone who enjoys physical, hands-on work, takes pride in quality craftsmanship, and is committed to safety in a manufacturing environment.

What You'll Do

Prepare & Finish Castings

  • Follow direction provided by the Floor Supervisor or designee.
  • Prepare products for processing by grinding and cleaning castings according to established instructions.
  • Remove castings from molds and shake out excess material from mold castings.
  • Utilize burning torches and air arc equipment to reduce material to the appropriate size.
  • Operate Roto Blast equipment to remove debris from products while wearing required personal protective equipment.

Move Materials & Support Production

  • Operate material handling equipment to move products to appropriate processing areas.
  • Stage finished products and remove material from staging areas as needed.
  • Remove unwanted materials from work areas and transport them to designated disposal locations.
  • Maintain and record process-related data and documentation.

Support Lean Manufacturing & Workplace Organization

  • Participate in 5S and Lean Manufacturing initiatives as assigned.
  • Help maintain an organized and efficient work environment.
  • Follow established procedures to ensure quality and consistency throughout the finishing process.

Promote Safety & Teamwork

  • Maintain a safe working environment by following all company safety policies and procedures, including the use of required personal protective equipment.
  • Communicate professionally and effectively with coworkers, management, customers, and others.
  • Represent McLanahan Corporation positively while supporting the company's core values.
  • Be available to work assigned shifts and overtime as needed.
  • Work safely in a high-temperature manufacturing environment.

What You'll Bring

Education & Experience

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Three (3) years of experience working in a manufacturing environment.
  • Experience reading and interpreting blueprints and engineering drawings.
  • Prior experience working in a Lean or ISO environment.
  • Strong math and analytical skills.

Skills & Qualifications

  • Computer literacy, primarily for attendance and job tracking.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to use experience and judgment to plan and accomplish goals.
  • Ability to work successfully in an environment requiring flexibility, initiative, and independent decision-making.

Physical Requirements

This position is based in a manufacturing environment and requires sitting and standing for extended periods. The role requires good hand-eye coordination, arm, hand, and finger dexterity, including the ability to grasp, lift, carry, move, and maneuver materials as assigned. Employees must be able to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing, and may be required to travel domestically.

The physical demands described are representative of those required to successfully perform the essential functions of the position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

Additional Information

This job description outlines the primary duties and responsibilities of the position but is not intended to be all-inclusive. Additional duties may be assigned as needed based on business needs and management direction. Responsibilities and requirements may change at any time.
