title: AI Solutions Architect
description:
AI Solution Architect

Hybrid, London Location

Help shape the future of AI at Premium Credit

At Premium Credit, we’re investing in AI to create better experiences, improve how we work and unlock meaningful value across our business. We’re now looking for an AI Solution Architect to provide the technical leadership that will turn ambitious ideas into secure, scalable and production-ready solutions.

This is a high-impact opportunity for someone who can operate confidently between architecture and engineering. You’ll define the technical approach for our AI solutions, establish reusable standards and patterns, and work hands-on with teams to solve complex problems.

The role

Working closely with our Head of AI Delivery and colleagues across Technology, Data, Architecture, Security and the wider business, you’ll translate AI opportunities into robust technical solutions that deliver measurable outcomes.

You’ll help us move AI initiatives from concept to production at pace—balancing rapid experimentation with the engineering discipline required in a regulated organisation.

What you’ll be doing

Solution architecture and delivery

· Shape AI solutions from concept to production, translating business opportunities into practical designs and selecting the right mix of generative AI, machine learning, automation and emerging technologies.

· Design secure, scalable and maintainable solutions that integrate with our systems, data platforms and wider technology architecture.

AI engineering expertise

· Provide hands-on guidance across LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation, AI agents and orchestration patterns, including proofs of concept, prototyping and complex problem-solving.

· Establish reusable architecture patterns, engineering standards and development practices that help teams deliver consistently and at pace.

Governance and collaboration

· Build responsible AI, data privacy, security, explainability, monitoring and human oversight into every solution.

· Guide internal teams and third-party partners, helping to build lasting AI capability across PCL.

What we’re looking for

You’ll combine strong technical depth with a pragmatic approach to delivery. You’ll be curious about emerging AI technologies, but disciplined in applying them only where they can solve a genuine business problem or create measurable value.

You’ll bring:

Architecture and AI delivery

· Experience designing and delivering enterprise technology solutions, including practical AI, machine learning or generative AI use cases.

· Strong knowledge of modern AI architectures, including LLM-based solutions, RAG, prompt engineering, agentic workflows and model evaluation.

Cloud and engineering

· A strong understanding of APIs, systems integration and cloud architecture, ideally within the Microsoft Azure ecosystem.

· Knowledge of source control, CI/CD, testing and deployment, combined with strong technical problem-solving and architectural decision-making.

Communication and influence

· The ability to make complex technical concepts clear to technical and non-technical audiences.

· A collaborative style, with the confidence to influence senior stakeholders and challenge decisions constructively.

Experience within financial services or another regulated industry would be advantageous, as would knowledge of MLOps or LLMOps, AI monitoring, responsible AI and model risk management.

Why Premium Credit?

Premium Credit is one of the UK and Ireland’s leading providers of premium finance. We’re a business where technology, innovation and customer outcomes come together—and where talented people can make a visible impact. With over 3 million customers and a network of more than 3,000 partners, we are an ambitious company. We have a Glassdoor rating of 4.2 and are certified as a Great Place to Work, as well as holding a silver sustainability award from EcoVadis.

If you’re excited by the opportunity to shape enterprise AI architecture, influence how AI is delivered and build solutions that move beyond experimentation into genuine business impact, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now and help us build the next generation of AI capability at Premium Credit.

We’re committed to providing reasonable adjustments or accommodations for applicants, so if you need assistance or support during the recruitment process, please let us know on the application form or by emailing recruitment@pcl.co.uk.

If you’re made an offer of employment, you’ll be required to prove your eligibility to work in the UK before you start work. You must reside in the UK from the start date of this role; unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship at this time.

Premium Credit is an equal opportunities employer with a strong and passionate commitment to Diversity, Equality and Inclusion in the workplace. We welcome applications from all sections of the community and encourage people from all backgrounds to apply. Equal opportunities are the only acceptable way to conduct business, and we believe that the more inclusive our environments are, the better our work will be. We are open to part-time working and job share.

By submitting your application, you agree that Premium Credit may collect your personal data for recruiting and related purposes. To view our Privacy Notice, please go to:

All postholders will be subject to appropriate pre-employment vetting procedures and a satisfactory Disclosure & Barring Service (DBS) check prior to appointment.

Essential Job Functions

E Assist with the installation, repair, and maintenance of residential electrical systems in full support of safety, operations, and productivity initiatives.

E Use industry related hand tools and power tools, under supervision.

E Assist the Electrician with measuring, cutting, bending, threading, and installing wire and electrical cable systems, conduit systems and other wire raceway systems.

Must be currently enrolled or working on enrollment in an approved Apprentice program. Knowledge of electrical theory, basic circuits, branch circuits, and specialty systems. Willing to travel within the following counties King, Snohomish, Pierce, Thurston, Kitsap, Mason, Jefferson, Island (travel may occur within other counties).

Oncor Electric Delivery Company LLC, headquartered in Dallas, is a regulated electricity transmission and distribution business that uses superior asset management skills to provide reliable electricity delivery to consumers. Oncor (together with its subsidiaries) operates the largest transmission and distribution system in Texas, delivering power to nearly 4 million homes and businesses and operating more than 145,000 miles of transmission and distribution lines in Texas.

Summary

Responsible for ensuring the safety of technology platforms including workstations, server systems, networks, applications, databases, electronic information, and protecting systems from security violations, access, or destruction. Assists with the implementation of Information Technology security policies covering protocols, applications, networks, client and server systems, personnel, and other risk‑management mechanisms.

title: Legal Officer
description:
About the Client

Our client provides crypto payment and business wallet services for companies. Its services support payment acceptance, asset management and exchange across international markets.

Role Overview

Take ownership of varied legal work in a growing payments business. You will help turn regulatory requirements into workable policies, resolve complex partner queries and support expansion across jurisdictions. The role offers autonomy and close collaboration with the Head of Legal.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own day-to-day legal work across jurisdictions within your assigned areas, alongside the Head of Legal, who retains overall legal strategy and shareholder communication.
  • Draft, review and negotiate commercial agreements, including redlines from banks, payment partners and service providers.
  • Drive licensing projects across jurisdictions by analysing requirements, building regulatory frameworks and translating them into internal policies.
  • Serve as the first legal contact for banks and partners on matters such as blocked payments. Resolve legal issues and route compliance or financial monitoring matters to the responsible teams.
  • Answer basic AML and financial monitoring questions independently where appropriate.
  • Find practical solutions to non-standard legal and regulatory issues involving fiat payments and virtual assets.
  • Travel regularly within the EU for regulatory inspections, team meetings and offsite events.

Requirements

  • Proven in-house legal experience in fintech or payments, preferably in a high-risk segment.
  • Experience supporting licensing processes with regulators in a business operating across several jurisdictions.
  • Working knowledge of fiat payment services regulation and crypto and virtual asset regulation, including the differences between these regimes.
  • Practical knowledge of AML/CTF and financial monitoring, with the ability to distinguish legal questions from compliance matters.
  • Hands-on experience negotiating commercial contracts with banks, payment providers and other counterparties.
  • Native or fluent Russian.
  • Ability to travel regularly within the EU without restrictions.
  • Languages: English , Russian .

Key Soft Skills

  • Independence, ownership and accountability.
  • Ability to learn quickly and build context without detailed guidance.
  • Sound judgment and risk-based thinking.

title: Head of Site Production & Logistics
description:
Vil du stå i spidsen for pladsproduktion og logistik på tværs af nogle af Danmarks største festivaler?

DTD Group står bag nogle af Danmarks største festivaler – NorthSide, Tinderbox og Fyrfest – samt DTD Concerts. Vi er en del af en international sammenslutning med over 80 festivaler i Europa og Australien, og vi søger lige nu en erfaren og relationsstærk leder til at stå i spidsen for vores pladsproduktion og interne logistik på tværs af vores arrangementer.

Som Head of Site Production & Logistics får du en central lederrolle med ansvar for medarbejdere, leverandørsamarbejder, budgetter og komplekse produktionsprocesser. Samtidig bliver du en del af vores operationelle ansvarsgruppe, hvor forskellige fagligheder arbejder sammen om at udvikle organisationen og sikre sammenhæng, kommunikation og velfungerende processer på tværs.

Om rollen

Du får det overordnede ansvar for et område, der omfatter en række forskellige fagligheder – herunder lager og logistik, pladsproduktion, el, VVS og IT-infrastruktur på festivalpladserne.

Du bliver leder for et team bestående af bl.a. Production Managers, en Warehouse Manager og øvrige medarbejdere og projektansatte, som sammen med dig sikrer planlægning og gennemførelse af vores produktioner. En vigtig del af din opgave bliver at sætte retning, udvikle teamets kompetencer og skabe tydelige rammer for både selvstændigt ansvar og tæt samarbejde.

Du får ansvar for områdets samlede organisering, økonomi og udvikling. Du skal kunne bevare det strategiske overblik, forstå og udføre de operationelle behov og sikre fremdrift gennem et stærkt samarbejde på tværs af fagligheder, afdelinger og eksterne leverandører.

Dine primære ansvarsområder

Personaleledelse og organisatorisk udvikling

  • Lede, sparre med og udvikle områdets managers og øvrige medarbejdere og projektansatte.
  • Skabe tydelige rammer, ansvarsfordeling og gode forudsætninger for, at teamet kan lykkes.
  • Udvikle områdets organisering, arbejdsgange og kompetencer.
  • Bidrage aktivt til organisationens samlede udvikling og tværfaglige samarbejde som en del af den operationelle ansvarsgruppe.

Produktionsstyring og tværgående projektledelse

  • Overordnet ansvar for pladsproduktion på tværs af arrangementer.
  • Sikre kvalitet, effektivitet, koordinering og fremdrift på tværs af fagområder som site, el, VVS og IT.
  • Lede komplekse, tværfaglige projekter og sikre sammenhæng mellem produktion, øvrige afdelinger og eksterne samarbejdspartnere.

Økonomi og leverandørsamarbejder

  • Budgetansvar, økonomisk styring og opfølgning inden for eget område.
  • Forhandle og indgå aftaler med leverandører samt sikre kvalitet og økonomisk ansvarlighed i samarbejdet.
  • Udvikle og vedligeholde stærke og langsigtede leverandørrelationer.

Intern logistik

  • Overordnet ansvar for den interne logistik i forbindelse med vores arrangementer.
  • Udvikle og optimere logistiske processer, der understøtter en effektiv og velfungerende produktion.

Din profil

Vi søger en erfaren leder med stærke kompetencer inden for personaleledelse og solid erfaring med tværfaglig projektledelse. Vi forventer ikke, at du er specialist inden for alle tekniske fagområder eller har erfaring fra festivalbranchen. Til gengæld skal du have erfaring med ledelse af komplekse projekter og en solid forståelse for de processer og afhængigheder, der kendetegner fysisk produktion.

Det afgørende for os er, at du formår at samle mennesker og fagligheder om fælles mål, tager ansvar for helheden og har viljen til at finde løsninger.

Vi lægger særligt vægt på, at du:

  • Har solid ledelseserfaring og motiveres af at udvikle både mennesker og organisation.
  • Er en stærk relationsskaber, der formår at opbygge tillid og sikre gode samarbejder internt såvel som eksternt.
  • Har erfaring med at lede komplekse, tværfaglige projekter med mange interessenter og afhængigheder.
  • Har økonomisk forståelse og erfaring med budgetter, kontrakter og leverandørstyring.
  • Arbejder struktureret, løsningsorienteret og har et stærkt organisatorisk overblik.
  • Er beslutningsdygtig og bevarer roen, når tempoet er højt, og planerne ændrer sig.
  • Har teknisk forståelse og interesse for de fagområder, du skal stå i spidsen for.
  • Kan arbejde både strategisk og operationelt og ikke er bange for at tage arbejdshandskerne på.

Hvorfor DTD Group?

Hos DTD Group får du mulighed for at sætte dit præg på produktionen bag nogle af Danmarks største musikoplevelser. Du bliver en del af en organisation med høje ambitioner, stærke fagligheder og en kultur, hvor samarbejde og handlekraft er afgørende for at lykkes.

Du får et stort selvstændigt ansvar og mulighed for at udvikle både mennesker, processer og løsninger på tværs af vores arrangementer. Som en del af vores operationelle ansvarsgruppe får du samtidig mulighed for at præge organisationens udvikling i tæt samarbejde med ledere fra andre fagområder.

Vi tilbyder en alsidig hverdag, hvor langsigtet planlægning møder praktisk eksekvering, og hvor resultatet af indsatsen kan opleves helt konkret, når festivalpladserne fyldes med mennesker.

Praktisk information og ansøgningsproces

Tiltrædelse: Hurtigst muligt.

Løn: Efter kvalifikationer og erfaring.

Arbejdssted: Egå

Ansøgningsfrist: 30. november 2026. Vi afholder samtaler løbende og opfordrer derfor interesserede kandidater til at søge hurtigst muligt.

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til Head of People & Culture Line Marie Bach via 'Ansøg'-knappen nederst.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte COO Flemming Myllerup på flemming@dtdgroup.dk.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

title: Welding Engineer
description:
Seeking a Highly Experienced Welding Engineer

Conax Technologies is seeking an experienced Welding Engineer with deep technical expertise in advanced welding, brazing, and joining technologies to support our manufacturing operations and drive continuous innovation. We are looking for a proven technical expert who has successfully developed, qualified, and optimized welding processes in a precision manufacturing environment.

The ideal candidate will bring experience in welding metallurgy, process development, welding procedure qualification, and manufacturing problem-solving, along with a passion for advancing welding technologies and mentoring others.

Position Summary

The Welding Engineer provides technical leadership in support of manufacturing operations with primary responsibility for welding and brazing processes, assembly operations, and manufacturing engineering initiatives. This individual will serve as a key technical resource for developing robust joining methods, improving production efficiency, solving complex manufacturing challenges, and ensuring compliance with customer and industry requirements.

What You'll Do

  • Lead welding engineering activities that support both day-to-day manufacturing operations and strategic business initiatives.
  • Develop, qualify, and optimize advanced welding and brazing processes for high-precision components.
  • Analyze welding process performance, troubleshoot defects, and implement corrective actions to improve quality and productivity.
  • Develop and maintain Weld Procedure Specifications (WPS), Procedure Qualification Records (PQRs), weld qualification reports, and manufacturing work instructions.
  • Evaluate and apply customer-specific and industry welding specifications and standards.
  • Provide technical training, mentorship, and guidance to manufacturing personnel, engineers, and customers.
  • Collaborate with Engineering, Quality, Operations, and customers to support new product introductions and process improvements.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on quality, throughput, reliability, and cost reduction.
  • Research, evaluate, and implement new joining technologies and manufacturing processes.

Required Experience

We are specifically seeking candidates with significant experience in:

  • Welding Engineering within a manufacturing environment
  • Welding Metallurgy and Materials Science
  • Stainless Steel Welding Metallurgy
  • Weld Procedure Development and Qualification
  • Manufacturing Process Development and Optimization
  • Root Cause Analysis and Corrective Actions
  • Welding Quality Systems and Documentation
  • Engineering Support for Production Operations

Experience with the following joining technologies is highly desired:

  • Gas Tungsten Arc Welding (GTAW/TIG)
  • Electron Beam Welding (EBW)
  • Laser Beam Welding (LBW)
  • Vacuum Furnace Brazing
  • Precision Brazing Processes

title: Charge Capture Specialist - Full Time Days - Non-Exempt
description:
Documentation Review & Charge Capture

  • Review provider clinical encounter notes, operative reports, bedside procedure logs, and diagnostic reports to verify that documentation is associated with billable services.
  • Cross-reference provider schedules, facility face sheets, and operative schedules against entered encounters to prevent missed charges, uncaptured revenue, and delayed billing.
  • Initiate formal provider queries when documentation is incomplete, illegible, ambiguous, or fails to substantiate the level of service or procedures rendered.

Charge Entry & Modifier Assignment

  • Enter, batch, and post professional and facility-level procedural charges (CPT/HCPCS Level II) and diagnostic codes (ICD-10-CM) into the practice management system within target turnaround times.
  • Ensure proper sequence of primary, secondary, and tertiary diagnosis pointers across all line-item charges.
  • Review and assign first-level anatomical and procedural modifiers based directly on chart documentation, including:
  1. Laterality & Anatomical Sites: RT (Right), LT (Left), 50 (Bilateral).
  2. Digits & Sub-sites: E1–E4 (Eyelids), FA–F9 (Fingers), TA–T9 (Toes).
  3. Distinct & Significant Procedures: 59, XE, XP, XS, XU (Distinct Procedural Services),

25 (Separately Identifiable Evaluation & Management), 76/77 (Repeat Procedures).

  1. Procedural Relationships: 51 (Multiple Procedures), 52/53 (Reduced/Discontinued Services), 22 (Increased Procedural Services). Appropriate distinction between diagnostic and screening procedures.

Work Queue & Pre-Bill Edit Resolution

  • Investigate and correct front-end billing rejections stemming from National Correct Coding Initiative (NCCI) Procedure-to-Procedure (PTP) edits, Medically Unlikely Edits (MUEs), and payer-specific medical necessity rules.
  • Collaborate with denial management and billing staff to identify recurring charge entry errors and update front-end workflows accordingly.

Compliance & Data Integrity

  • Adhere strictly to CMS, HIPAA, OIG, and commercial payer guidelines regarding unbundling, upcoding, and medical necessity.
  • Keep current on annual coding updates, specialty-specific billing regulations, and changes to local and national coverage determinations (LCDs/NCDs).
  • Participate in regular internal revenue cycle quality audits and meet established benchmarks for accuracy and volume.

title: Scientist l, Biologics Analytical R&D
description:
AbbVie Biologics Analytical Research & Development (Biologics Analytical R&D) at Irvine is an analytical sciences organization responsible for early-stage CMC analytical activities related to the development of AbbVie's biologics products. Careers in AbbVie Biologics Analytical R&D provide opportunities to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams to drive scientific understanding and innovative product development strategies. The biologics characterization group develops analytical techniques for in-depth characterization of biologics using separation and compendial techniques. We are looking for candidates with strong scientific experience to join the AbbVie Analytical R&D team and can offer exciting career opportunities for these candidates.

Responsibilities

The position requires the individual to work with and in areas requiring select agents access (i.e. Biosafety level 2 laboratories). Access to and use of select agents is regulated by federal policies. Therefore, the candidate must conduct all work activities in compliance with AbbVie internal and applicable regulatory requirements. title: Hjælper
description:
Stilling: Hjælper

Oprettet: 11-11-2026

Job start: Snarest muligt

Annoncenr: 176652
JobId: 190178

Arbejdssted: 4653 Karise

Køn:

MK

Kort beskrivelse

Socialpædagogisk ledsager søges til en kvinde i Karise

Jobbeskrivelse

Er du initiativrig og frisk på at tage med en kvinde ud til aktive oplevelser? Så tag et kig på denne annonce.

Engageret medarbejder søges til 24årig kvinde i Karise.

Om borger:
Hun har Downs, og hun bor på et bosted. Hun har verbalt sprog, men hendes ordforråd er begrænset. Hun stammer, og det er derfor vigtigt, at du giver hende tid til at svare og ikke afbryde. Hun holder af hygge og god mad, og kan have brug for guidning i det sunde madvalg.
Hun kan også lide at bevæge sig, men hun har brug for en som kan tage med, når hun skal ud på egen hånd.

Hun har brug for en socialpædagogisk ledsager, som kan støtte hende undervejs, når hun skal til aktiviteter ud af huset. Hun har brug for nogle gode planer at se frem til. Ledsager skal støtte hende i at fastholde hende i en aktivitet, motivere og tage initiativ til aktiviteter. Borger vil gerne mange ting, men er ikke den, som tager initiativet. Når I er afsted, vil du ligeledes støtte hende ved at minde hende om toiletbesøg og praktiske ting såsom, at om hun har husket at tage sit kort med.

Om opgaven:
Hun er bevilget 8 timer om måneden til ledsagelse. Ledsagelsen vil ca. finde sted 2 gange om måneden i weekender om formiddagen.
Du skal ledsage hende til aktiviteter udenfor hjemmet. Undervejs skal du minde hende om praktiske ting såsom toiletbesøg, og om hun har betalingskort med, støtte hende i at finde vej og guide i, om hun er relevant påklædt ift. vejret.

Hun vil gerne ud at cykle, gå en tur, tage ud at bowle, teater, eller andre gode oplevelser. Hjælperen må gerne komme med ideer til aktive oplevelser.

I kommer frem og tilbage til aktiviteterne med enten offentlig transport, Flextrafik, cykel eller gåben afhængigt af destinationen og afstanden dertil. Borger har en trehjulet cykel, som hun cykler på.

Du aftaler tidspunkter for ledsagelse med hendes værge. Første møde vil blive afholdt på bostedet, hvor der vil være en fra bostedet til stede under samtalen. Ledsagelsen vil foregå i weekender.

Om dig:
Vi søger dig, som er initiativrig, omsorgsfuld og god til at motivere og engagere til og i aktiviteter og er god til at guide. Vi søger en pædagog, ufaglært medarbejder eller en pædagogisk assistent med erfaring fra lignende stilling.

Vil du være vores nye kollega?

Så send en ansøgning via linket. Du skal have en profil på mit.duos.dk og være logget ind for at søge. Vi holder samtaler løbende, send derfor gerne din ansøgning med det samme. Tiltrædelse snarest muligt.

Har du yderligere spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte Ledsagelse og Omsorg på 3634 8128

Du bliver en del af en ambitiøs virksomhed med en masse engagerede medarbejdere. Du har en fast rådgiver, som du altid kan få sparring hos. Udenfor kontorets åbningstid er der altid en bemandet vagttelefon, så du er aldrig alene. Løn og pension i henhold til Landsoverenskomst for handicaphjælp i borgers eget hjem (minus BPA) indgået mellem FOA og Dansk Erhverv.

I DUOS hjælper vi mennesker i hverdagen, støtter dem i svære situationer og bidrager til deres trivsel og livskvalitet. Som en af Danmarks største og ældste velfærdsleverandører stræber vi efter at være til stede der, hvor behovet er. Vi kender betydningen af den rette empati og den rette faglige viden, og vi ved, at det er afgørende at sikre det rette match mellem medarbejder og borger, hvis vores ydelser skal have værdi.

Bemærk: Din ansøgning formidles gennem DUOS.

For at søge stillingen kræver det at du er oprettet i vores jobdatabase

Log ind hvis du allerede har en profil eller opret dig.

OBS: Du vil blive viderestillet til Mit DUOS platformen.

title: Shipping/RecClerk 1
description:
The shipping/Receiving Clerk is responsible for coordinating all shipping and receiving activities to ensure accurate and timely movement of materials, parts, and finished goods. This role includes preparing shipments, verifying incoming materials, maintaining inventory records, and supporting production needs in a fast-paced environment.

  • Transport raw materials and colors to and from the the production floor
  • move finished goods from Quality Control to the warehouse for stock or shipping
  • Transfer production from the production floor to the warehouse

Other Skills & Abilities

  • Must be reliable and punctual with consistent on-site attendance
  • Comfortable working in a fast paced, team-oriented environment

Company Overview

Precise Aerospace Manufacturing - precisemfg.com

Precise Aerospace Manufacturing Inc. (PAM), established in 1965, is a premier full-service supplier specializing in close-tolerance custom molding and machining for the aerospace, defense, medical, and electronic industries. With over five decades of experience, PAM offers expertise in injecting, compression, and transfer molded plastics, as well as CNC machining and value-added assembly.

The company maintains AS9100 and ISO 9001 certification, ensuring adherence to stringent quality standards. PAM is also approved by major OEMs and has been privileged to manufacture parts for the NASA Space Shuttle Program

Located in Yorba, Linda, California, Precise Aerospace Manufacturing is committed to delivering high-quality, precision-engineered solutions to meet the demanding requirements of its diverse clientele.

Pexco is a leading component supplier across a variety of industrial end markets and applications with production facilities in the US, Mexico, and Canada. The Company is primarily engaged in designing and manufacturing not only extruded plastic (commodity to high-performance) tubes and profiles through an expansive twelve-site footprint but also specializes in the injection molding of high-performance polymer parts. In addition, Pexco offers a wide range of differentiated, value-added services, including design, prototyping, die building, sub-assembly, fabrication and supply chain management. Moreover, Pexco has developed deep expertise in processing PTFE rod, tube, sheet, tape, and pipe, as well as in rubber extrusion serving the RV and other industries.

Pexco’s innovative products are utilized in fluid handling, electrical insulation, traffic safety, infrastructure, and lighting applications across aerospace & defense, medical, electronics & semiconductors, mobility, environmental testing, pharmaceuticals, food & beverage, and other high-growth end-markets. The Company sells directly to more than 2,000 customers, including OEMs and end-users, as well as through distribution in certain markets.

Pexco has built an industry-leading reputation through its focus on short-run products with rapid turnarounds, tight tolerances, material science expertise, and a high degree of operational complexity. The company has a proven track record of growing its core segments and entering attractive new verticals over time to gain an increased share of a $10 billion total addressable market.

title: Sr. People Analytics Analyst
description:
This role may be based in Sunnyvale, San Francisco, Carpinteria, New York City, Chicago, Detroit, Washington, D.C.,or Omaha.

At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.

This role will be part of the People Analytics organization within LinkedIn's Global Talent Organization. People Analytics enables better, faster, and more strategic workforce decisions through trusted data, scalable insights, and modern analytics platforms.

We are seeking a collaborative, process-minded Senior Data Governance Analyst to help operationalize LinkedIn's People Data Governance program. Reporting to the Senior Manager, People Data Governance, this role will work across the program's core areas, including the governance operating model, data certification, data quality, metadata and master data management, governance adoption, and governance automation and AI.

This individual will help turn governance strategy into consistent, repeatable, and well-documented practices. They will partner across People Analytics, HR Technology, Engineering, Legal, Privacy, Security, and business functions to help ensure that people data is trusted, well-defined, consistently used, and prepared to support reporting, analytics, and emerging AI use cases.

Responsibilities

  • Support the People Data Governance operating model by helping maintain clear data ownership, stewardship responsibilities, decision rights, and escalation paths.
  • Partner with data owners, data stewards, analytics teams, and technical partners to document and operationalize consistent governance processes.
  • Coordinate data certification activities, including defining certification requirements, documenting review criteria, tracking approvals, and maintaining certification records.
  • Help establish and maintain standards for trusted data products, certified metrics, business definitions, and approved data sources.
  • Support data quality processes by documenting rules, monitoring issues, coordinating remediation, and tracking quality improvements with business and technical partners.
  • Partner with stakeholders to identify the business impact of data quality issues and establish appropriate ownership and resolution plans.
  • Develop and maintain business glossaries, data dictionaries, metadata documentation, lineage information, ownership records, and related governance materials.
  • Support master and reference data management practices that improve the consistency and usability of people data across systems and reporting solutions.
  • Create repeatable governance workflows, templates, playbooks, standards, and documentation that enable teams to apply governance practices consistently.
  • Facilitate working sessions, governance reviews, decision forums, and stakeholder discussions across business and technical teams.
  • Support governance adoption through communications, training materials, office hours, onboarding resources, and change-management activities.
  • Track governance priorities, decisions, risks, dependencies, and action items, and provide clear updates to program leaders and stakeholders.
  • Partner with Legal, Privacy, Security, HR Technology, Engineering, and People Analytics teams to support responsible data access, usage, sharing, and retention practices.
  • Help assess governance requirements for analytics, machine learning, and AI use cases involving people data.
  • Support the development of governance automation, monitoring, and AI-enabled capabilities that improve the scalability and effectiveness of the program.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify governance processes, reduce manual work, and improve the experience of data owners, stewards, producers, and consumers.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Data Management, Business, Human Resources, Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in data governance, data management, data stewardship, data quality, metadata management, analytics, or a related discipline.
  • Experience supporting or implementing data governance operating models, standards, policies, processes, or controls.
  • Background documenting business definitions, data ownership, data lineage, data quality rules, or certification requirements.
  • Experience coordinating work across business, analytics, and technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to create process documentation, standards, templates, playbooks, or training materials.
  • Experience facilitating meetings, working sessions, or decision-making discussions with cross-functional partners.
  • Ability to organize and manage multiple priorities, dependencies, decisions, and follow-up items.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience delivering technical or analytics projects in a large, matrixed organization, preferably within HR, People Analytics, or workforce-related domains.
  • Hands-on experience with several of the following technologies (deep expertise in every tool is not required): SQL/T-SQL, Python, Alteryx, Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate, and Excel-based analytical solutions.
  • Experience with ETL processes and data pipelines, including data modeling, reporting and dashboard development, and data reconciliation and validation.
  • Experience with cloud-based data and analytics platforms such as Databricks, Azure, or similar ecosystems.
  • Familiarity with APIs and system integrations.
  • Demonstrated problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with a pragmatic, outcome-oriented approach.
  • Experience establishing data ownership and stewardship models in a large, complex, matrixed organization.
  • Experience with policy setting, including data standards, business rules definition, data access governance, privacy, security, retention, and responsible data-use practices.
  • Familiarity with data catalog, data quality, metadata management, data lineage, or master data management tools.
  • Working knowledge of SQL and HR systems, analytics, and reporting environments (e.g., Workday, Power BI, Visier, or similar) sufficient to partner effectively with technical teams.
  • Understanding of how upstream HR business processes affect downstream data quality, analytics, and AI outcomes.
  • Experience supporting data certification, certified metrics, semantic models, or governed reporting environments.
  • Experience working with sensitive, confidential, or regulated data.
  • Interest in using automation and AI to scale governance practices, and familiarity with AI data readiness concepts.
  • Demonstrated documentation, facilitation, and change management skills, with the ability to make governance concepts clear and practical for non-technical audiences.
  • Demonstrated stakeholder management, communication, and presentation skills, with the ability to influence without authority and drive adoption.
  • Experience working in Agile delivery models such as Scrum and Kanban.

How You Will Lead

You will lead through collaboration, organization, and influence. You will bring structure to complex governance work, help partners understand their responsibilities, and turn broad governance objectives into practical and repeatable processes.

You can communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences, facilitate alignment across teams, and document decisions and requirements in a way that supports consistent execution. You are comfortable working across multiple functions and helping teams balance data accessibility, quality, privacy, security, governance, and business needs.

Suggested Skills

  • Data Governance
  • Data Stewardship
  • Data Quality
  • Metadata Management
  • Master Data Management
  • People Analytics

title: YOUTH DEVELOPMENT REPRESENTATIVE
description:
General Job Information

Job Summary

The DC Department of Youth Rehabilitation Services (DYRS) mission is to improve public safety and give court-involved youth the opportunity to become more productive citizens by building on the strengths of youth and their families in the least restrictive, most homelike environment consistent with public safety.

DYRS is an agency tasked with providing holistic and therapeutic programs and services to adjudicated youth between the ages of 12-21 in the District of Columbia. It serves as the district’s cabinet level juvenile justice agency. DYRS administers detention, commitment, and aftercare services for youth held under its care in its secure facilities or residing in the DC community. The Youth Development Representative (YDR) position is in the Secured Programs Division, under the purview of the Deputy Director of Secured Programs with the DC Department of Youth Rehabilitation Services (DYRS)

Duties and Responsibilities

Provides for the day-to-day direct supervision and positive engagement of youth in the department's care and custody; is vigilant in the performance of assigned duties and is an integral part of a multi-disciplinary team endeavoring to rehabilitate and provide safe, secure, and humane treatment of youth in custody. Maintains ongoing visual contact with all youth under their supervision and engages the youth in a positive and developmentally appropriate manner. Transports youth to court and other varied locations; supervises recreational activities; maintains custody of youth in hospitals and medical clinics, and monitors living, dining, and educational areas, in an engaging and interactive manner, while assuring youth and staff safety.

During non-academic programming, serves as a role model to youth, leads and participates in recreation and group sessions with youth, and assists with the development of appropriate life and social skills. De-escalate conflicts, tensions, fights or other disturbances, and when necessary, physically restrains and imposes discipline of youth consistent with department policies and procedures. Documents report and officially enter incidents into the department's computerized information system and/or logbooks in the event of an incident and submit detailed written reports. Responsible for supervising and engaging youth through behavioral management programs that are implemented in the facility. As part of a team, evaluates youth on DYRS' behavior management and modification system, and participates with Youth Family Team meetings to provide input on youth's behavior and case planning. Performs other related duties as assigned.

Qualifications and Education

Successful completion of a full 4-year course of study in any field leading to a bachelor's degree, in an accredited college or university.

Or

Specialized experience must have equipped the applicant with the particular knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform successfully the duties of the position to be filled. To be creditable, applicants must have one (1) year of specialized experience equivalent to at least the next lower grade level in the line of progression.

Licenses and Certifications

Required to possess a valid driver’s license to operate a DC Government vehicle.

Working Conditions / Environment

Work is performed in a juvenile detention facility. Some degree of hazard may be present in working with high-risk youth in custody with histories of aggressive conduct and disruptive behavioral problems.

Other Significant Facts

Tour of Duty: Due to the nature of the responsibilities of this position, work hours are on a rotational basis to any of DYRS facilities, group homes, or service areas. This facility is a 24/7 operation. Shifts may vary. Rotational tour of work normally requiring rotation on each of three tours - AM, PM, Midnight - seven days per week, and holidays.

Pay Plan, Series and Grade: CS-0007-07

Collective Bargaining Unit: This position is a union position covered by Fraternal Order of Police (FOP) and may require the payment of an agency service fee through direct payroll deductions.

Promotion Potential: No known promotion potential

Duration of Appointment: Career Service Permanent

Position Designation: The incumbent of this position will be subject to enhanced suitability screening pursuant to Chapter 4 of DC Personnel Regulations, Suitability – Safety Sensitive.

The incumbent must be able to physically perform the basic life operational functions of walking, standing, bending, grasping, talking, repetitive motions, squatting, running, jumping and climbing; to carry or drag an individual (125 pounds, or more) a minimum of seventy-five (75) feet; and to fully perform DYRS approved restraint techniques and to apply restraining devices to aggressive and assaultive youth. The incumbent must have visual and hearing acuity to fully observe the behaviors and interactions of residents and other persons within the facility or during official travel and activities, and to effectively receive and transmit communications by two-way radios and telephones and be able to read and interpret written material and must possess effective written and oral communication skills.

A physical exam and physical assessment examination will be conducted during the pre-employment process to verify that the incumbent can meet the physical demand of the position.

A child Protection Registry clearance is also required.

In compliance with the Prison Rape Elimination Act (PREA), DYRS is required to employ adequate gender specific staff to carry out duties of the position. During each hiring cycle, DYRS will assess its current population of youth and staff to determine the current staffing needs and will hire accordingly. The specific duties that require gender specific staff are daily direct care responsibilities such as body searches and shower supervisions.

Essential Designation: This position has been designated as an essential employee position under the provisions of District Personnel Manual, Chapter 12. As such, your services may be required in emergency situations to perform crucial duties, i.e., snow removal, debris removal, transportation, shelter operations, food distribution, and communication. These duties may be performed when the government is closed or when most employees are dismissed early.

Residency Preference: When claiming residency preference, you are required, and must agree in writing, to maintain bona fide District Residency for a period of seven (7) consecutive years from the effective date of employment. You will be required to present documents (proofs) to show District residency, and failure to maintain bona-fide District residency for the seven-year (7-year) period will result in forfeiture of employment.

EEO Statement: The District of Columbia Government does not discriminate or retaliate in employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, family responsibilities, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, homeless status, disability, genetic information, age, membership in an employee organization, participation in a legally protected activity, parental status, matriculation, personal appearance, credit information, status as a victim or family member of a victim of domestic violence, sexual offense, or stalking, military service, or other non-merit factor.

title: Senior Analyst, Global Marketplace Network & Analytics – Veilance
description:
Department: Veilance

Reports to: Director, Global Marketplace - Veilance

Location: Vancouver BC

Your Opportunity at Arc’teryx:

As the Senior Analyst, Global Marketplace Network & Analytics - Veilance, you play a critical role in connecting data, commercial insights, and strategic planning to support global growth decisions across the business. Serving as the analytical engine behind the Global Marketplace function, you develop actionable recommendations that inform market prioritization, channel mix, network evolution, and overall business performance. Working closely with regional commercial teams and global functional partners, you help create a comprehensive view of the Veilance marketplace across retail, wholesale, and e-commerce. You also support Marketplace integration within the Innovation-to-Consumer (I2C) process, ensuring consumer, channel, and market insights are represented at key decision points throughout product creation and go-to-market planning. Through analytical rigor, strategic curiosity, and cross-functional collaboration, you transform data into decisions that drive alignment, support execution, and advance Veilance's long-term growth ambitions.

This role is based out of our North Vancouver office and is open to hybrid/remote work. Candidates must be eligible to work in Canada.

Meet Your Future Team:

The Veilance team is made up of innovative problem solvers who thrive on collaboration. Fueled by curiosity, we take an immersive approach to understanding future needs in city environment then design, test, and validate high‑end product solutions.

The Global Marketplace team defines global distribution strategies, sets commercial frameworks, and enables regions to execute with consistency, discipline, and brand integrity to drive sustainable business expansion.

If you were the Senior Analyst – Global Marketplace Veilance now, here are some of the core activities you could be doing:

1) Marketplace Analytics & Insights – 40%

  • Develop and maintain Global Marketplace dashboards, reporting tools, and scorecards across retail, wholesale, and e-commerce.
  • Consolidate data from multiple sources into a single marketplace view that supports planning and decision-making.
  • Deliver recurring performance reviews that identify opportunities, risks, and emerging trends across channels and regions.
  • Analyze channel productivity, distribution effectiveness, and commercial performance to generate actionable insights.
  • Translate complex datasets into executive-ready recommendations and business reviews.
  • Partner with regional and cross-functional teams to improve data quality, reporting consistency, and visibility.

2) Market Prioritization & Network Strategy – 30%

  • Analyze market, city, wholesale account, and Arc'teryx brand store performance to identify growth opportunities.
  • Support market prioritization through analysis of consumer demand, productivity, brand relevance, and competitive dynamics.
  • Evaluate distribution opportunities, channel expansion, and network evolution.
  • Assess channel mix and productivity across retail, wholesale, and e-commerce to identify optimization opportunities.
  • Support long-range planning and growth initiatives through data-driven recommendations.
  • Monitor progress against strategic objectives and highlight required actions.

3) Market Intelligence & Business Planning – 15%

  • Monitor competitor activity, consumer trends, channel developments, and market dynamics.
  • Gather and synthesize regional marketplace insights to develop a global perspective.
  • Support recommendations related to market prioritization, distribution strategy, and growth opportunities.
  • Build business cases, forecasts, and scenario models for strategic initiatives and investments.
  • Assess the impact of channel, distribution, and network changes on commercial performance.
  • Support annual planning, forecasting, and strategic decision-making.

4) Innovation-to-Consumer (I2C) Calendar Marketplace Integration – 15%

  • Represent Marketplace requirements and insights across key I2C milestones and decision points.
  • Connect marketplace intelligence, channel performance, and consumer insights.
  • Partner with PLM, Merchandising, Planning, Retail, E-Commerce, and Wholesale teams to improve cross-functional alignment and readiness.
  • Capture hindsight, commercial performance, and marketplace learnings to inform future seasonal.
  • Identify risks, opportunities, and key actions throughout the process to support successful execution.

Here are some of the things you could be working on in the future:

  • Developing predictive analytics and forecasting capabilities to support seasonal planning and long-term marketplace decisions.
  • Building market opportunity and prioritization frameworks to guide future expansion and investment decisions.
  • Creating channel productivity and profitability models across retail, wholesale, and e-commerce.
  • Supporting distribution and network optimization initiatives, including market, city, store, and account-level analysis.
  • Advancing Marketplace integration within the I2C process by establishing reporting standards, decision frameworks, and hindsight methodologies.

Are you our next Senior Analyst – Global Marketplace Veilance?

  • You have 3+ years of experience in business analytics, marketplace strategy, commercial planning, retail, wholesale, operations, or related fields.
  • You have experience translating complex data into actionable insights and strategic business recommendations.
  • You are proficient in Excel, Power BI or similar analytics tools.
  • You have experience with forecasting, scenario modeling, business case development, and performance analysis.
  • You have a strong understanding of retail, wholesale, and ecommerce performance drivers.
  • You have experience supporting commercial planning, market analysis, or strategic decision-making.
  • You are comfortable working cross-functionally in a matrix organization.
  • You have strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex information into clear recommendations and actions.
  • You are analytical, detail-oriented, and naturally curious, with the ability to identify opportunities, risks, and emerging trends.
  • You are comfortable operating in ambiguity and solving complex business problems.
  • You balance strategic thinking with strong execution, organization, and follow-through.
  • You are proactive in identifying root causes, solving problems, and driving continuous improvement.
  • You are collaborative and able to build relationships and influence stakeholders across multiple teams and levels.
  • You seek the best solutions, challenge assumptions, and demonstrate sound judgment in your decision-making.
  • You have a passion for marketplace strategy, consumer insights, network planning, and global growth opportunities.

Compensation:

The salary range for this role is CAD$ 82,000 - CAD$108,000

Total Rewards

Most new team members join between the start and midpoint of the range, where you can contribute right away while continuing to grow your craft, your collaborations, and your impact at Arc’teryx. This range reflects market alignment and the scope of the role. Individual pay is determined by your skills, experience, and level of responsibility.

We’re committed to fair, equitable, and competitive pay, reviewed regularly to ensure internal alignment and market relevance. Transparency is part of how we follow through on our commitments and how we honour the value you bring to our team.

In addition to base pay, Arc’teryx supports people through benefits designed to sustain both work and life:

  • Health & wellbeing - Extended health, dental, and vision coverage, including mental health support, fertility benefits, gender-affirming care and a 24/7 Employee Assistance Program (EAP).
  • Financial wellbeing - RRSP matching and eligibility for Arc'teryx Annual Incentive Plan and access to Employee Stock Purchase program (ESPP) where applicable.
  • Time & Flexibility - Paid time off, wellness time, and No Wasted Day program (dedicated paid days to get outside & explore).
  • Family support - Parental leave top-up and a nesting period for new parents.
  • Growth, community & gear - Professional development opportunities, Arc'teryx Academies (outdoor skill-building events), Employee Belonging Councils, and access to employee discounts and Pro Deals (exclusive discounted pricing on gear).

    *Eligibility for certain programs may vary by role.

Equal Opportunity

Arc’teryx is committed to actively creating and fostering a culture of inclusivity where voices are heard, people are seen, and values are respected. We care about the uniqueness of our applicants, employees, and guests, and we do so in a safe space fueled by curiosity and acceptance.

Creating an inclusive workplace is connected to our core value Do Right while also having the added benefit of helping make our business better. We believe inclusion helps us to create a healthier, happier workplace, drive creativity and innovation, and reflect the communities where we operate.

All applicants, employees, and guests can expect equality of opportunity and fair treatment in alignment with our values.

Leave it Better

We believe that the mountains transform us, that how we adventure matters, and that there’s always a better way.

Join us in creating positive change in ourselves, our communities, and the world.

Live it. Get out there - the mountains make us better
Disruptive evolution. In pursuit of better. Always.
Commit. We set bold objectives and see them through.

title: EXPERT TELECOM ENGINEER #00032858
description:
Hiring Department

Information Technology

The Information Technology Department supports administrative systems, academic technologies, and research computing. System reliability and campus operations are strengthened through IT initiatives. IT roles involve system support, infrastructure maintenance, and technical collaboration with campus units.

Job Description

Missouri S&T is seeking a skilled and customer-focused Network Technician to support, maintain, and troubleshoot the university's data, voice, wireless, and network infrastructure. The Network Technician plays a critical role in ensuring reliable connectivity for academic, research, administrative, and residential environments across campus.

This position is responsible for installing, configuring, testing, monitoring, and maintaining network equipment and cabling systems while providing technical support to faculty, staff, and students. The successful candidate will work closely with network engineers, IT staff, and campus stakeholders to ensure network services operate efficiently, securely, and reliably.

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot network hardware including switches, routers, wireless access points, and related equipment
  • Perform structured cabling installation, termination, testing, labeling, and documentation for copper and fiber-optic infrastructure
  • Monitor network performance and assist in identifying and resolving connectivity issues
  • Respond to service requests and incidents related to wired and wireless network services
  • Assist with network upgrades, equipment replacements, and infrastructure improvement projects
  • Maintain accurate records of network assets, configurations, and cabling documentation
  • Conduct routine inspections and preventive maintenance of network equipment
  • Support campus telecommunications and network services in academic, research, administrative, and residential facilities
  • Assist with troubleshooting DHCP, DNS, VLAN, TCP/IP, and wireless networking issues
  • Collaborate with cybersecurity and infrastructure teams to support university security standards and best practices
  • Provide technical assistance and excellent customer service to faculty, staff, students, and visitors
  • Participate in after-hours maintenance activities and emergency response efforts as necessary
  • Follow university safety practices and applicable industry standards

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Understanding of network infrastructure, telecommunications, and connectivity principles
  • Ability to read and interpret technical diagrams, network documentation, and cabling schematics
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities
  • Excellent organizational and documentation skills
  • Ability to prioritize multiple assignments and meet deadlines
  • Commitment to customer service and professionalism
  • Ability to learn new technologies and adapt to changing requirements

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to lift and carry equipment up to 50 pounds
  • Ability to work in telecommunications closets, data centers, and construction environments
  • Ability to climb ladders and work above ceilings when installing or troubleshooting cabling

Working Environment

This position operates in office, classroom, laboratory, residence hall, and outdoor campus environments. Work may occasionally require evening or weekend hours to support maintenance activities, emergency repairs, or campus events.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Associate degree in Information Technology, Computer Networking, Electronics Technology, or a related field; or an equivalent combination of education and experience
  • Experience installing, supporting, or maintaining network infrastructure in an enterprise environment

    • TCP/IP networking
    • Ethernet switching
    • Wireless networking technologies
    • Network cabling standards
    • Microsoft Windows systems
  • Ability to diagnose and resolve technical issues in a timely manner
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team environment

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related discipline
  • Experience supporting large-scale campus, educational, healthcare, or enterprise networks
  • Experience with:
    • Cisco networking equipment
    • Wireless network management systems
    • Fiber-optic infrastructure
    • Network monitoring and management tools
    • Structured cabling standards (TIA/EIA)
  • Industry certifications such as:
    • CompTIA Network+
    • Cisco Certified Support Technician (CCST)
    • Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA)
    • BICSI certifications

The anticipated hiring range for this position has been established as $60,944 to $86,632 annually.

Salary is determined by a variety of factors, including but not limited to, the individual’s particular combination of education, skills, and experience, as well as organizational requirements.

Join the Transformation of Catholic Education in Milwaukee
Seton Catholic Schools is a network of K-8 parish schools in Milwaukee. There are currently 15 schools serving 3,500 students in the network. • Be a model of exemplary character, self-esteem and self-discipline

title: Scientist
description:
Hiring Department

Life Sciences Center

Job Description

These two Scientist positions will be supported with the NIH funded grants and will involve investigating pathogenesis of tick-borne pathogens, such as in characterizing bacterial proteins for their roles in causing infections.

The studies involve molecular genetics, molecular biology, cell biology, and functional characterization of Ehrlichia chaffeensis genes and proteins involved in regulating the bacterial gene expression and those critical for the pathogen's intracellular survival in vivo and in vitro. Additional research goals include developing host cell-free bacterial replication of E. chaffeensis and Anaplasma phagocytophilum; both are tick-borne bacterial pathogens.

Shift

Monday-Friday, 8am-5pm with occasional evening/weekend work depending on experiment needs

Minimum Qualifications

A Bachelor's degree in related/ relevant area and at least 3 years of experience from which comparable knowledge and skills can be acquired is necessary

Preferred Qualifications

PhD or DVM/PhD in biological sciences or a related field, with research experience in areas such as molecular biology, molecular genetics, cell biology, or protein studies. Preference will be given to candidates with experience in one or more of the following: transposon and targeted mutagenesis, vaccine studies, bacterial genetics, immunological assessment, in vitro and in vivo research, and gene mapping.

title: Senior/Principal Systems Research & Analysis - Embedded Threat Analyst, Onsite
description:
About Sandia

Sandia National Laboratories is the nation’s premier science and engineering lab for national security and technology innovation, with teams of specialists focused on cutting-edge work in a broad array of areas. Some of the main reasons we love our jobs:

  • Challenging work with amazing impact that contributes to security, peace, and freedom worldwide
  • Extraordinary co-workers
  • Some of the best tools, equipment, and research facilities in the world
  • Career advancement and enrichment opportunities
  • Flexible work arrangements for many positions include 9/80 (work 80 hours every two weeks, with every other Friday off) and 4/10 (work 4 ten-hour days each week) compressed workweeks, part-time work, and telecommuting (a mix of onsite work and working from home)
  • Generous vacation, strong medical and other benefits, competitive 401k, learning opportunities, relocation assistance and amenities aimed at creating a solid work/life balance*

World-changing technologies. Life-changing careers. Learn more about Sandia at: http://www.sandia.gov


*These benefits vary by job classification.

What Your Job Will Be Like

Sandia National Laboratories is seeking an experienced Embedded Threat Analyst with an entrepreneurial spirit. As the geopolitical landscape increases in complexity, there is an increased need to embed threat analysts within Sandia's mission programs to ensure the mission is met. The Embedded Threat Analyst will be responsible for conducting analysis of intelligence data from multiple sources to support technical programs across a wide array of scientific disciplines.

The ideal candidate will possess proficiency with all-source analytic disciplines and tradecraft, with a proven track record of delivering timely, high-quality intelligence products and briefings to technical staff. Additionally, the ideal candidate will find exciting the need to flow between a variety of scientific disciplines and technical programs, hopping between both technical topics and different team structures and workflows.

On any given day, you may be called on to:

  • Conduct comprehensive all-source intelligence analysis on technical topics in response to requests from technical staff, synthesizing information from multiple intelligence (INT) sources into clear, actionable analytic messages aligned with customer requirements.
  • Identify trends, patterns, and anomalies in data to provide actionable intelligence insights.
  • Assess the quality and relevance of intelligence information, ensuring credibility, reliability, and alignment with customer needs.
  • Apply U.S. Intelligence Community (IC) tradecraft standards in all aspects of all-source analytic work.
  • Understand and tailor intelligence products to meet the specific needs, scope, focus, and delivery preferences of end-users.
  • Work collaboratively with cross-functional teams, including non-intelligence personnel such as technical experts, scientists, and technologists, fostering a culture of teamwork and shared objectives.
  • Navigate ambiguity in tasking by effectively communicating to clarify requirements and deliverables.
  • Participate in joint analysis efforts, contributing expertise and insights to enhance overall intelligence products.
  • Integrate technical subject matter expertise from multiple experts into intelligence products designed for non-technical audiences.
  • Independently produce clear, concise, and well-structured written analytical reports and assessments tailored to the needs of Sandia's technical staff.
  • Ensure all written products comply with established standards and are delivered within specified timelines.
  • Prepare and deliver high-quality briefings that effectively communicate complex technical information in an accessible manner.
  • Engage with customers to clarify requirements and ensure their intelligence needs are fully met.
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and methodologies in intelligence analysis, actively pursuing professional development opportunities.
  • Demonstrate the ability to learn and maintain knowledge of new and evolving technical areas.
  • Contribute to the development and refinement of analytical tools, processes, and best practices.

Applicants on this requisition may be interviewed by multiple organizations at Sandia National Laboratories.

Due to the nature of the work, the selected applicant must be able to work onsite.

Salary Range

$117,500 - $235,700

*Salary range is estimated, and actual salary will be determined after consideration of the selected candidate's experience and qualifications, and application of any approved geographic salary differential.

Qualifications We Require

  • A Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline and five (5) years of directly relevant experience, or an equivalent combination of directly relevant education and engineering or scientific experience that demonstrates the knowledge, skills, and ability to perform independent research and development.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a DOE Q and SCI clearance which may require a polygraph test.

Qualifications We Desire

The ideal R&D S&E, Systems Research and Analysis candidate for Sandia National Laboratories will in addition possess the following:

  • Graduate degree in a highly related field where an independent research project was a graduation requirement (e.g., independent project, thesis, or dissertation).
  • The ability to understand, synthesize, and draw insights from multiple types of data streams (e.g., technical, economic, policy) through the use of various analytical tools.
  • Experience working as part of multi-disciplinary teams examining complex systems.
  • Knowledge of the fundamentals of good project management, especially as it pertains to the execution of federally-funded work (e.g., proposal development through annal review, final delivery, and closeout).
  • Experience working with federal sponsors in the defense and intelligence sectors, as well as their domestic FFRDC partners, international partnering agencies, and foreign governments.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary teams delivering critical information to customers in a succinct manner.

Also, for this posting we are seeking individuals with the following experience:

  • Well-developed technical leadership skills and the ability to prioritize and execute in a principled and focused manner
  • Proficient in all-source analytic disciplines and tradecraft, analytical tools, and software.
  • Willing to learn how to support technical research and communicate effectively with scientists.
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with the ability to synthesize complex information and present it clearly and in a timely manner.
  • Proven ability to collaborate effectively in a multidisciplinary team environment, demonstrating a positive and proactive attitude.
  • Experience within the aerospace industry and space systems.
  • Operational intelligence support experience with a civilian or military intelligence organization.
  • Technical curiosity and an interest and aptitude for learning.
  • Ability to champion the value of integrated approaches by effectively engaging stakeholders and influencing decision-making beyond immediate team boundaries.
  • Active DOE Q-level and SCI security clearance or equivalent (e.g., DOD Top Secret/SCI).

About Our Team

The Emerging Disruptive Technology department (5934) specializes in technical analysis across all facets of foreign science and technology programs. The department evaluates, researches, and develops emerging technologies by leveraging broad and deep technical expertise from across Sandia and delivers timely analysis and insights for our partners.

Posting Duration

This posting will be open for application submissions for a minimum of three (3) calendar days, including the 'posting date'. Sandia reserves the right to extend the posting date at any time.

Security Clearance

Sandia is required by DOE to conduct a pre-employment drug test and background review that includes checks of personal references, credit, law enforcement records, and employment/education verifications. Applicants for employment need to be able to obtain and maintain a DOE Q-level security clearance and SCI access, both of which require US citizenship. SCI access may also require a polygraph examination. If you hold more than one citizenship (i.e., of the U.S. and another country), your ability to obtain these levels of access may be impacted.

Applicants offered employment with Sandia are subject to a federal background investigation to meet the requirements for access to classified information or matter if the duties of the position require a DOE security clearance. Substance abuse or illegal drug use, falsification of information, criminal activity, serious misconduct or other indicators of untrustworthiness can cause a clearance to be denied or terminated by the DOE, resulting in the inability to perform the duties assigned and subsequent termination of employment.

EEO

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status and any other protected class under state or federal law.

NNSA Requirements for MedPEDs

If you have a Medical Portable Electronic Device (MedPED), such as a pacemaker, defibrillator, drug-releasing pump, hearing aids, or diagnostic equipment and other equipment for measuring, monitoring, and recording body functions such as heartbeat and brain waves, if employed by Sandia National Laboratories you may be required to comply with NNSA security requirements for MedPEDs.

If you have a MedPED and you are selected for an on-site interview at Sandia National Laboratories, there may be additional steps necessary to ensure compliance with NNSA security requirements prior to the interview date.

title: Senior Development & Learning Specialist

The Senior Development & Learning Specialist is also responsible for the administration and optimization of Acuity’s Learning Management System (LMS), including governance, technical infrastructure, platform configuration, user access management, and overall system functionality.

Knowledge of eLearning/instructional design software and multimedia tools for content creation.

Excellent leadership, interpersonal and coaching skills. Demonstrated ability to communicate with and present to management, executives and board members. description:

ABOUT UNITED ACTIVITIES UNLIMITED: Staten Island, NY; United Activities Unlimited, Inc. (UAU) is a community-based agency that provides a wide range of services that is inclusive of job placement, youth development programs and community outreach services to inspire, transform, and empower individuals of all ages. UAU is responsive to the needs of diverse populations and implements programs that support positive outcomes for individuals and communities. The comprehensive nature of UAU's programming options and the emphasis on holistic services for individuals and families make UAU an outstanding resource and a pillar of support for communities. UAU is dedicated to the engagement, education, and empowerment of individuals and strives to transform individuals and communities to create a better future. EOE

POSITION SUMMARY:
Under the direction of the SYEP Program Director and FRNYC Program Director, the Data Specialist will support the successful implementation of UAU’s SYEP, WLG, and FutureReady NYC programs by managing program data, maintaining accurate documentation, monitoring compliance, preparing reports, supporting communications, and providing technical support to staff. The Data Specialist will support data accuracy, program performance management, and administrative operations by analyzing data, tracking key deliverables and outcomes, and providing program leadership with actionable insights to identify trends, address gaps, and improve performance. The Data Specialist will ensure adherence to UAU policies, applicable NYCPS/DOE and DYCD expectations, and FutureReady NYC requirements. Working collaboratively with Program Leadership and Staff, the Data Specialist will help streamline workflows, strengthen reporting practices, and support continuous program improvement. The Data Specialist will support both the SYEP and FutureReady NYC teams; the division of time is approximate and may shift seasonally based on program needs.


PRIMARY JOB RESPONSIBILITIES (include but are not limited to):
• Maintain accurate, timely, and complete program data, databases, tracking systems, and documentation across SYEP, WLG, and FutureReady NYC, including participant enrollment, attendance, assessments, placements, worksite onboarding, job assignments, payroll confirmations, and program outcomes.
• Develop, maintain, and optimize data collection tools, forms, tracking files, workflows, and procedures; extract, clean, and integrate data from multiple sources, including DYCD’s YEPS database and the FutureReady NYC Career Pathway (CPP) database, and other program platforms, to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and comprehensive reporting.
• Collaborate with NYCPS/DOE school partners and the FutureReady NYC DOE Data team to confirm student eligibility for each program cycle, reviewing student status reports and collaborating with school liaisons to resolve discrepancies.
• Maintain all FutureReady NYC candidate pool spreadsheets, ensuring student eligibility and status information is accurate and up to date.
• Prepare and share student status and eligibility reports with partner schools, and support data needs during the eight-week student and worksite onboarding period before each of the three FutureReady NYC cycles (Fall, Winter, Spring).
• Conduct regular data quality and compliance reviews, monitor program deliverables, performance measures, and deadlines, and coordinate corrective actions with program staff to address discrepancies and ensure adherence to UAU policies, DYCD requirements, applicable NYCPS/DOE expectations, and FutureReady NYC guidelines.
• Prepare internal, funder, and program performance reports; analyze data to identify trends, assess progress toward goals, address performance gaps, and provide program leadership with actionable insights to support decision-making and continuous improvement.
• Maintain organized, confidential program records and supporting documentation to meet reporting requirements and support audits, including end-of-cycle FutureReady NYC audits, monitoring visits, and program reviews while ensuring the appropriate handling and protection of participant and organizational information.
• Provide technical assistance and training to staff on data systems, reporting procedures, documentation standards, and software applications; manage user access to program databases and platforms, including YEPS and worksite supervisor accounts, and troubleshoot technical issues to support daily operations.
• Support program communications and outreach by maintaining contact databases and distribution lists, responding to inquiries, disseminating program information, and assisting with the development of communication and marketing materials, including flyers, social media content, surveys, and presentations.
• Collaborate with program leadership, school and employer engagement teams, and other UAU departments to strengthen data management, compliance, reporting, communications, and operational efficiency across programs.
• Identify opportunities to improve data systems, technology, and administrative workflows; implement solutions and support special projects and other initiatives as assigned by Workforce Development leadership to enhance program efficiency and effectiveness.
• Serve as backup to the Data & Technology Coordinator for data, reporting, and technology functions.
• Performs other related duties as necessary or assigned.
