title: Research Specialist I
description:
Hiring Department

NextGen Precision Health

Job Description

Join the Lei Laboratory

The Lei Laboratory at the University of Missouri is seeking a motivated, dependable, and detail-oriented Research Specialist I to join its research team at NextGen Precision Health in Columbia, Missouri. This hands-on position provides essential technical support for ongoing laboratory research and helps sustain consistent, high-quality laboratory operations.
The Research Specialist will work closely with Dr. Lei and other laboratory members in a collaborative environment supporting faculty, students, postdoctoral researchers, and other research personnel.


What You Will Do
• Molecular and laboratory techniques: Perform PCR testing, gel electrophoresis, tissue collection and processing, cell culture, and other routine laboratory procedures.
• Mouse colony management: Support daily colony care and monitoring, including breeding, weaning, health checks, genotyping, animal identification, and accurate colony records.
• Research support: Assist scientists and students with experimental procedures, data collection, routine laboratory techniques, and troubleshooting under appropriate guidance.
• Laboratory operations: Prepare reagents; maintain supplies and equipment; assist with inventory control, ordering, and stocking; and help maintain an organized and efficient laboratory.
• Documentation: Maintain complete and accurate records of experimental procedures, results, animal colonies, and routine laboratory activities.
• Safety and compliance: Follow applicable animal-care, IACUC, laboratory-safety, training, and ethical-research requirements.
• Collaboration: Participate in laboratory meetings and training and communicate effectively with faculty, students, postdoctoral researchers, and other laboratory personnel.


Why This Position Matters
This position is necessary to maintain continuity of laboratory operations and directly supports the University’s research and educational missions. The employee will provide essential technical research support, including PCR testing, gel electrophoresis, tissue collection and cell culture, mouse colony maintenance, recordkeeping, and laboratory and equipment maintenance.
These functions allow faculty and other research personnel to focus their specialized expertise on experimental design, data analysis, scholarship, and research training. If the position is not filled, ongoing responsibilities would have to be redistributed to faculty and existing laboratory personnel, potentially delaying experimental work and data collection, reducing research capacity, and diverting specialized personnel from higher-level research and educational activities.
Mouse colony care and routine laboratory maintenance are continuing responsibilities that cannot simply be deferred. Filling this position supports the effective and responsible continuation of the University’s research enterprise and the research environment serving faculty, students, and other laboratory personnel.


Work Environment and Schedule

This is an onsite, hands-on laboratory position located at NextGen Precision Health in Columbia, Missouri. The role requires regular work with laboratory materials, research equipment, cell culture, biological specimens, and laboratory mice. Work schedules will be established based on laboratory and research needs, including the continuing care requirements of the mouse colony.

Shift

Monday - Friday, 8 am to 5 pm and as needed to accomplish research duties

Minimum Qualifications

A Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience and at least 1 year of experience from which comparable knowledge and skills can be acquired is necessary

Preferred Qualifications

• A bachelor’s degree in biology, molecular biology, biochemistry, animal science, biomedical science, or a closely related field.
• Hands-on experience with one or more of the following: PCR, gel electrophoresis, nucleic acid extraction, tissue collection or processing, cell culture, microscopy, or related molecular and cellular biology techniques.
• Experience handling laboratory mice and supporting mouse colony operations, including breeding, weaning, genotyping, health monitoring, animal identification, or colony recordkeeping.
• Experience working in an academic, biomedical, or life-sciences research laboratory.
• Knowledge of animal-care, IACUC, biosafety, and general laboratory-safety expectations.
• Demonstrated ability to maintain accurate, organized laboratory records and follow established protocols.
• Strong attention to detail, organization, reliability, communication, and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively.

Anticipated Hiring Range

Salary Range: $19 - $21 hourly

Grade: GGS-7

University Title: Research Specialist I

Internal applicants can determine their University title by accessing the Talent Profile tile in myHR.

Application Materials

Applicants should submit the materials required in the University’s official posting. A resume or curriculum vitae and a brief cover letter describing relevant laboratory experience are encouraged.

Sponsorship Information

Employment visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

Community Information

Columbia offers small-town friendliness with big city features and a high quality of life for people of all ages and interests. Founded on education and known as an ideal college town, its location also makes it an attractive spot for businesses and travelers. Located on Interstate 70 and U.S. Highway 63, Columbia is right in the middle of the state and the nation. Just a couple hours’ drive from St. Louis and Kansas City, Columbia is Boone County’s largest population center offering big-city culture, activities, and resources with a low cost of living. Columbia is home to a variety of restaurants and entertainment venues and hosts more than a dozen festivals each year. If you want to grow your career, continue your education, raise a family, and retire, Columbia is a good place to be!

Benefit Eligibility

This position is eligible for University benefits. As part of your total compensation, the University offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental and vision plans, retirement, paid time off, short- and long-term disability, paid parental leave, paid caregiver leave, and educational fee discounts for all four UM System campuses. title: Data Engineer II
description:
Job Title: Data Engineer II
Location: 100% Remote (US Based Only)
  • We cannot sponsor or transfer any visas, of any kind, at this time*
Hiring Manager: Senior Director of Data Engineering
Estimated salary range: $110,000 to $185,000
  • The salary offered for this position will be based on a candidate’s experience and skill demonstrated during interviews and other evaluations

Position Overview:
The Data Engineer II independently contributes to data engineering workstreams at Ocient, supporting customer workload onboarding, schema design, query conversion, data loading, and pre-pilot workload testing with growing technical depth and autonomy. This role works closely with Solutions Architects and Senior Data Engineers to deliver high-quality pre-pilot engineering outputs and developing customer solutions, applying growing expertise in Ocient’s SQL data platform, metadata analysis tooling, and workload performance analysis. The Data Engineer II is technically rigorous, collaborative, and developing the deep engineering skills that define Ocient’s customer-facing data engineering excellence.

Responsibilities:
  • Work with Solutions Architects to understand customer workloads, capture requirements through questionnaires and workshops, and obtain sample queries and data where possible.
  • Convert customer queries to Ocient syntax using internal tools and perform metadata analysis to understand field types, relationships, multi-dimensional elements, and changing schemas.
  • Analyze queries in bulk to understand indexing schemes and refine schema; define initial schema designs for pre-pilot workload preparation.
  • Load data, create workload test suites, and deploy end-to-end sample workloads to run initial pre-pilot tests.
  • Build test cases and validation assets for Delivery and Development teams, and create artifacts in GitHub and other repositories.
  • Assist with system sizing, delivery timeline development, and GDPR and data rolloff procedure definition.
  • Report performance results and status to management and contribute to cross-functional workload documentation.

Ideal Qualifications:
  • 2+ years of experience in data engineering, database engineering, or a related technical role with demonstrated SQL proficiency and data pipeline experience.
  • Demonstrated experience contributing to schema design, data loading, and workload testing in a data warehousing or analytics environment.
  • Strong SQL proficiency with the ability to write, convert, and optimize queries in large-scale analytical database environments.
  • Working knowledge of schema design, indexing strategy, ETL/ELT processes, and data loading in relational or columnar database systems.
  • Familiarity with metadata analysis, query bulk analysis, and workload performance testing.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to independently produce accurate technical documentation and engineering artifacts.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate cross-functionally with Solutions Architects, Delivery, and Engineering teams.

An Exceptional Candidate Will Have:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field.
  • Experience with Big Data platforms, distributed database systems, or cloud data warehousing (AWS Redshift, Google BigQuery, Snowflake, or comparable).
  • Familiarity with GDPR data compliance, HA/DR requirements, or data governance processes.
  • Experience with GitHub or comparable version control and artifact repository tools.

title: Program Coordinator, Rural Track Graduate Medical Education (GME) Programs - UMKC School of Medicine
description:
Hiring Department

Department of Graduate Medical Education

University of Missouri - Kansas City

School of Medicine

Job Description

This position provides comprehensive administrative and programmatic support for the Rural Track Graduate Medical Education Programs. The role coordinates resident and faculty activities, supports accreditation and regulatory compliance, manages educational and evaluation processes, and facilitates partnerships with affiliated rural training sites. Serving as a key resource for residents, faculty, and institutional stakeholders, the position helps ensure the effective operation, continuous improvement, and long-term success of rural residency training programs.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Onboard new residents and trainees by coordinating all aspects such as requesting resident accounts, setting up EMR training, arranging badge access, and managing orientation processes to ensure a smooth transition into the program while maintaining compliance with institutional and accreditation standards.
  • Work with UMKC to credential new preceptors appropriately, ensuring that all faculty members involved in training meet necessary qualifications and that their credentials are updated and verified regularly, thereby driving the ongoing development and efficacy of the training program.
  • Manage the evaluative processes by overseeing the assessment and feedback systems for trainees, program, faculty, and rotations, ensuring that evaluations are conducted regularly and effectively to drive continuous improvement of the educational program and adherence to accreditation requirements.
  • Monitor immunization records and requirements, sending timely reminders to residents and trainees to ensure that all health and safety compliance aspects are up-to-date and documented.
  • Develop, implement, and oversee office systems including filing, record keeping, and distribution of materials, while evaluating and standardizing office procedures to effectively troubleshoot and resolve any issues, ensuring the smooth operation of the administrative functions of the program.
  • Plan and coordinate departmental events such as recruitment, orientation, and graduation, including the creation of brochures and advertisements, to ensure that all program-related activities are well-organized and effectively communicated to all stakeholders.
  • Coordinate resident rotations across participating rural hospitals and ambulatory sites.
  • Maintain compliance with ACGME Institutional, Common and Specialty Program Requirements.
  • Prepare and maintain accreditation documentation, Annual Program Evaluation (APE), ADS updates, surveys, and site visit documentation.
  • Assign and monitor resident and faculty evaluations using residency training management systems.
  • Assist with scheduling internal reviews and implementation of subsequent corrective action plans or accreditation findings.

Minimum Qualifications

A Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education and experience and 1 year of experience from which comparable knowledge and skills can be acquired is necessary.

Preferred Qualifications

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Thorough knowledge of ACGME accreditation requirements and graduate medical education.
  • Knowledge of rural residency training models and affiliated teaching sites.
  • Excellent organizational and project management skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication abilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities with minimal supervision.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficiency with residency training management software (New Innovations, MedHub, or similar).
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Ability to build collaborative relationships with physicians, hospital executives, faculty, residents, and community partners.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment.

Anticipated Hiring Range

The anticipated hiring range for this position has been established as $19.25 - $31.25 per hour.

Salary is determined by a variety of factors, including but not limited to, the individual’s particular combination of education, skills, and experience, as well as organizational requirements.

Your total compensation goes beyond the number on your paycheck. The University of Missouri provides generous leave, health plans, and retirement contributions that add to your bottom line.

Grade: GGS-8

Kansas City offers the best of both worlds—a vibrant, urban community with Midwestern appeal. The city’s rich history and its modern-day, innovative thinking come together to create an eclectic group of neighborhoods that offer a little something for everyone. From thriving arts districts, an energetic downtown nightlife, casual to upscale shopping and champion sports teams, you will have no problem making yourself at home. Of course, one of Kansas City’s biggest claims to fame is its food, especially its world-famous barbecue. Foodies will delight in the culinary scene found throughout the city. Ranging from award-winning chefs to cozy pizza joints, Kansas City definitely is not lacking any flavor.

UMKC’s campuses are conveniently nestled in the middle of all the action. Volker Campus is just minutes from the legendary Country Club Plaza, perfect for shopping or restaurants for lunch or after-work happy hours. Surrounded by hip neighborhoods and eateries, the Health Sciences Campus is located downtown near University Health Truman Medical Center and Children’s Mercy Hospital.

UMKC is proud to be “Kansas City’s university,” and the campus and its people celebrate all the characteristics of the surrounding community. To learn more about life in Kansas City and find more resources, visit VisitKC.com.

title: Erfaren chefkonsulent til investeringsområdet i Finans Danmark
description:
Finans Danmark har sat en ny strategisk retning, der skal styrke vores samlede interessevaretagelse på finanssektorens vegne og sikre, at både organisationen og sektoren står stærkt i en tid med voksende nationale og globale udfordringer. Finanssektoren spiller en central rolle som alliancepartner for samfundet og i udviklingen af fremtidens løsninger

Til afdelingen Investering og Opsparing søger vi en erfaren profil, der får en central rolle i arbejdet med at udvikle fremtidens rammevilkår på investeringsområdet og bliver en vigtig sparringspartner for vores medlemmer.

Du kommer til at arbejde med nogle af de væsentligste dagsordener for kapitalforvaltere, investeringsfonde, banker og andre aktører på investeringsområdet, både i Danmark og i EU.

Om stillingen

Din vigtigste opgave er at forstå de udfordringer, vores medlemmer møder på investeringsområdet, og omsætte dem til politiske og regulatoriske positioner og løsninger, der gør en forskel for sektoren. Det kræver tæt dialog med medlemmerne, forståelse for deres forretningsmæssige virkelighed og blik for det politiske og regulatoriske mulighedsrum.

Opgaverne spænder fra konkrete regulatoriske og operationelle problemstillinger til større politiske dagsordener. Du bliver et fagligt anker på området og får ansvar for at drive sager fra start til slut sammen med dygtige kolleger i teamet og på tværs af Finans Danmark.

Den danske og europæiske regulering af investeringsområdet er en central del af arbejdet. Det er derfor vigtigt, at du har solid erfaring med investeringsområdet og et indgående kendskab til centrale regelsæt som UCITS, AIFMD og MiFID II. Du skal kunne forstå reguleringens betydning for medlemmernes forretning og bidrage til at udvikle konstruktive løsninger.

Du repræsenterer desuden Finans Danmark i relevante europæiske medlemsfora, blandt andet i EFAMA og EBF, hvor du arbejder for at bringe danske medlemmers perspektiver og interesser ind i de europæiske dagsordener.

Opgaver og ansvar

  • Analysere regulatoriske og politiske udviklinger på investeringsområdet og formidle deres betydning for medlemmerne.
  • Udvikle politiske og regulatoriske positioner, høringssvar, analyser og konkrete løsningsforslag.
  • Drive og facilitere Finans Danmarks udvalg og arbejdsgrupper på investeringsområdet.
  • Repræsentere Finans Danmark i europæiske fora, herunder EFAMA og EBF, og arbejde for at fremme danske medlemmers interesser.
  • Bidrage til faglig udvikling, videndeling og sparring på tværs af organisationen.

Vi tilbyder

Finans Danmark tilbyder en spændende, travl og udfordrende hverdag som er præget af højaktuelle sager, mediemæssigt såvel som politisk. Arbejdsdagen dækker både drift og udvikling, og det sker i tæt samspil med gode og fagligt dygtige kolleger internt, såvel som hos vores medlemmer i den danske finansielle sektor. Du bliver del af et team, der løfter i flok, og værdsætter samarbejde, sparring, godt humør, høj faglighed, et stærkt netværk og socialt samvær.

Finans Danmark har til huse i Amaliegade i indre by, hvor du får ca. 110 kolleger. Vi er kendetegnet ved et højt fagligt niveau, et godt samarbejde og en uformel omgangstone. Vi lægger vægt på udvikling og indflydelse.

Om dig

Du har en relevant videregående uddannelse inden for økonomi, jura eller tilsvarende og flere års erfaring fra den finansielle sektor, centraladministrationen eller en erhvervsorganisation. Du har solid indsigt i investeringsområdet og erfaring med investeringsprodukter, kapitalforvaltning, investeringsfonde eller værdipapirmarkedet.

Du har en stærk forståelse for samspillet mellem regulering, politik og den finansielle sektor. Du kombinerer høj faglighed med et godt blik for medlemmernes interesser og det politiske landskab og formår at omsætte komplekse problemstillinger til konkrete løsninger og klare budskaber.

Du trives med en bred kontaktflade og er god til at opbygge relationer og skabe konstruktivt samarbejde med medlemmer, myndigheder og andre interessenter. Du kan navigere mellem forskellige interesser, identificere fælles løsninger og skabe fremdrift i de sager, du arbejder med.

Du arbejder selvstændigt, struktureret og analytisk og tager naturligt ansvar for dine opgaver. Samtidig er du en engageret og løsningsorienteret kollega, der værdsætter faglig sparring og samarbejde. Du har stærke formidlingsevner og kan kommunikere komplekst fagligt stof klart og overbevisende på både dansk og engelsk.

Kontakt og ansøgning

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte underdirektør for Investering og Opsparing, Rasmus Eske Bruun på rbr@fida.dk eller telefon 20 47 43 12.

Send din ansøgning hurtigst muligt og senest den 22. november 2026. Vi indkalder til samtaler løbende. Vi behandler kun ansøgninger fremsendt via vores digitale rekrutteringssystem.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Om Finans Danmark

Finans Danmark er erhvervs- og arbejdsgiverorganisation for den finansielle sektor. Vi repræsenterer penge- og realkreditinstitutter, kapitalforvaltere, børsmæglere, investeringsfonde samt datacentraler, it- og fintechvirksomheder. Ligesom vi er arbejdsgiverorganisation for virksomheder, der beskæftiger godt 47.000 ansatte. Sammen udgør vores medlemmer en central del af fundamentet under dansk økonomi, vækst og velstand.

title: Senior/Principal Cybersecurity - Systems Security Engineering, Onsite
description:
About Sandia

Sandia National Laboratories is the nation’s premier science and engineering lab for national security and technology innovation, with teams of specialists focused on cutting-edge work in a broad array of areas. Some of the main reasons we love our jobs:

  • Challenging work with amazing impact that contributes to security, peace, and freedom worldwide
  • Extraordinary co-workers
  • Some of the best tools, equipment, and research facilities in the world
  • Career advancement and enrichment opportunities
  • Flexible work arrangements for many positions include 9/80 (work 80 hours every two weeks, with every other Friday off) and 4/10 (work 4 ten-hour days each week) compressed workweeks, part-time work, and telecommuting (a mix of onsite work and working from home)
  • Generous vacation, strong medical and other benefits, competitive 401k, learning opportunities, relocation assistance and amenities aimed at creating a solid work/life balance*

World-changing technologies. Life-changing careers. Learn more about Sandia at: http://www.sandia.gov


*These benefits vary by job classification.

What Your Job Will Be Like

Are you interested in defending and protecting our national security digital systems against advanced cyber threats? Would you like to contribute to the development of Sandia's risk management framework for digital systems? Are you up for the challenge to help enact a new vision for implementing digital systems security?

If so, the Digital Assurance team is looking for highly motivated and hardworking Systems Security Engineer (job title: R&D Cybersecurity) to implement systems security engineering for non-traditional digital systems. This individual must be passionate about securing, and supporting certification and accreditation of nuclear deterrent centric digital systems. Come join our team and make a national impact!

On any given day, you may be called on to:

  • Define system security requirements (hardware/software/Data) from concept to production
  • Partner with design and engineering teams to create secure systems
  • Architect, design, and validate security implementations of digital systems
  • Develop applicable security policies, standards, and procedures
  • Identify and present innovative security solutions
  • Develop and implement new technologies that can advance security of the system
  • Lead technical design reviews of digital systems including security audits, and provide clear feedback and actionable solutions
  • Lead and conduct security risk assessment, red-teaming exercise and provide vulnerability remediation guidance and recommendations
  • Be an authority on security best practices and serve as a security subject matter expert for the design teams

Due to the nature of the work, the selected applicant must be able to work onsite in Livermore or Albuquerque. The preferred work location for this position is Livermore, CA.

Applicants on this requisition may be interviewed by multiple organizations at Sandia National Laboratories.

Salary Range

$139,900 - $280,600

*Salary range is estimated, and actual salary will be determined after consideration of the selected candidate's experience and qualifications, and application of any approved geographic salary differential.

Qualifications We Require

  • A Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline and five (5) years of directly relevant experience, or an equivalent combination of directly relevant education and engineering or scientific experience that demonstrates the knowledge, skills, and ability to perform independent research and development
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a DOE Q-level security clearance

Qualifications We Desire

The ideal R&D S&E Cybersecurity candidate for Sandia National Laboratories will in addition possess the following:

  • Graduate degree in Computer Science/Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Information Systems, Computer Forensics, Mathematics or a directly related field where an independent research project was a graduation requirement (e.g., independent project, thesis, or dissertation)
  • Experience in one or more of the following: reverse engineering, software vulnerability assessment, web application assessment, computer networking, computer architecture, compilers, or similar computer security topics
  • Proficiency in scripting or high-level programming
  • Familiarity with secure-system design principles and information assurance principles
  • Excellent communication skills and a demonstrated ability to develop technical ideas and results and present them in oral and written form in a concise manner

Also, for this posting we are seeking individuals with the following experience:

  • Strong systems engineering background with interest in digital assurance and cybersecurity
  • Experience with non-traditional IT systems product development
  • Experience in one or more of the following areas: digital systems design, microelectronics, hardware security, embedded systems security, and/or software security
  • Experience with building secure and reliable digital systems and the application of security controls
  • Experience working with a federal cyber security program
  • Experience crafting cyber security plans and/or performing cyber security assessments
  • Knowledge and experience of DOE/NNSA cyber security orders and policies; relevant federal and private standards and requirements (e.g., NIST, ISO, CNSS, STIGS); and understanding of the Risk Management Framework as documented in various NIST publications
  • Experience with secure-system design principles and information assurance principles
  • Experience in digital systems design and in the field of hardware and embedded security
  • Experience with hardware/software security verification or testing techniques
  • Excellent leadership skills with the ability to prioritize and execute in a disciplined and focused manner
  • Active DOE Q-level security clearance or equivalent DOD Top Secret level security clearance

About Our Team

The Cyber & Digital Assurance Group is composed of four cyber security departments that conduct research, develop tools and methods, and work closely with customers to assure verification of high-consequence digital systems and to support cybersecurity of enterprise and weapons systems. We serve as local domain experts for Sandia/CA nuclear weapon system and component organizations, and as Sandia resources for cybersecurity operations, as well as for digital formal verification, rigorous cyber experimentation, and cyber risk assessments. We engage throughout the design-to-retirement lifecycle, and actively manage research collaborations with academic institutions. We are dedicated to supporting cybersecurity of Sandia and government systems, and digital assurance of a flexible and responsive nuclear deterrent that remains robust to an evolving environment.

Posting Duration

This posting will be open for application submissions for a minimum of three (3) calendar days, including the 'posting date'. Sandia reserves the right to extend the posting date at any time.

Security Clearance

Sandia is required by DOE to conduct a pre-employment drug test and background review that includes checks of personal references, credit, law enforcement records, and employment/education verifications. Applicants for employment need to be able to obtain and maintain a DOE Q-level security clearance, which requires U.S. citizenship. If you hold more than one citizenship (i.e., of the U.S. and another country), your ability to obtain a security clearance may be impacted.

Applicants offered employment with Sandia are subject to a federal background investigation to meet the requirements for access to classified information or matter if the duties of the position require a DOE security clearance. Substance abuse or illegal drug use, falsification of information, criminal activity, serious misconduct or other indicators of untrustworthiness can cause a clearance to be denied or terminated by DOE, resulting in the inability to perform the duties assigned and subsequent termination of employment.

EEO

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status and any other protected class under state or federal law.

NNSA Requirements for MedPEDs

If you have a Medical Portable Electronic Device (MedPED), such as a pacemaker, defibrillator, drug-releasing pump, hearing aids, or diagnostic equipment and other equipment for measuring, monitoring, and recording body functions such as heartbeat and brain waves, if employed by Sandia National Laboratories you may be required to comply with NNSA security requirements for MedPEDs.

If you have a MedPED and you are selected for an on-site interview at Sandia National Laboratories, there may be additional steps necessary to ensure compliance with NNSA security requirements prior to the interview date.

title: Software Engineering Manager, Core Storage
description:
This role will be based in Bellevue, WA.

At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.

Drive the development of LinkedIn's next-generation, public-cloud-grade blob storage platform. Guide the blob storage team to establish a scalable, durable, secure, and cost-effective storage foundation supporting LinkedIn's online services as well as offline data and AI operations. You will partner with defining the architectural vision and strategic roadmap, cultivate a high-performing engineering team, and collaborate with internal partners across LinkedIn to deliver high throughput, low latency, and scalable automated operations.

Construct an S3-compatible, public-cloud-grade blob storage system designed to support a wide range of LinkedIn workloads, such as Media, Ads, CTR, tracking events, analytics, AI/ML training, checkpointing, and artifact distribution. Streamline integration through seamless client adoption, robust multi-tenancy controls, quota management, and comprehensive observability. Optimize system performance by balancing throughput, latency, availability, durability, and cost using tailored replication and erasure-coding strategies. Scale capacity seamlessly to exabytes while reducing operational overhead through automated capacity management, self-healing recovery, continuous testing, and proactive rebalancing.

Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach and manage core team of engineers working on building the infrastructure.

  • Participate with senior management in developing a long-term technology roadmap for the team and company.

  • Have the ability to dive deep into technical discussions to challenge the status quo, and steer the team in the right direction/to push the envelope.

  • Communicate and collaborate effectively with stakeholders across engineering and business leadership.

  • Help the team realize their potential by setting clear expectations, openly evaluating performance, upholding accountability, and providing challenges to stretch their skills.

  • Drive a culture of operational excellence. Lead the team into defining performance goals, metrics and building the infrastructure and tooling necessary to maintain a high quality bar and detect issues in real time.

  • Create an inclusive work environment that fosters autonomy, transparency, innovation and learning, while holding a high bar for quality.

  • You will provide technical leadership, driving and performing best engineering practices to initiate, plan, and execute critical, large-scale, cross-functional, and company-wide programs.

Basic Qualifications

  • BS/BA in Computer Science or related technical field, or equivalent related experience

  • 1+ year(s) of management experience or 1+ year(s) of staff level engineering experience with management training

  • 5+ years industry experience in software design, development, and algorithm related solutions.

  • 3+ years experience in large-scale system design and software development

  • Experience programming in object-oriented and/or functional programming languages (like Rust/Python/C++/Scala)

Preferred Qualifications

  • MS or PhD in Computer Science or related technical discipline

  • 2+ years of hands-on software engineering/technical management and people management experience

  • 7+ years of industry experience in software design, development, and algorithms related solutions.

  • 5+ years programming experience in languages such as Rust, Java, C++, Python, Go, Scala

  • 5+ years in technical leadership, and contributions to industry, open-source projects or academic research in large-data, parallel or distributed systems.

  • Experience with public-cloud object storage, multi-tenant infrastructure, databases, remote disk or other large-scale distributed storage systems; familiarity with S3-compatible APIs and customer migrations.

  • Successful track record of managing teams of engineers to deliver multiple projects on time and with quality

  • Active involvement in the creation and execution of technical strategies and roadmaps

Suggested Skills

  • Distributed systems

  • Storage

  • Technical Leadership

You will Benefit from our Culture

We strongly believe in the well-being of our employees and their families. That is why we offer generous health and wellness programs and time away for employees of all levels. LinkedIn is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices.

The pay range for this role is $175,000 - $287,000. Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, certifications, and specific work location. This may be different in other locations due to differences in the cost of labor.

The total compensation package for this position may also include annual performance bonus, stock, benefits and/or other applicable incentive compensation plans. For more information, visit https://careers.linkedin.com/benefits.

title: Reimbursement Analyst
description:
General Job Information

When you become a member of Team DHCF (Department of Health Care Finance), the state Medicaid agency for the District of Columbia, you join our "Mission Possible!" We work every day, in concert with various District government agencies, to streamline access to comprehensive, affordable and quality healthcare services for District residents. Whatever your position within our agency, you will positively impact beneficiaries, their families and their future! We invite you to bring your skills, your experience and your passion to a job that makes a difference!

Job Summary

This position is located within the Department of Health Care Finance (DHCF), Office of the Director, Office of Rates, Reimbursements, and Financial Analysis (ORRFA). This incumbent serves as a Reimbursement Analyst working closely with external health care providers in establishing rates for services provided.

Duties and Responsibilities

Provides in-depth advice to the Deputy Director and DHCF management on rate setting and reimbursement actions, including an analysis of problems encounters and recommendation; calculates, reviews, and monitors reimbursements methodology payment rates for the District of Columbia. Establishes a system to track and evaluates overpayments; initiates and coordinates recovery efforts including the evaluation of provider’s documentation to develop repayment plan. Applies reimbursement formulas

Applies reimbursement formulas to calculate federal/local share in the funding of providers. Participates in project teams involved in reviewing pending District and federal legislation affecting DHCF programs related to payment and rate setting. Develops Ad hoc updates to the fee schedule (e.g. external and internal requests to add codes, change pricing, or change authorizations or units); develops manual pricing for codes “covered” and not priced on the fee schedule. Works with consultants to update the annual Upper Payment Limit (UPL) demonstrations.

Qualifications and Education

Specialized Experience – Experience that equipped the applicant with the particular knowledge, skills and abilities to perform successfully the duties of the position, and this is typically in or related to the work of the position to be filled. To be creditable, at least one (1) year of specialized experience must have been equivalent to at least the next lower grade level in the normal line of progression.

Licenses and Certifications

None.

Working Conditions/Environment

The work is performed in a typical office setting.

Other Significant Facts

Tour of Duty: Monday – Friday; 8:15 am - 4:45 pm

Pay Plan, Series, and Grade: CS-301-14

Promotion Potential: No known promotion potential.

Collective Bargaining Unit (Union): This position is NOT represented by a collective bargaining unit.

Position Designation: This position has been designated as security sensitive therefore the incumbent of this position will be subject to enhanced suitability screening pursuant to Chapter 4 of DC Personnel Regulations, Suitability and as such, incumbents of this position shall be subject to criminal background checks, background investigations, and mandatory drug and alcohol testing, as applicable.

Residency Preference: Applicants claiming “Residency Preference” will be required to maintain residency in the District of Columbia for a minimum of seven (7) years. Failure to do so may result in forfeiture of employment.

EEO Statement: The District of Columbia Government does not discriminate or retaliate in employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, family responsibilities, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, homeless status, disability, genetic information, age, membership in an employee organization, participation in a legally protected activity, parental status, matriculation, personal appearance, credit information, status as a victim or family member of a victim of domestic violence, sexual offense, or stalking, military service, or other non-merit factor.

title: Experience Manager

This role is highly client-facing, leading sales calls and meetings with both internal teams and prospective clients to bring new experiences to life. Success in this role requires close collaboration across departments throughout the organization, from sales and operations to marketing and mountain teams, to deliver experiences that are both innovative and flawlessly executed. This position reports to the Director of Client Experience.

The salary range for this position is $65,000 to $80,000. Actual pay will be dependent on budget and experience; all our salaried roles are eligible for bonus.

Job Posting Deadline

Applications for this position will be accepted until December 1, 2026.

Essential Job Functions/Key Job Responsibilities

  • Serve as a key connector across Aspen One, partnering closely with Sales, Marketing, Hospitality Operations and Mountain Operations to align experiences with broader company goals and ensure consistent, on-brand execution.

title: Executive Director of Education
description:
Job Title: Executive Director of Education

Department: Department of Education

Reports to: Chief Administrative Officer (CAO)

Location: Wilton Rancheria Tribal Office, Elk Grove, California

Employment Status/Level: Full-Time, Exempt

POSITION SUMMARY

The Executive Director of Education provides strategic, administrative, and programmatic leadership for education services serving Wilton Rancheria Tribal Citizens from early learning through postsecondary education, workforce development, and lifelong learning. The position designs, implements, evaluates, and continuously improves culturally responsive programs that promote academic achievement, career readiness, family engagement, Tribal history, language, cultural values, youth leadership, and community well-being. The Executive Director is accountable for departmental planning, fiscal stewardship, compliance, staff leadership, partnerships, and clear reporting to Tribal leadership and the community.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

· Provide executive leadership for the Department of Education and translate Tribal priorities, the Department vision, and approved budgets into annual operating plans, measurable program objectives, timelines, staffing plans, and service standards.

· Design, administer, monitor, and evaluate educational programs and services for preschool, K–12, postsecondary, adult learners, and Tribal Citizens pursuing career, vocational, or entrepreneurial goals.

· Lead educational support services, including Individualized Education Program (IEP) and Student Success Team (SST) assistance, tutoring, home school support, student success planning, case management, and referrals

· Oversee the Higher Education Scholarship and Adult Education Assistance Programs.

· Oversee career and workforce planning services, including career and personality assessments, education and training pathways, transition and advancement counseling, employment readiness, trade and graduate school guidance, and coordination of appropriate business start-up resources.

· Lead the rollout and phased implementation of the Boys and Girls Club and other youth-centered programming.

· Lead family and community engagement through educational gatherings, graduation recognition, backpack distribution, summer and year-round activities, speaker series, cultural education, language activities, and other approved events.

· Develop the Youth Leadership Initiative to build leadership skills, elevate youth voices, encourage service and stewardship, and strengthen connections among youth, families, culture, lands, and Indigenous worldviews.

· Plan and oversee the Small Business Assistance initiative.

· Promote Wilton Rancheria cultural values, history, language, traditions, and community priorities throughout Department programs, curricula, partnerships, communications, and events. Coordinate with cultural knowledge holders and appropriate Tribal departments when developing content.

· Build and maintain productive relationships with Tribal Citizens, students, parents and guardians, schools, colleges, training providers, Tribal colleges, community partners, contractors, and public or private agencies.

· Maintain regular communication with Tribal youth, postsecondary students, adult learners, and families to identify needs, monitor progress, connect participants to resources, and support completion of educational and career goals.

· Provide or coordinate college, vocational, and career guidance, including application planning, college essays, admissions processes, financial aid referrals, transition support, and post-graduation career planning.

· Develop, manage, and monitor the Department budget. Review expenditures, forecasts, fiscal reports, scholarship and assistance commitments, contracts, professional services, supplies, facilities, events, and other program costs. Submit proposed budgets and amendments through the established administrative and Tribal approval process.

· Oversee grants and sponsored programs. Ensure grant-funded activities remain aligned with approved scope and requirements.

· Plan and administer contracts, professional services, rental space, equipment, software, transportation, and facility-related needs.

· Establish systems for record keeping. Protect confidential and sensitive information and ensure records are retained and handled in accordance with Tribal policy and applicable requirements.

· Develop performance measures and reporting methods to evaluate participation, service quality, academic support, student progress, program outcomes, community engagement, and progress toward Department goals. Use findings to recommend program improvements and resource adjustments.

· Prepare accurate and timely reports, presentations, budget narratives, policies, procedures, correspondence, outreach materials, and program information for the CAO, Tribal leadership, participants, and partner agencies, as appropriate.

· Recruit, orient, supervise, coach, mentor, and evaluate Department managers and staff. Set clear expectations, delegate appropriately, support professional development, resolve workplace issues professionally, and maintain an accountable and collaborative work environment.

· Facilitate meetings, trainings, conferences, parent discussions, community presentations, and cross-department coordination. Represent the Department professionally at internal and external meetings.

· Ensure Department operations comply with the Department of Education Establishment and Organization Act, Tribal laws and policies, approved budgets, funding requirements, safety standards, and other applicable requirements.

· Perform other duties as assigned by the Chief Administrative Officer.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

· Knowledge of Wilton Rancheria government, Tribal sovereignty, traditional forms of government, Tribal customs and traditions, and culturally responsive service delivery.

· Advanced knowledge of education program administration across K–12, postsecondary, adult education, workforce development, scholarships, tutoring, youth development, and community education.

· Knowledge of IEP and SST processes, student support planning, learning differences, assessment information, case management, and effective collaboration with students, families, educators, and school administrators.

· Knowledge of child safety, mandated safeguards, behavior management, youth engagement, emergency procedures, and risk management for youth programs, events, volunteers, and facilities.

· Knowledge of college, trade school, vocational, scholarship, financial aid, admissions, college essay, career planning, and adult education pathways.

· Knowledge of administrative principles and practices, including strategic planning, policy development, program design, project management, budgeting, procurement, contracting, grants management, fiscal reporting, records management, supervision, and staff development.

· Ability to lead department and program expansion, including needs assessment, phased implementation, staffing, facilities, partnerships, communications, and outcome evaluation.

· Ability to develop culturally grounded, age-specific curricula, activities, and services and to integrate Tribal history, language, culture, and values appropriately.

· Ability to analyze qualitative and quantitative information, identify trends and service gaps, project consequences, evaluate options, and implement sound recommendations.

· Ability to manage multiple complex programs, projects, deadlines, budgets, and stakeholder expectations while maintaining accuracy, organization, and follow-through.

· Ability to establish measurable goals, maintain accurate documentation, assess program effectiveness, and prepare clear recommendations for executive and Tribal leadership consideration.

· Ability to communicate effectively and respectfully, verbally and in writing, with youth, parents and guardians, Tribal Citizens, staff, volunteers, leadership, community partners, and outside agencies.

· Ability to build trust, maintain effective working relationships, resolve conflicts professionally, and demonstrate sound judgment, diplomacy, discretion, and sensitivity to community concerns.

· Ability to maintain strict confidentiality and appropriately protect student, family, personnel, applicant, financial, and Tribal information.

· Ability to supervise, coach, mentor, and evaluate employees and to foster a safe, accountable, service-oriented, and collaborative workplace.

· Skill in facilitating meetings, conferences, trainings, community events, and public presentations.

· Skill in preparing budgets, fiscal reports, grant applications and reports, program plans, timelines, staffing plans, policies, procedures, comprehensive reports, and public information materials.

· Proficiency with Microsoft Suite Programs. Ability to learn and use software systems and programs.

title: Senior Systems Engineer
description:
Senior Systems Engineer

Capstone Research Corporation is seeking to expand our team. We provide high level engineering to the Department of War with Integrated Air and Missile Defense Systems Engineering expertise to solve the tough interoperability problems facing Warfighters today. We pride ourselves on providing high level engineering in a customer-oriented, ethical approach. Capstone offers 100% Company Provided Medical and Dental Insurance as part of our top-notch benefits package. Compensation for this position will be determined, but not limited to, factors such as responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, alignment with market data, and internal equity.

We have an immediate opening for a Senior Systems Engineer who will support USAF Portfolio Acquisition Element Command, Control, Communications, Battle Management (PAE C3BM) in Huntsville, AL, however, other locations will also be considered. This will be a high visibility position for Capstone Research Corporation with a significant opportunity for growth.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain systems requirements, operational-to-system traceability, interfaces, and system-of-systems architecture products for PAE C3BM efforts.
  • Translate operational needs into technical specifications and design alternatives; analyze C2, sensor, network, tactical data link, and effector interoperability.
  • Apply systems engineering and MBSE methods to conduct trade studies, identify integration gaps and risks, and support acquisition decisions.
  • Plan and support integration, verification, and validation, including hardware/software-in-the-loop testing, LVC events, exercises, and demonstrations.
  • Develop test plans, evaluation criteria, technical reports, design artifacts, and concise briefings for government and industry stakeholders.
  • Work with government teams, operational SMEs, and integration partners to resolve technical issues and deliver practical engineering solutions.

Requirements

  • S. in Systems, Electrical, Computer, Aerospace, Software Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
  • 10+ years of relevant engineering experience, including hands-on requirements, architecture, interface definition, integration, and test.

title: Qualified Professional, Intensive In-Home in Stokes County, NC
location: YOUTH HAVEN - STOKES OFFICE - WALNUT COVE, NC 27052
description:
Qualified Professional – Intensive In-Home Services (IIH)

Stokes County, NC | Paid Per Billable Contact

Help Strengthen Families Where They Need It Most

Youth Haven Services is seeking a compassionate and dedicated Qualified Professional (QP) to provide Intensive In-Home (IIH) services to children, adolescents, and their families throughout Stokes County, NC.

This position is ideal for professionals who enjoy working independently, building meaningful relationships with families, and helping youth remain safely in their homes and communities. As a Qualified Professional, you will provide clinical oversight, case management, and skill-building services while working closely with licensed therapists and community partners to help families achieve lasting success.

At Youth Haven Services, our mission is to support the healing of children, adolescents, and families through empowerment and hope. If you're looking for meaningful work with flexibility and the opportunity to make a real difference, we'd love to hear from you.

Position Summary

The Qualified Professional provides Intensive In-Home case management and rehabilitative services for children and adolescents with behavioral and mental health needs. Services are delivered primarily in the client's home and community and are guided by each individual's Person-Centered Plan. This position works collaboratively with the licensed therapist, family members, schools, and other providers to ensure coordinated, quality care.

This is a W-2 position and compensation is based on billable client contacts.

Essential Responsibilities

  • Complete client intakes, assessments, and Person-Centered Plans (PCPs).

  • Submit initial authorizations and reauthorizations for Intensive In-Home services.

  • Coordinate care with therapists, families, schools, physicians, and other community providers.

  • Meet with clients and families in their homes, schools, and community settings to provide case management and skill-building services.

  • Monitor client progress and assist families in achieving treatment goals identified in the Person-Centered Plan.

  • Maintain accurate, timely, and compliant clinical documentation, including progress notes, service logs, treatment updates, and required agency paperwork.

  • Complete NC TOPPS assessments, Service Authorization Requests (SARs), discharge documentation, and other state-required documentation.

  • Maintain assigned caseloads and ensure authorizations remain current.

  • Assist families in accessing community resources and support services.

  • Participate in Child and Family Team (CFT) meetings and other treatment planning meetings as needed.

  • Perform other duties as assigned in support of the Intensive In-Home program.

Compensation

This position is compensated on a per-contact (billable service) basis. Qualified Professionals have the flexibility to manage their schedules while meeting the needs of assigned families and maintaining productivity expectations.

Why Join Youth Haven Services?

At Youth Haven Services, you'll become part of a team committed to helping children and families thrive. We value collaboration, integrity, and compassionate care while providing opportunities to make a meaningful impact every day.

Whether you're looking to expand your experience in community-based mental health or continue your passion for serving youth and families, we invite you to join our team.

Apply today and help bring hope and healing to families throughout Stokes County.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Youth Haven Services, LLC is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, age, sex, marital status, sexual orientation, disability, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Americans with Disabilities Act

Applicants and employees must be able to perform the essential functions of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation. Reasonable accommodations will be considered on an individual basis in accordance with applicable law.

title: End User Support Engineer
description:
MISSION

The job holder ensures smooth daily operations in our offices globally by delivering responsive, high-quality technical support to all users. They leverage strong expertise in Office 365 and trading applications to maintain system reliability and performance. Working closely with global IT teams, the job holder efficiently resolves issues, manages user onboarding, and maintains clear technical documentation. Through their proactive approach and collaboration, they contribute to a secure, efficient, and high-performing technology environment that supports business success.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Trading Application Support: Assist with installation, configuration, and troubleshooting of trading applications used by front-office teams.

  • Hardware Management: Set up, configure, and maintain laptops, desktops, mobile devices, printers, and other peripherals.

  • User Onboarding/Offboarding: Manage account creation, permissions, and system access for new hires and leavers.

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to support users at all levels of the business.

  • Service orientation

  • Ability to work under pressure

  • Fluent in English; other European languages are a plus.

  • Spanish national or holder of a valid work permit in Spain.

title: Projekteringsleder til spændende baneprojekter indenfor køreledningsanlæg
description:
Vil du være med til at udvikle Danmarks grønne infrastruktur? Så er du måske vores nye kollega!

Som projekteringsleder i Banedanmark får du faglig indflydelse gennem hele projektforløbet og bliver en del af fornyelsen af hele jernbanen på én gang. Du arbejder med køreledningsanlæg i tæt samspil med rådgivere og entreprenører og får en hverdag med store tværfaglige grænseflader til blandt andet Elektrificeringsprogrammet, signalsystemer og sporfornyelse.

Vi er i Banedanmark ved at forny hele jernbanen på en gang. Så ikke nok med at du kommer til at arbejde med køreledningsanlæg, så skal der samtidig koordineres med andre områder, som også er ved at forny jernbanen, bl.a. Elektrificeringsprogrammet, signalsystemerne, gennemførelse af sporfornyelser, modernisering af perroner og stationer, ombygning af broer og andre mindre opdaterings- og vedligeholdelsesprojekter på de pågældende strækninger. Der kommer derved en masse tværfagligt arbejde, som gør at man skal holde tungen lige i munden, når man kommer til de forskellige grænseflader.

Projekter, udvikling og faglig indflydelse gennem hele projektforløbet

Du bliver koblet på de projekter, der passer bedst til din erfaring og dine kvalifikationer. Projekterne er alsidige og forskellige af karakter og størrelse. De omfatter både etablering af nye køreledningsanlæg på de strækninger, som endnu ikke er elektrificeret, og udskiftning eller tilpasning af eksisterende køreledningsanlæg ifm. fornyelsesprojekter.

Når du arbejder hos os, vil du opleve at:

  • du får gode muligheder at fordybe dig i dit fagområde
  • du får faglige indflydelser på de tidlige faser på projekter og er med til at definere tekniske løsninger
  • du er med hele vejen på et projekt
  • du får muligheder for at arbejde med opgaver indenfor dine interesser
  • work life balance er højt prioriteret hos os
  • du har gode kollegaer med høje fagligheder, som du kan sparre med

I det daglige vil du typisk referere til projektlederen. Din nærmeste leder bliver sektionschefen for projekteringslederne.

Citat fra projekteringslederne:

”Vi har en høj faglighed i gruppen og er gode til at sparre med hinanden. Der er en god stemning på arbejdet og vi har et godt sammenhold.”

Hvem er du?

Du kommer med en teknisk uddannelsesbaggrund som ingeniør eller lignende og interesserer dig for tekniske anlægsprojekter inden for jernbane eller køreledningsanlæg.

Du kan være relativt ny i din karriere og have lyst til at udvikle dine kompetencer i et stærkt fagligt miljø. Du kan også have nogle års erfaring med projektering, udbudsprocesser, grænsefladekoordinering, projektopfølgning eller projektgranskning fra større anlægsprojekter.

Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring fra leverandør-, rådgiver- eller entreprenørbranchen og gerne fra jernbaneprojekter, men det er ikke et krav.

Uanset din erfaring har du en god teknisk forståelse, arbejder struktureret og formår at bevare overblikket over flere samtidige opgaver. Du trives i samarbejdet med forskellige fagligheder og er god til at skabe relationer på tværs af organisationer og projekter.

Som person er du nysgerrig, løsningsorienteret og har lyst til at bidrage aktivt til de tekniske løsninger. Du kommunikerer ubesværet på dansk og engelsk, både skriftligt og mundtligt.

Hvad tilbyder vi?

Du bliver en del af divisionen Anlægsprogrammer og Strøm, hvor du får omkring 25 fagligt dygtige kolleger og eksterne samarbejdspartnere som sparringspartnere. Her arbejder vi i et uformelt og professionelt miljø med høj faglighed, hjælpsomhed og fokus på samarbejde.

Vi tilbyder en hverdag med spændende og komplekse projekter, hvor du får mulighed for at udvikle dig fagligt og tage ansvar i takt med dine erfaringer og ambitioner. Er du ny i rollen, sikrer vi en grundig introduktion og tæt sparring. Har du erfaring, får du mulighed for at bringe din viden i spil og være med til at præge de tekniske løsninger.

Din arbejdsplads afhænger af din bopæl og kan være på Banedanmarks hovedkontor i København, tæt på Dybbølsbro Station og Fisketorvet, eller på vores kontor i Aalborg, som ligger i gåafstand fra togstationen.

Trivsel og arbejdsglæde er vigtigt for os. Vi tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes, når vi har det godt sammen, hjælper hinanden og udvikler os i fællesskab. Derfor lægger vi stor vægt på et positivt arbejdsmiljø med plads til faglig sparring, personlig udvikling og et godt kollegialt fællesskab.

Løn

Du ansættes efter den til enhver tid gældende overenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og en række akademikerorganisationer for akademikere i staten.

Du indplaceres på baggrund af akademisk anciennitet og erfaring som AC-medarbejder på basistrin eller specialkonsulent jf. gældende overenskomst, som du finder her og Medarbejder- og Kompetencestyrelsens lønoversigt, som du finder her.

Afhængigt af dine kvalifikationer og kompetencer er der mulighed for forhandling af tillæg. Der vil være tilknyttet en arbejdsgiverfinansieret pensionsordning på 18,07 %.

Ansøgning og kontakt

Vil du høre mere om stillingen, så kontakt sektionschef Yuanyuan Yang på tlf.: 2494 4327.

Har du spørgsmål til løn- og ansættelsesvilkår, er du velkommen til at kontakte vores HR-konsulter på mail banedanmarkpersonale@BANE.dk.

Send os gerne dit CV hurtigst muligt, da vi løbende vurderer CV’er og indkalder til samtaler. Går du videre fra de indledende samtaler, vil der blive indhentet referencer fra tidligere arbejdsgiver. Du vil blive informeret inden, at der bliver indhentet en reference.

For at søge stillingen klikker du på linket ”Søg stilling” og følger instruktionerne.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig.

Forskellige perspektiver gør os stærkere. Derfor værdsætter Banedanmark mangfoldighed og opfordrer alle interesserede kandidater, uanset personlig baggrund, til at søge

title: Cleared Senior/Principal R&D Electronics Engineer - High Assurance Product Realization Group, Onsite
description:
About Sandia

Sandia National Laboratories is the nation’s premier science and engineering lab for national security and technology innovation, with teams of specialists focused on cutting-edge work in a broad array of areas. Some of the main reasons we love our jobs:

  • Challenging work with amazing impact that contributes to security, peace, and freedom worldwide
  • Extraordinary co-workers
  • Some of the best tools, equipment, and research facilities in the world
  • Career advancement and enrichment opportunities
  • Flexible work arrangements for many positions include 9/80 (work 80 hours every two weeks, with every other Friday off) and 4/10 (work 4 ten-hour days each week) compressed workweeks, part-time work, and telecommuting (a mix of onsite work and working from home)
  • Generous vacation, strong medical and other benefits, competitive 401k, learning opportunities, relocation assistance and amenities aimed at creating a solid work/life balance*

World-changing technologies. Life-changing careers. Learn more about Sandia at: http://www.sandia.gov


*These benefits vary by job classification.

What Your Job Will Be Like

We are seeking an experienced R&D Electronics Engineer to join our team and support legacy use control products.

Your daily roles and responsibilities will involve:

  • Collaborating with weapon systems colleagues to respond to Unsatisfactory Reports (URs) and Significant Finding Investigations (SFIs)
  • Providing technical support for legacy coded switches and CMS equipment
  • Working with Military Liaison and System partners to resolve PAL-related Unsatisfactory Reports (URs)
  • Evaluating coded switches to support the stockpile assessment
  • Supporting development of Component Assessment Reports (CARs) as needed

Due to the nature of the work, the selected applicant must be able to work onsite 100% of the time.

This role requires occasional travel - typically less than 10% - to support mission-related work.

Applicants on this requisition may be interviewed by multiple organizations at Sandia National Laboratories.

Salary Range

$117,500 - $235,700

*Salary range is estimated, and actual salary will be determined after consideration of the selected candidate's experience and qualifications, and application of any approved geographic salary differential.

Qualifications We Require

  • A Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline and five (5) years of directly relevant experience, or an equivalent combination of directly relevant education and engineering or scientific experience that demonstrates the knowledge, skills, and ability to perform independent research and development.
  • Position requires an active DOE Q-level security clearance or equivalent to start.

Qualifications We Desire

The ideal R&D S&E Electronics Engineer candidate for Sandia National Laboratories will in addition possess the following:

  • Graduate degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a highly related field where an independent research project was a graduation requirement (e.g., independent project, thesis, or dissertation).
  • Demonstrated experience with analog and digital circuit design and analysis.
  • Hands-on experience testing and de-bugging circuitry, with clear mastery of tools such as oscilloscopes, logic/network/spectrum analyzers, function/pulse generators, etc.
  • Proven experience with design and analysis tools (e.g., Matlab and LabVIEW), analog simulation codes (e.g., LTSpice), and HDL simulation codes (e.g.,ModelSim).
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary teams.

Also, for this posting we are seeking individuals with the following experience:

  • Experience with anomaly resolution efforts including URs and SFIs.
  • Knowledge of system designs for currently fielded air-delivered systems.
  • Experience with product realization of electronic systems.
  • Experience with nuclear safety.
  • Experience with analog and digital electronics.
  • Experience with ND chemical compatibility.
  • Experience with materials aging information.
  • Ability to operate laboratory testing equipment.
  • Familiarity with and/or contributions to Stockpile Assessment Reports.
  • Teaching and training skills.

About Our Team

The High Assurance Product Realization group develops embedded and ground support equipment in support of high assurance National Security missions. We are a leader for high-assurance National Security hardware, utilizing current and advanced electronic hardware approaches, tools, and techniques in developing information assurance subsystems. These responsibilities span research, design, development, production liaison, and existing product evaluation for Use Control Applications. Our staff develops custom electronic technologies in support of the DOE/DoD Use Control community and specialize in real-time embedded electronic design solutions with emphasis on security and reliability. The team also has a key role in the development, maturation, and deployment of advanced technologies for next-generation weapon systems and information assurance products.

Posting Duration

This posting will be open for application submissions for a minimum of three (3) calendar days, including the 'posting date'. Sandia reserves the right to extend the posting date at any time.

Security Clearance

Position requires a Department of Energy (DOE) Q security clearance to start, or equivalent active security clearance with another U.S. government agency (e.g., DOD). Sandia is required by DOE directive to conduct a pre-employment drug test and background review that includes checks of personal references, credit, law enforcement records, and employment/education verifications. Applicants for employment need to be able to maintain a DOE Q-level security clearance, which requires U.S. citizenship. If you hold more than one citizenship (i.e., of the U.S. and another country), your ability to obtain a security clearance may be impacted.

Applicants offered employment with Sandia are subject to a federal background investigation to meet the requirements for access to classified information or matter if the duties of the position require a DOE security clearance. Substance abuse or illegal drug use, falsification of information, criminal activity, serious misconduct or other indicators of untrustworthiness can cause a clearance to be denied or terminated by DOE, resulting in the inability to perform the duties assigned and subsequent termination of employment.

EEO

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status and any other protected class under state or federal law.

NNSA Requirements for MedPEDs

If you have a Medical Portable Electronic Device (MedPED), such as a pacemaker, defibrillator, drug-releasing pump, hearing aids, or diagnostic equipment and other equipment for measuring, monitoring, and recording body functions such as heartbeat and brain waves, if employed by Sandia National Laboratories you may be required to comply with NNSA security requirements for MedPEDs.

If you have a MedPED and you are selected for an on-site interview at Sandia National Laboratories, there may be additional steps necessary to ensure compliance with NNSA security requirements prior to the interview date.

title: House Attendant - [YR] Dollywood's DreamMore Resort & Spa - Full Time Year Round
