title: Customer Advisor - 25 Hours
description:
Your role in the JoJo story…

Do you dream of a role where you can make meaningful contributions that finish in days well spent? If you're ready to begin a fabulous adventure and you're passionate about retail, we have the perfect role for you!

Each JoJo store is unique whether that’s trading over two floors, having a quirky layout or being situated in an interesting place. They have a life of their own. Our Unique Selling Point (USP) in this ever-changing retail world is the relationship we build with our customers, many of them loyal to our brand and to their local store team. This is where you come in - you’ll be the face of JoJo providing a fantastic level of customer care and service that we are renowned for and one we pride ourselves in upholding always. You’ll be guiding, informing, and assisting our customers in the correct purchase of our huge range of clothing and products. This could be an expectant parent, an excited grandparent or other friends or family.

Our B Corp principles are so important, and every member of our teams will always uphold them. As we move into a digital retail world, offering an Omni-Channel customer service is expected as this builds on customer loyalty. As such most of our stores offer Ship from Store or Click and Collect options, you will take ownership of preparing and shipping all such orders daily.

A peek into your daily adventures:

  • Assisting our customers in many different and sometimes diverse situations, from bra measuring or discussing our maternity wear, to demonstrating a baby carrier to an intrigued parent.

  • Preparing Omni-Channel orders.

  • Liaising with customers in store or via the phone on Omni-Channel orders.

  • Using our digital or virtual learning platforms to continuously develop your knowledge and retail skills.

  • Embracing new product knowledge or learning to increase sales opportunities.

  • Actively listening to our customers’ needs and working out what the best solution is for them.

  • Taking pride in keeping your store looking immaculate.

A typical week would be 5 x 5 hour shifts however, flexibility is required in line with store requirements.

Skills that make you shine:

  • Previous retail, customer service and sales experience

  • Competent IT skills and excellent systems ability, with an aptitude to pick up new systems quickly.

  • The ability to learn and retain a high level of product information and be able to communicate this effectively to our customers.

  • You’ll need a self-developing mentality and a curiosity to learn new products independently.

  • We don’t like hard sales techniques, but you’ll need to demonstrate a level of sales ability, which includes active listening skills, empathy, and an understanding of our customers’ needs.

  • You’ll be working within a small team; therefore, the ability to work harmoniously and respectfully is important.

  • Working in a retail environment requires a level of flexibility, most of our stores are open 7 days a week.

  • We like to keep our stores looking tip-top, so you’ll have a keen eye for detail and play a key role in maintaining our standard.

Please note: We will only recruit individuals who are 18 or over.

Just to give you a taste of our culture, we’ll be looking for you to:

  • Be a brand ambassador, safeguarding our values and ethos.

  • Demonstrate honesty and respect in every interaction.

  • Foster collaboration and open, active listening

  • Take ownership of all aspects of the role.

Perks and Benefits:

  • Extra day of annual leave for each year you’re with us, up to 38 days.

  • Is it your birthday? Take it off and celebrate!

  • Let’s celebrate JoJo doing well – non-contractual bonus scheme.

  • Helping plan for the future - enhanced pension scheme.

  • Get on the move - cycle to work scheme.

  • Financial wellbeing app - pay yourself 40% of your earned wages whenever you want.

  • Saving scheme with Smart Money Cymru – You do not need to live in Wales!

  • Flexible work options.

  • Enjoy fabulous social events.

  • Give back with volunteer days to support our communities.

  • Prioritise your well-being with our Health and Wellbeing hub.

  • Specsavers voucher – Get a free sight test and contribution towards glasses (T & C’s) apply.

  • We love our products! Enjoy:

    • 40% off JoJo branded lines

    • 25% off full-price NEXT products

    • 10% off NEXT Beauty products

    • Up to 10% off most branded products

  • Embrace an “It’s up to you” learning environment with ongoing training and development opportunities.

Want to know more about JoJo?

We make happy and helpful clothes and products that let children be children – in all their silly, messy, adventurous, noisy, imaginative joy. But we’re not just about selling products; we’re about creating a warm, community-centric environment for our employees and our customers. From 39 locations across the UK and Ireland and a thriving e-commerce platform, we offer a meticulously designed collection of children’s clothing, toys, and essentials designed with love and care: always with children at the forefront of our minds.

As a B Corp, our commitment goes beyond commerce, we strive for a sustainable future and take pride in our responsibilities to the planet and our communities. At JoJo, every role, every task and every day is an opportunity to support, inspire and contribute to the well-being of our teams and our customers.

We embrace and openly welcome people from different cultures, perspectives, and experiences to create a diverse and enriched environment. We work hard to recruit, develop, and retain the most talented people, regardless of background to make sure we grow our company sustainably and with different cultural influences. By encouraging a diverse and inclusive workforce, we aim to create an environment where everyone can thrive and reach their full potential.

title: Millwork Crew Leader
description:
Boise Cascade has an exciting opening for a Millwork Crew Leader. Please review the responsibilities and needed qualifications below and apply today!

Shift: Swing - Noon - 8:30pm

Responsibilities

  • Crew Leaders perform daily activities for a millwork facility.
  • Perform distribution-related functions (receiving, storing, and shipping/building of loads).
  • Operate forklift.
  • Ensure load matches order prior to vehicle exiting yard.
  • Perform customer service activities.
  • Incumbents have broad knowledge of building material products and warehouse operations.
  • May train, assign and oversee work of others and ensure work is complete and built to order specifications.
  • Possess alertness and ability to adapt to warehouse routines.
  • Understand and apply fundamental mathematical calculations (addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division).
  • May be responsible for raw materials and finished goods inventory, and materials order replenishment.
  • Maintain good housekeeping in work area.
  • Follow safety programs and ensure compliance of OSHA regulation.
  • Crew Leaders will help plan the daily workflow.
  • Demonstrate strong commitment to safety, quality, environmental awareness, and continuous process improvement.
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications: HS Diploma, GED or two (2) years equivalent work experience. Must be able to understand and communicate safety and other work-related instructions. Warehouse/yard operations environment with considerable physical exertion. Performs duties in all weather conditions.

Preferred Qualifications: Typically more than five (5) years of experience in related job function. Role may require technical certification or associates degree. Possess an in-depth knowledge of building materials products, warehouse operations, and/or BMD products/operations. Possesses ability to understand and apply fundamental mathematical calculations. Demonstrates accuracy in checking, posting, counting, addition, subtraction, fractions, and linear measurement. Must exhibit good personal interaction and supervisory skills.

About Boise Cascade

Boise Cascade has been in the business of distributing building materials and manufacturing wood products for decades. Today we're the only wholesale stocking distributor for building products that can service the entire United States – and one of the largest manufacturers of plywood and engineered wood products in North America. Because our business is built on relationships, our associates are critical to our success. Our people-centered approach to associate experience and engagement is rooted in our Core Values. We're invested in cultivating a respectful workplace culture that attracts, connects, grows, and retains a talented workforce – one where everyone feels seen, heard, and valued.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to have a positive impact on all areas of your life – from health and well-being, career, and community, to financial security and personal safety, with many benefits beginning on your first day of employment. We call it, Total Rewards. Here's a snapshot of what we offer:

  • Medical + Prescription Drug
  • Dental + Vision
  • Flexible Spending Accounts (Healthcare + Dependent Care)
  • 401(k) Retirement Savings with company contribution
  • Paid Time Off (20 days per year)
  • Paid Holidays (10 per year)
  • Paid Parental Leave (6 weeks)
  • Life Insurance

title: Technical Product Specialist, Software Applications
description:
_Are you motivated by becoming the technical expert behind products and solutions that support clean water and energy? Do you thrive in a role where you connect technical development, business needs, and customer requirements? Are you excited by the opportunity to influence products throughout their entire lifecycle while collaborating with stakeholders across the organization?

**Here Is What The Job Entails

**In the role as our next Technical Product Specialist within our software applications, your job will be to provide technical expertise across the product lifecycle while ensuring that products, solutions, and technical documentation remain accurate, compliant, and competitive.

More specifically you will be:

  • Acting as the technical liaison between Research and Development, Sales, Customer Service, Supply Chain, and other stakeholders
  • Providing technical support including tender support, sales support, product training, and advanced troubleshooting
  • Serving as the technical expert on products, configurations, software solutions, and applications
  • Maintaining technical product information and documentation
  • Supporting product lifecycle activities including new product development, maintenance, and phase in and phase out activities

You will experience the freedom to act and leave your mark on how we manage and support our products throughout their lifecycle. Therefore, you will work closely with technical and commercial stakeholders across the organization, gain deep insight into our products and technologies, and play a key role in ensuring knowledge sharing, product adoption, and continuous improvement.

**Meet your future team

**With direct reference to Senior Manager, Technical Product Management, you will become part of the technical product management team. As a team, we are committed to ensuring our products remain technically accurate, competitive, and capable of meeting both market and business requirements, and you will have a key role in achieving this. In the team you will experience close collaboration with colleagues across product management, development, customer service, sales, and supply chain. Together we support products throughout their lifecycle while ensuring strong stakeholder engagement and knowledge sharing across the organization.

Did you know? As a Technical Product Specialist, you will work with stakeholders from many different functions, making every day an opportunity to learn something new about our products, technologies, and customers.

**Less About Us, More About You

**We are looking for a Technical Product Specialist who is ready to take ownership of technical product activities and who is motivated by solving complex challenges. You achieve this through strong collaboration skills, technical curiosity, and a structured approach to your work.

In order to succeed, we imagine that you:

  • Hold a degree in Engineering within Electronics, Software, Mechatronics, or a similar field.
  • Have an understanding of product development, product lifecycle management, and technical product support
  • Have experience with, or an understanding of, software-related systems such as Swagger documentation, Jira, Confluence or comparable platforms. A general end-to-end understanding of hardware and connectivity along with insights to APIsis an advantage.
  • Demonstrate strong analytical and problem-solving skills combined with the ability to communicate technical information clearly
  • Have experience with product related systems such as Configure Price Quote, Product Lifecycle Management, Enterprise Resource Planning, or similar platforms.

We also value experience developing and delivering technical training and knowledge sharing activities

As we are an international organization it is important that you are fluent in English.

Whilst you may not meet all the qualifications listed above, you could still be a good candidate for the position. If you find the role intriguing, do not hesitate to apply.

**We are more than the ordinary workplace

**We cherish the good colleagueship which we all contribute to, the only limit is your engagement. As we are a big organization you are bound to find one or more colleagues who share the same interest as you. This might be in our board game club, cycle team, during our yearly summer festival or on the padel court. For example, is our Head of System Engineering and Information Technology Denmark also our volunteer padel instructor while our Software Test Engineer runs weekly spinning classes.

Besides the best colleagues you could imagine, we also offer:

  • Work life balance through flexible working hours
  • Employee benefits including a healthy canteen, fitness facilities, in house dental clinic, hairdresser, and a free health clinic
  • An active employee association that fosters a collaborative and supportive workplace community
  • Beneficial health care and insurance package

**Do you want to be a part of Kamstrup?

**Please submit your application by using the link below. Applications are reviewed on a continuous basis, and you can expect a response within six weeks.

The job will be located at Kamstrup's headquarters in Stilling, between Aarhus and Skanderborg.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Senior Manager, Technical Product Management, Kirsten Sahl, by phone: +45 89 93 10 00.

**Get to know us

**At Kamstrup, you'll become part of a close-knit community that genuinely cares about one another, fostering connections both in and out of the workplace. Our team comprises innovators, dreamers, and doers, united by an unyielding passion to challenge the status quo, find better solutions, and constantly push the boundaries of what's possible all with the purpose of securing clean water and energy to the maximum number of people. With an unwavering commitment to growth, we offer opportunities for you to leverage your skills and drive our business to new heights, empowering you to leave your mark on our future and grow with us. Explore more on our website, see our annual report, and stay updated through LinkedIn for the latest news and job openings.

title: Hoteldirektør, Scandic Opus Horsens
description:
ER DU VORES NYE HOTELDIREKTØR TIL SCANDIC OPUS HORSENS?

Vi søger en hoteldirektør, der kan kombinere forretningsforståelse, nærværende ledelse og passion for gæsteoplevelsen.

Scandic Opus Horsens er et hotel med en solid position blandt både konferencegæster, forretningsrejsende og weekendgæster. Hotellet er kendt for sine smukke omgivelser, sit høje serviceniveau og et engageret team, der hver dag arbejder for at skabe oplevelser, som gæsterne husker og vender tilbage til.

Du overtager ledelsen af et hotel med en stærk kultur, dygtige og erfarne medarbejdere og med mange stamgæster. Din vigtigste opgave bliver at videreudvikle det, som allerede fungerer godt, samtidig med at du skaber nye muligheder ved at få fortalt de gode historier og styrket hotellets position i markedet.

Vi søger en tydelig og inspirerende leder, der evner at sætte retning og skabe engagement. En som tager ansvar for både drift og udvikling, har et sikkert overblik og formår at omsætte strategiske mål til konkrete resultater – sammen med teamet. Som leder er du positiv, imødekommende og skaber god energi omkring dig. Du får ting til at ske – og du gør det med en tilgang, der inspirerer andre til at følge med.

Som hoteldirektør skal du bl.a.:

  • Sikre høj gæstetilfredshed og videreudvikling af gæsterejsen
  • Skabe stærke relationer, der motiverer og engagerer dine medarbejdere
  • Have et kommercielt drive hvor du engagerer dig i det lokale netværk og sikrer kendskab til hotellet hos virksomheder i nærområdet
  • Drive og sikre høj kvalitet gennem Scandics standarder – og samtidig skabe og udvikle lokale initiativer
  • Skabe resultater gennem samarbejde, tydelig kommunikaiton og handlekraft

Dine kvalifikationer

  • Du har solid hotel- og ledelseserfaring og er parat til at yde en ekstra indsats for at drive og udvikle hotellerne sammen med de respektive teams
  • Du har indgående kendskab og erfaring med salg og F&B
  • Du er vant til at arbejde analytisk med resultatopfølgning og anvendelse af økonomiske systemer
  • Du er en værdsat og visionær leder, der ved, hvordan man motiverer og inspirerer teams til at yde deres bedste for at servicere hotellets gæster
  • Engelskkundskaber i skrift og tale forudsættes

Vi tilbyder

  • At træde ind i nordens største hotelkæde og blive en del af et meget stærkt netværk af dygtige og kompetente kolleger
  • En spændende mulighed for faglig og personlig udvikling i en virksomhed, som konstant er i udvikling nationalt og internationalt
  • Landets bedste kolleger som alle arbejder med tydeligt afsæt i vores fire værdier "be caring", "be you", "be a pro" og "be bold"
  • Den fedeste kultur, hvor vi vil hinanden det godt, hvor der er plads til alle, uanset hvor vi kommer fra, og hvor vi har det sjovt
  • Favorable personalegoder, herunder Team Member Card som giver dig rabatter på overnatning på Scandics hoteller og en god sundhedsforsikring

Vi inviterer løbende til samtaler og hoteldirektørstillingen er med henblik på jobstart den 1. februar 2027.

Scandic er en mangfoldig arbejdsplads, og vi opfordrer alle til at søge uanset køn, alder, etnicitet, religion, seksualitet eller funktionsnedsættelse.

Vi har mange fordele

  • En omsorgsfuld arbejdsplads

  • Fair og konkurrencedygtige vilkår

  • Gode ophold, mad og partnerfordele

  • Muligheder for udvikling

  • Støtte til dit velbefindende – og fleksibilitet til livet

  • Arbejd på tværs af grænser og roller

Om Scandic

Det hele starter med dig
At arbejde på et af vores hoteller handler om at være en del af et team, hvor omtanke for hinanden, samarbejde og hverdagens små øjeblikke gør en forskel. Du er med til at skabe den særlige følelse af hjem, der kendetegner Scandic – ved at være til stede her og nu og sørge for at selv små detaljer gør en forskel.

Nogle dage går det stærkt, andre er mere forudsigelige – og ikke to dage er ens. Men det gennemgående for alle dage er teamwork. Vi træder til og hjælper hinanden, løser problemer, når de opstår, og er stolte af at levere kvalitet – selv når tempoet er højt. Og når vi gør det, nyder gæsterne ikke bare deres ophold – de får lyst til at komme tilbage.

Sådan arbejder vi hos Scandic
Vi er bedst, når vi arbejder sammen – på tværs af roller, hoteller og teams – og fokuserer på det, der gør en reel forskel i hverdagen. Vores værdier guider os til, hvordan møder hinanden og leverer: Be Pro, Be Bold, Be Caring og Be You.

Hvis du synes, at ægte gæstfrihed skabes gennem samarbejde, at gøre sig umage – hver gang – og små gode øjeblikke, vil du føle dig hjemme hos os.

title: Manager, Database Administration
description:
THE POSITION:

The Manager, Database Administration provides strategic and operational leadership for enterprise database services across on-premises, hybrid, and multi-cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) environments. This individual leads a team of database professionals responsible for the availability, performance, security, scalability, and continuous improvement of critical business data platforms.

This role is accountable for developing and executing the enterprise database services strategy, including cloud modernization, operational excellence, automation, capacity planning, and database lifecycle management. The manager oversees service delivery, project intake, resource allocation, and operational priorities while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Working closely with Cloud Engineering, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Systems Engineering, Network Engineering, Security, Architecture, and Application Development teams, this leader ensures database services are reliable, secure, cost-effective, and aligned with evolving business requirements.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical foundations with people leadership, sound judgment, strategic thinking, and a passion for developing high-performing teams.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
Our employees are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of their teams. These results are achieved by:

  • Lead and Develop a High-Performing Database Administration Team: Provide leadership, coaching, mentoring, and professional development for database professionals. Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and accountable team culture that promotes technical excellence, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement.
  • Drive Enterprise Database Strategy and Modernization: Develop and execute a database technology roadmap supporting enterprise architecture standards, cloud adoption, application modernization, and business growth. Guide the evolution of database services across on-premises, hybrid, and cloud platforms, including Microsoft SQL Server, Azure, AWS, GCP, and emerging database technologies.
  • Ensure Database Reliability, Performance, and Operational Excellence: Oversee the availability, performance, capacity, security, and lifecycle management of enterprise database platforms. Establish operational standards for proactive monitoring, incident management, patching, backup and recovery, high availability, and disaster recovery to support business continuity and service reliability.
  • Manage Service Delivery, Resource Planning, and Operational Priorities: Direct database project intake, work prioritization, resource allocation, and service request management. Balance operational commitments with strategic initiatives, establish clear service ownership and accountability, and ensure effective communication with business and technology stakeholders.
  • Advance Automation, DevOps, and Database Engineering Practices: Champion database automation, Infrastructure as Code, standardized deployments, configuration management, and continuous integration and delivery practices. Partner with engineering teams to improve database provisioning, change management, release processes, and operational efficiency.
  • Strengthen Architecture, Security, and Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Application Development, Enterprise Architecture, Cloud Engineering, DevOps/SRE, and Information Security teams to establish scalable, secure, and supportable database solutions. Provide technical guidance on database architecture, performance optimization, access controls, data protection, and regulatory compliance, including HIPAA and the protection of sensitive information.
  • Drive Continuous Improvement, Financial Accountability, and Risk Reduction: Identify opportunities to simplify the database technology landscape, optimize infrastructure and licensing costs, reduce technical debt, and improve operational resilience. Establish meaningful service performance indicators, communicate risks and improvement opportunities to leadership, and support informed technology investment decisions.
  • Demonstrate the Core Values of Eversana, but specifically “Always Innovate”
  • All other duties as assigned

Consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and applicable state and local laws, it is the policy of EVERSANA to provide reasonable accommodation when requested by an employee with a disability, unless such accommodation would cause an undue hardship for EVERSANA. If reasonable accommodation is needed to perform the essential functions of your job position, please contact Human Resources.

EXPECTATIONS OF THE JOB:

  • Travel 10%*
  • Hours 40 per week, 5 days of the week

The above list reflects the general details necessary to describe the expectations of the position and shall not be construed as the only expectations that may be assigned for the position.

An individual in this position must be able to successfully perform the expectations listed above.

MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

The requirements listed below are representative of the experience, education, knowledge, skill and/or abilities required.

  • 7+ years of progressive experience in database administration, database engineering, or enterprise data platform operations, including 3+ years of technical team leadership or people management.
  • Demonstrated experience leading database operations in a complex enterprise environment, including team development, resource planning, service management, and operational prioritization.
  • Strong technical foundation in Microsoft SQL Server administration, including high availability, performance management, security, backup and recovery, and database lifecycle management.
  • Working knowledge of cloud database services and architectures across at least one major public cloud platform, such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, and/or Google Cloud.
  • Understanding of database security, access management, data protection, disaster recovery, and operational risk management.
  • Familiarity with modern DevOps practices, automation, version control, CI/CD, and infrastructure management.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate technical challenges into business risks and actionable recommendations.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives, manage competing priorities, and drive continuous improvement.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience managing database services across multiple public cloud platforms, particularly AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud.
  • Experience with cloud-native and managed database technologies, such as Amazon RDS, Amazon Aurora, Azure SQL, Google Cloud SQL, and Google BigQuery.
  • Familiarity with NoSQL and distributed database platforms, including MongoDB and MongoDB Atlas.
  • Experience supporting data warehousing, analytics, or enterprise data platforms.
  • Knowledge of database automation and Infrastructure as Code using technologies such as Terraform, PowerShell, Python, or equivalent tools.
  • Familiarity with modern database DevOps practices, including schema version control, automated deployments, and CI/CD integration.
  • Experience with database observability, performance optimization, capacity management, and proactive reliability engineering.
  • Experience developing technology roadmaps, managing infrastructure costs, and supporting cloud migration or database modernization initiatives.
  • Experience working in regulated industries such as healthcare, life sciences, or financial services, including familiarity with HIPAA and related data protection requirements.
  • Experience with database platforms running on Windows Server and Linux.
  • Relevant cloud, database, or technology leadership certifications.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

title: ML Systems Engineer – Framework Integration
description:
Who we are

Roofline is building a Deployment Platform to run any model on disruptive hardware at the edge. As a Systems Engineer, you’ll own the path from a model in a framework to fast code on the target, across every layer in between. You’ll find where things break, fix them at the root, and set the technical direction that keeps our engineering teams aligned.

Why us?

  • The opportunity to grow. Be at the forefront of building and shaping an industry-defining venture. There are plenty of opportunities to learn and evolve.
  • The team succeeded. We are building the leading AI compiler team in Europe. Join our future-focused team to contribute to meaningful, disruptive innovations with us.
  • The flexibility you need. Whether you need to take extra time off, adjust your schedule, or have other ideas to maximize your productivity, we’ve got your back
  • The compensation that rewards. We are looking for world class talent and pay accordingly. We offer equity for every employee since we truly want you to participate in our success.
  • The culture you desire. We actively make space to build our culture. We organize dedicated regular events and retreats for the whole team.

Your mission

  • Own the path from a model in a ML framework down to running fast on a target hardware. Work at all levels of the software stack with a wide understanding of everything from quantization to compiler abstractions to final target code generation.
  • Bring up reference models using Roofline's deployment tools, pinpoint which component an issue really lives in, and make sure it’s fixed at the root.
  • Set technical direction across multiple teams for ML, compiler, runtime, and architecture based on your first-hand data. Define contracts and interfaces between the layers and keep the teams aligned to them.
  • Turn your findings into products. Reflect on recurring blockers to craft solutions that benefit our customers and help improve our SDK. Think ahead to make sure that we always support the latest models and applications.
  • Interacting with open-source community in the ML space (e.g. PyTorch)
  • Raise the level of the engineers around you. Mentor junior engineers and help to maintain the best technical culture for the company.

Your profile

  • Several years of hands-on experience in AI and embedded systems.
  • Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related fields.
  • Deep practical expertise in C/C++ and Python
  • End-to-end experience with an accelerator toolchain for NPUs, DSPs, or GPUs spanning their compiler, runtime, kernel libraries and memory models.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills to align other engineers through clear ideas, abstractions, and design docs.
  • Demonstrated technical influence beyond your own deliverables. Have product changes you argued for and got shipped, engineers you've mentored, or practices a team adopted because you established them.
  • Ambition and curiosity to solve complex problems, a strong mindset to take ownership and drive our solutions forwards, and a collaborative attitude to foster our culture.

Nice to haves:
  • Experience working with hardware or architecture teams, and an understanding of how their approaches to problems and processes differ from software teams’.
  • Experience working with PyTorch, ONNX, Tensorflow
  • Experience shipping an accelerated model into production under real constraints for applications such as automotive, medical, industrial or consumer where memory budgets, certification and time budgets apply.

title: Program Manager
description:
General Job Information

Job Summary

This position is located at the Department of Employment Services (DOES), Office of Unemployment Compensation (OUC), American Job Centers (AJCs). The OUC Program Manager for the AJCs provides strategic leadership, operational oversight, and program management for the OUC component of the District's American Job Center, ensuring the seamless delivery of the District’s Unemployment Compensation Services alongside federal workforce initiatives funded by the Workforce Innovation and Opportunity Act (WIOA), Wagner-Peyser, and related federal statutes. This dual focused role’s primary charge is to integrate unemployment compensation systems with federal reemployment programs to minimize the duration of UI claims and accelerate the return-to-work timeline.

The incumbent is responsible for overseeing OUC AJC operations, supervising UI AJC leadership and ensuring programmatic compliance with the District’s Unemployment Compensation Act, the Workforce Innovation and Opportunity Act (WIOA) of 2014, the Rehabilitation Act of 1973, U.S. Department of Labor requirements, and all applicable federal and District laws, regulations, policies and program standards.

Duties and Responsibilities

Plans, organizes, and supervises the operation of a program(s) and its activities in accordance with the mission and goals of an agency; develops new programs to support the strategic direction of the agency; advises and consults with administration/division managers; meets with appropriate staff to identify and resolve problems or conflicts; makes or recommends final decisions regarding policy, operations, and administrative procedures of the program.

Establishes and manages long-and short-term program goals; develops, analyzes, and evaluates new or modified program/management policies, regulations, goals, or objectives. Develops, implements and maintains complex procedures, administrative monitoring practices and controls in order to obtain smooth and effective operation of a program(s); coordinates work activities of the program to prevent delays in required actions or to improve programs or services; identifies, develops and implements departmental goals, objectives, policies, and priorities; determines resource allocation and levels of service.

Qualifications and Education

Specialized Experience: Experience that equipped the applicant with the particular knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform successfully the duties of the position, and that is typically in or related to the work of the position to be filled. To be creditable, one (1) year of specialized experience must have been equivalent to at least the next lower grade level in the normal line of progression.

Degree from a four-year college or university and at least five years of supervisory experience preferred.

Licensures, Certifications, and other requirements

None

Work Conditions/Environment

The work is performed in a normal office setting.

Other Significant Facts

Tour of Duty: Monday-Friday 8:30 am- 5:00 pm or Varies

Operating Status: In-Person reporting, flexible and limited telework options available upon position eligibility and operational needs.

Promotion Potential: No known promotion potential

Duration of Appointment: Management Supervisory Service (MSS), At-will. Positions in the Management Supervisory Service serve at the pleasure of the appointing authority and may be terminated at any time with or without cause.

Pay Plan, Series and Grade: MS-0301-14

Salary: $114,441- $160,216; Based on qualifications and funding

Collective Bargaining Unit (Union): This position is not covered by a Collective Bargaining Unit.

Position Designation: This position has been designated as Security sensitive therefore the incumbent of this position will be subject to enhanced suitability screening pursuant to Chapter 4 of DC Personnel Regulations, Suitability and as such, incumbents of this position shall be subject to criminal background checks, background investigations, and mandatory drug and alcohol testing, as applicable.

Residency Preference: Applicants claiming “Residency Preference” will be required to maintain residency in the District of Columbia for a minimum of seven (7) years. Failure to do so may result in forfeiture of employment.

Residency Requirement: If the position you are applying for is in the Career, Management Supervisory, or Educational Service at an annual salary of one hundred fifty thousand dollars ($150,000) or more, you must establish residency in the District of Columbia within one hundred eighty (180) days of the effective date of the appointment and continue to maintain residency within the District of Columbia throughout the duration of the appointment.

EEO Statement: The District of Columbia Government does not discriminate or retaliate in employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, family responsibilities, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, homeless status, disability, genetic information, age, membership in an employee organization, participation in a legally protected activity, parental status, matriculation, personal appearance, credit information, status as a victim or family member of a victim of domestic violence, sexual offense, or stalking, military service, or other non-merit factor.

title: GRILL SUPERVISOR-CRRHC
location: COMANCHE RED RIVER HOTEL CASINO - DEVOL, OK 73531-4264
description:
SCOPE OF POSITION:


The Grill Supervisor is responsible for the effective management and operating of the Grill/Café and will assist the Grill Manager to oversee the direction of the Grill/Cafe’s daily activities in accordance with CNE policies and procedures. The Grill Supervisor’s performance is necessary to ensure guest satisfaction, profitability and a positive, productive and compliant work environment. DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: The following are major duties and are not intended to be all-inclusive or restrictive.
•Assist the Grill Manager to hone employee skills, supplement training and development to Grill/Café employees by working side-by-side with them.
•Assist the Grill Manager with subordinate performance reviews and counseling sessions when necessary.
•Provide leadership and support to the entire Grill/Café staff; builds morale and encourages empowerment of employees.
•Maintains a positive and compliant employee relations climate, promotes support and communication with all employees and assists the Grill Manager with maintaining a positive work environment.
•Reinforce expectations, procedures and practices through repetition and strong communication, leads by example and continuesinstruction to employees to guarantee exceptional quality and consistency of food concepts, the final product and guest service.
•Assists the Grill Manager with employee recordkeeping duties such as variances, timecards and employee attendance records.
•Assist the Grill Manager with disciplinary decisions, including recommending employment actions such as hiring, or suspension.
•Assist the Grill Manager with end of month food inventory
•Assists the Grill Manager with controlling labor costs through effective scheduling of Grill/Café employees, implementing cross-training and development of employees.
•Responsible for ensuring that food waste is limited through effective control measures including portion controls, kitchen timings,food inventory rotation measures, receiving and food storage procedures and waste control.
•Ensures that the purchasing, when needed, and the preparation of all food products meet CNE’s standards of quality and consistency.
•Supervises all line set-up, prep, and breakdown activities. Responsible for in-service delegation of tasks to Grill/Café personnel.
•Monitors production of food preparation ensuring recipe specifications, portion controls and kitchen timings are met.
•Monitors all food served relative to appearance, temperature, sanitary and quality standards.
•Assists Grill Manager with end of month item inventory, as needed or requested.
•Ensures compliance with health, sanitation, safety and employment regulations by clearly communicating and reinforcing standardsand procedures to Grill/Café employees.

• Coordinates the storage, maintenance, and repair of all kitchen equipment to ensure operational readiness.
• Assists with the delivery and set-up of catered services and food service areas as needed.
• Performs other duties as assigned.

PHYSICAL & ENVIRONMENTAL DEMANDS:
The Grill Supervisor is regularly required to stand or sit in a stationary position for half or more of their shift, communicate, and exchange
Information with coworkers and guests, and maintain the Grill/Cafe area and personnel. The Grill Supervisor must reach with hands and
arms, sit; climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The Grill Supervisor is regularly required to do light lifting of objects up to
75 pounds. Work is performed throughout all areas of the facility where the noise levels vary from quiet to loud depending on the time of
day, the specific location, and the amount of business. The Grill Supervisor must be able and willing to work evenings, weekends, and
holidays in a smoke-filled environment. The workplace is also under constant surveillance both inside and outside the facility.
The Grill Supervisor may be exposed to the risks associated with resolving contentious issues with difficult guests and staff members.
Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals to perform essential functions.

ACKNOWLEDGMENTS:

I have read this position description and certify that I can perform the duties and responsibilities, with or without an accommodation, and understand and accept the physical and environmental demands.

title: Vil du være med til at forme fremtidens naturvejledere?
company: KU - SCIENCE - S og L - Eldrupgård
description:
Skovskolen, Københavns Universitet, søger en underviser til naturvejlederuddannelsen på Djursland.

Brænder du for naturvejledning og for at bringe mennesker tættere på naturen gennem formidling, læring og oplevelser? Har du erfaring med undervisning og lyst til at udvikle både mennesker og uddannelse? Så er du måske vores nye kollega på Skovskolen Djursland.

Naturvejlederuddannelsen er i udvikling, og vi søger en engageret underviser, der også vil bidrage til at koordinere og videreudvikle uddannelsen på Djursland og styrke sammenhængen med Skovskolen i Nødebo.

Du skal have lyst til at undervise og udvikle naturvejledningens faglige fundament ved at bringe formidling, pædagogik, didaktik og naturdannelse i spil.

Om skovskolen
Skovskolen er det praksisrettede uddannelsessted for skov, landskab, urbane miljøer samt frilufts- og naturvejledning. Studerende, elever og kursister på Skovskolen opbygger kompetencer til et arbejdsliv, der er tæt koblet til naturen. Som naturens, skovenes og de grønne bymiljøers kommende vejledere, ledere, forvaltere og håndværkere forholder de sig aktivt til vilde udfordringer som naturdannelse, biodiversitet, klima og bæredygtig praksis. Med et blik for at få ting til at ske lærer de at handle både selvstændigt og i samarbejde med andre. For at forberede på praktisk håndtering af vilde udfordringer, skal Skovskolens uddannelser være baseret på Danmarks vildeste undervisning – ude i praksis, ude i naturen og sammen med omverdenen.

Dine opgaver

Vi forestiller os, at du kan:

  • Undervise på uddannelsens moduler, særligt Naturvejlederen, Økologi, biodiversitet og projektudvikling, afgangsprojekter og relevante specialiseringsmoduler.
  • Koordinere og udvikle naturvejlederuddannelsen på Djursland i tæt samarbejde med studielederen i Nødebo.
  • Sikre sammenhæng mellem moduler, undervisere og uddannelsessteder samt bidrage til kvalitetssikring af undervisningen
  • Sparre med eksterne undervisere og understøtte planlægning og praktisk afvikling af undervisningen.
  • Udvikle faglige netværk, synliggøre uddannelsen i Jylland og koordinere faglige arrangementer
  • Bidrage til øvrige undervisnings- og udviklingsaktiviteter på Skovskolen Djursland i tråd med dine kompetencer og erfaringer.
Din profil

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har erfaring med undervisning af voksne og gerne med uddannelsesudvikling eller projektkoordinering.
  • Har et solidt fagligt og teoretisk fundament inden for naturvejledning, formidling, pædagogik og didaktik.
  • Har kendskab til naturvejlederfeltet og et netværk i Jylland – eller lyst og evne til at opbygge det.
  • Arbejder struktureret og selvstændigt og trives med undervisning, samarbejde og koordinering
Din uddannelsesbaggrund kan eksempelvis være inden for naturvejledning, biologi, lærerfaget, skov og landskab eller et andet relevant område.

Vi tilbyder
En deltidsstilling, hvor du underviser samtidig med at du får mulighed for at præge udviklingen af naturvejlederuddannelsen og styrke forbindelsen mellem naturvejledningens faglige miljøer og uddannelsen på Skovskolen Djursland og i Nødebo. Du bliver en del af et engageret fagligt miljø med fokus på naturforståelse, formidling, læring og uddannelse.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår
Stillingen er en deltidsstilling på 15–20 timer om ugen med primært arbejdssted på Skovskolen Djursland. Tiltrædelsesdato 1. januar eller snarest muligt herefter.

Ansættelse sker på en af tre af følgende stillingskategorier:

Hvis du har en kandidatuddannelse, vil du blive ansat som enten studieadjunkt eller studielektor. Her vil ansættelse og aflønning ske efter overenskomst mellem Skatteministeriet og Akademikere i staten, samt i henhold til gældende stillingsstruktur for videnskabeligt personale ved universiteter.
Indplaceringen sker efter konkret bedømmelse af sagkyndige bedømmere. Hvis ansættelsen sker som studieadjunkt, vil det være med henblik på opkvalificering til studielektorniveau.

Hvis du har uddannelse som urban landskabsingeniør eller lignende som højeste færdiggjorte uddannelse, vil du blive ansat som underviser. I dette tilfælde vil ansættelse og aflønning ske efter overenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og Lærernes Centralorganisation og CO10 – Centralorganisationen af 2010 (LC/CIO 10-fællesoverenskomsten) og efter Organisationsaftalen for Skov- og landskabsingeniører.

For alle tre stillingskategorier gælder det at løn fastsættes efter principperne om ny løn, hvor der er mulighed for forhandling af tillæg afhængig af dine kvalifikationer og erfaring.
Du kan læse mere om lønniveauer i staten på .

Ansættelsesområdet er Københavns Universitet og med Skovskolen, Eldrupvej 2, 8963 Auning som tjenestested. Stillingen er en deltidsstilling.

Du indgår i Skovskolens samlede gruppe af undervisere med reference til Studieleder for Efteruddannelse og Urban landskabsingeniør.

Der er gode udviklingsmuligheder i jobbet og vi prioriterer faglig og pædagogisk kompetenceudvikling højt.

Universitetet ønsker at afspejle det omgivende samfund og opfordrer alle uanset personlig baggrund til at søge stillingen.

Ansøgning
Er du interesseret i stillingen, beder vi dig sende en elektronisk ansøgning med bilag via jobportalen.

Vær opmærksom på, når du trykker ”søg stillingen” skal du vælge den stillingskategori, der passer til din uddannelsesbaggrund:
Hvis du har en kandidatuddannelse, skal du søge på studieadjunkt/-lektor, eller hvis du har en uddannelse som skov- og landskabsingeniør eller lign., skal du søge på underviser.

Vedlæg venligst til ansøgningsmaterialet:

  • Ansøgningen
  • CV
  • Dokumentation for relevant uddannelse
  • Evt. dokumentation for bestået universitetspædagogikum (til vurdering af studieadjunkt/-lektorniveau)
Ansøgningsfristen er 30. november 2026. 23:59 CEST.
Samtaler forventes afholdt umiddelbart efter.

Yderligere information
Yderligere oplysninger om job, ansættelsesforhold og arbejdssted fås ved henvendelse til Studieleder Maja Steen Møller på telefon 35336776.

Det Natur- og Biovidenskabelige Fakultet på Københavns Universitet – SCIENCE i kort form – er landets største naturvidenskabelige forsknings- og uddannelsesinstitution med 4.000 ansatte og 9.700 bachelor- og kandidatstuderende fordelt på 12 institutter. Fakultetet har et årligt budget på ca. 3 mia. kr.

title: Communications and Training Specialist - Mid
description:
With a company culture rooted in collaboration, expertise and innovation, we aim to promote progress and inspire our clients, employees, investors and communities to achieve their greatest potential. Our work is the catalyst that helps others achieve their goals. In short, We Enable Possibility℠.

The Communications and Training Specialist is responsible for developing, coordinating, and continuously improving end-user communications, training, and technology adoption initiatives within Global End User Support.

The role provides a consistent and user-focused approach to both Major Incident and Standard IT communications, helping ensure that employees receive clear, timely, accurate, and actionable information regarding IT services, incidents, changes, and technology initiatives.

The incumbent also develops scalable end-user learning and adoption solutions designed to improve workforce productivity, increase awareness and adoption of IT capabilities, strengthen user confidence with technology, increase self-service capabilities, and reduce avoidable support demand.

This position works collaboratively with Global End User Support, Major Incident Management, technology teams, project teams, and other business stakeholders to translate technical information into communications and learning experiences that are understandable and relevant to end users.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES AND ACCOUNTABILITIES

IT Communications

  • Develop, implement, maintain, and continuously improve the end-user IT communications process for Major Incidents, planned activities, service changes, system updates, IT initiatives, and other standard communications.
  • Develop clear, concise, professional, and user-focused communications that translate technical information into language appropriate for end users.
  • Establish and maintain standard communication templates and guidelines to promote consistency in messaging across Global End User Support.
  • Coordinate with Major Incident Management and relevant technical teams to support timely and accurate end-user communications during service disruptions.
  • Review communication requests for completeness and work with appropriate stakeholders to clarify messaging, audience, timing, and required approvals.
  • Ensure communications provide users with relevant information such as impact, expected action, available alternatives or workarounds, and appropriate next steps.
  • Support communication planning for technology implementations, service transitions, application changes, upgrades, migrations, and other IT initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities to improve the quality and effectiveness of IT communications based on stakeholder and end-user feedback.

Training and Technology Adoption

  • Develop and execute end-user training and technology-adoption strategies that support workforce productivity and effective use of IT services and solutions.
  • Design training materials for new technologies, applications, processes, and significant changes to existing services.
  • Deliver learning through scalable formats such as user guides, quick-reference materials, knowledge articles, instructor-led sessions, virtual training, recorded demonstrations, and other digital learning content.
  • Partner with technology owners, subject-matter experts, project teams, and Global End User Support teams to identify training requirements and develop appropriate learning solutions.
  • Translate complex technical processes into simple, practical instructions that employees can confidently follow.
  • Support technology rollouts by combining communication, awareness, training, and adoption activities into a coordinated end-user experience.

title: Environment, Safety and Health (ESH) Coordinator, Onsite
description:
About Sandia

Sandia National Laboratories is the nation’s premier science and engineering lab for national security and technology innovation, with teams of specialists focused on cutting-edge work in a broad array of areas. Some of the main reasons we love our jobs:

  • Challenging work with amazing impact that contributes to security, peace, and freedom worldwide
  • Extraordinary co-workers
  • Some of the best tools, equipment, and research facilities in the world
  • Career advancement and enrichment opportunities
  • Flexible work arrangements for many positions include 9/80 (work 80 hours every two weeks, with every other Friday off) and 4/10 (work 4 ten-hour days each week) compressed workweeks, part-time work, and telecommuting (a mix of onsite work and working from home)
  • Generous vacation, strong medical and other benefits, competitive 401k, learning opportunities, relocation assistance and amenities aimed at creating a solid work/life balance*

World-changing technologies. Life-changing careers. Learn more about Sandia at: http://www.sandia.gov


*These benefits vary by job classification.

What Your Job Will Be Like

Join a dynamic team that solves challenging issues for national security! We are seeking a highly motivated Environment, Safety and Health (ES&H) coordinator with experience implementing ES&H requirements and working in a complex technical environment. You will play a key role as you help build a strong and healthy safety culture at the Labs. In this position, you are responsible for performing a variety of environmental, safety, and occupational health related functions. This is a fast-paced job that offers a great deal of ES&H project breadth.

On any given day, you may be called on to:

  • Be the voice of safety through department meetings, safety briefings, pre-job briefings, and face-to-face interactions with line partners
  • Advise and support staff and management in identifying potential hazards in existing or future projects, systems, equipment, facilities/spaces, processes, and operations
  • Collaborate with appropriate ES&H subject matter experts (SME) and line partners to evaluate/assess hazards and risks which may result in unsafe work conditions and formulate engineering/administrative controls to mitigate identified hazards
  • Perform technical evaluations and advise line partners in the preparation and review of technical work documents, Hazard Analysis, Primary Hazard and Aspect Survey, Work Planning and Controls, and other required ES&H-related documentation
  • Perform and communicate regular facility and work area walk-throughs to physically observe activities and inspect equipment, facilities, and the general workplace environment with management
  • Document and report staff and management concerns, findings, non-compliance issues and significant information in corporate data systems and through appropriate management channels
  • Support management with ES&H-related events, occurrences or emergencies
  • Support internal and external ES&H audits and assessments of facilities and operations/activities, and any related corrective actions
  • Participate in accident investigations involving injuries and damage and assist in identification of causes and corrective actions
  • Communicate and support corporate safety initiatives, regulatory and policy updates and safety performance metrics with a strong focus on customer service and partnering with line management and staff to help meet performance expectations
  • Assist with audits and assessments of operational areas to determine effectiveness of safety programs, including electrical safety/Lock Out Tag out, construction safety, rigging/crane operations, traffic safety, seismic safety, pressure safety, industrial ergonomics
  • Support integrating safety systems, associated support equipment, facilities, functional specifications, and operations to ensure hazards are mitigated and in compliance with safety and health regulations
  • Cultivate effective communications and relationships with organization leadership, the ES&H organization and ES&H coordinator community
  • Independently analyze and recommend safety criteria in system design, equipment and procedures to control or eliminate hazards

Due to the nature of the work, the selected applicant must be able to work onsite in Livermore, CA.

Salary Range

$88,900 - $201,000

*Salary range is estimated, and actual salary will be determined after consideration of the selected candidate's experience and qualifications, and application of any approved geographic salary differential.

Qualifications We Require

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline with 2 or more years of directly relevant experience; or equivalent combination of relevant education and/or experience
  • Experience with common office software, such as Microsoft Office, Excel, Word, Powerpoint, and/or Outlook
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a DOE Q level security clearance

Qualifications We Desire

  • Knowledge or training in worker safety and health programs
  • Professional certification in a relevant field (e.g., Associate Safety Professional, Certified Safety Professional)
  • Proven understanding of industrial safety standards, equipment, and practices, including but not limited to the following: machine tools, electrical, laser, pressure, hazardous materials, radiological and explosives
  • Understanding of applicable OSHA, EPA, and DOE regulations
  • Strong technical background safely interpreting and applying the latest editions of Codes and Standards
  • Knowledge and experience in performing occupational health, safety, and environmental management related assessments and the development of corrective actions, particularly in a research and development setting
  • Strong customer focus and ability to work well in a team focused environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to meet and adapt to quickly changing deadlines and priorities
  • Active DOE L or Q clearance

About Our Team

The ESH System Integration, 5 Team provides ES&H integration support for both CA and NM sites, including remote site operations. Department personnel support and facilitate the implementation of ES&H requirements and processes and assist in the identification and analysis of any hazards, threats and risks which may create an unsafe worksite. We collaborate to translate corporate policy requirements into line implementation plans and to formulate engineering and administrative controls to mitigate hazards, threats, and risks.

Posting Duration

This posting will be open for application submissions for a minimum of three (3) calendar days, including the 'posting date'. Sandia reserves the right to extend the posting date at any time.

Security Clearance

Sandia is required by DOE to conduct a pre-employment drug test and background review that includes checks of personal references, credit, law enforcement records, and employment/education verifications. Applicants for employment need to be able to obtain and maintain a DOE Q-level security clearance, which requires U.S. citizenship. If you hold more than one citizenship (i.e., of the U.S. and another country), your ability to obtain a security clearance may be impacted.

Applicants offered employment with Sandia are subject to a federal background investigation to meet the requirements for access to classified information or matter if the duties of the position require a DOE security clearance. Substance abuse or illegal drug use, falsification of information, criminal activity, serious misconduct or other indicators of untrustworthiness can cause a clearance to be denied or terminated by DOE, resulting in the inability to perform the duties assigned and subsequent termination of employment.

EEO

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status and any other protected class under state or federal law.

NNSA Requirements for MedPEDs

If you have a Medical Portable Electronic Device (MedPED), such as a pacemaker, defibrillator, drug-releasing pump, hearing aids, or diagnostic equipment and other equipment for measuring, monitoring, and recording body functions such as heartbeat and brain waves, if employed by Sandia National Laboratories you may be required to comply with NNSA security requirements for MedPEDs.

If you have a MedPED and you are selected for an on-site interview at Sandia National Laboratories, there may be additional steps necessary to ensure compliance with NNSA security requirements prior to the interview date.

title: Senior AI web software Engineer
description:
Experian Partner Solutions is looking for Senior Web Engineers to build the products our partners white label as their own – embedded components that run inside partner applications, and hosted sites that carry a partner's brand. When a partner puts our software in front of their customers, our code runs under their brand, in their environment, with their reputation attached. There is no margin for "it works on my machine."

Predominantly JavaScript and TypeScript across the browser and the server – React on the front end, Node in our services and tooling.

We are building this team around AI-assisted development. That is not a perk in the job description – it is the operating model. You will spend a significant share of your time directing AI coding agents, reviewing what those agents produce, and being personally accountable for code you did not type character by character. You will report to the director of web development.

  • Manage web software end-to-end – develop, and support it in production. Ownership does not stop at the merge.
  • Direct AI coding agents as your primary implementation method rather than hand-writing every line.
  • Decompose features into work an agent can build reliably, and write the prompts and specs that make that possible.
  • Make the architecture calls AI cannot make for you: interface and Api design, state and service boundaries, versioning, and backward compatibility for consumers who depend on your releases.
  • Design for environments you do not control, whether that is a hostile host page, an unfamiliar partner configuration, or an unexpected client of your Api.
  • Use AI to create test suites and regression coverage, then look for what the generator missed: adversarial inputs, integration conflicts, and configuration edge cases.

Agentic Responsibilities

  • Break complex features into AI-manageable tasks.
  • Review AI-generated code for bugs, security, and architecture issues.
  • Write prompts that produce quality code.
  • Use AI for testing while recognizing its limitations.
  • Demonstrate architecture and system-design judgment.
  • Understand where AI performs well and where it fall short.
  • 5+ years experience building and shipping production web software, with ownership of what you built after it went live.
  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent experience.
  • You will have experience in JavaScript and TypeScript, applied across the browser and the server. We work in React and Node; expertise in a comparable ecosystem plus evidence you pick up new stacks quickly is equally welcome.
  • Component libraries, design systems, or SDKs consumed by teams outside your own — where breaking changes carry cost.
  • Server-side or full-stack web work — Node services, APIs, and the integrations that connect a customer-facing product to the systems behind it.
  • Practical web security awareness: injection and XSS vectors, authentication and session handling, dependency risk, and safe handling of sensitive data.
  • Experience with DevOps and CI/CD, automated test and build tooling.

Our uniqueness is that we celebrate yours. Experian's people first, driven culture is multi award-winning; World's Best Workplaces™ 2025 (Fortune Global Top 25), Great Place To Work™ in 26 countries to name a few. Check out Experian Life on social or explore our Careers Site to understand why.
