title: Styrk Danmarks forsvar mod fremtidens trusler – Forsvarets Materiel- og Indkøbsstyrelse søger en teknisk specialist
description:
Vil du være med til at styrke det danske forsvar mod hybride trusler fra luften og i det maritime domæne? Antallet og kompleksiteten af hybride trusler stiger konstant, så vi har brug for flere teknisk stærke profiler, der kan bidrage til opbygningen af forsvaret mod hybride trusler, og den digitale transformation der understøtter Forsvarets evne til at gennemføre Multi-Domain Operations.

Om os
Vi er en sektion i Forretningsområde Værnfælles i Forsvarsministeriets Materiel- og Indkøbsstyrelse. Vores arbejde har stor betydning for Forsvarets enheder og myndigheder og vi samarbejder tæt med både interne og eksterne partnere samt industrien.

Vi søger lige nu flere teknisk og analytisk dygtige profiler til projekter og driftsopgaver omkring kommando-, kontrol- og data displaysystemer, der anvendes af hhv. Flyvevåbnets og Søværnets kapaciteter og bidrager til overvågning af det danske luftrum og i det maritime domæne.

De systemer vi opstiller og de serviceydelser vi tilbyder anvendes operativt døgnet rundt i både nationale og internationale missioner. Ud over leverancen til de operative brugere skal vi også sikre, at disse systemer kommer med i den digitale og operative transformation af Forsvaret og bliver klar til at indgå i Multi-Domain Operations.

Vi er et team af erfarne og nyuddannede top engagerede ingeniører og teknikere, der arbejder på tværs af fagområder i en afvekslende hverdag. Vi værdsætter en uformel omgangstone og professionalisme. Vi prioriterer vidensdeling og høj faglighed og derfor tilbyder vi efteruddannelse og kompetenceudvikling. Vi ser os selv som et team hvor samarbejde og sammenhold er nøgleord.

Om stillingen
Stillingens opgaver forudsætter, at du har motivation på at arbejde med både daglige driftsopgaver, såvel som forskelligartede komplekse projektopgaver.

Du vil komme til at arbejde som systemansvarlig inden for Forsvarets landbaserede kommando og kontrolsystemer (C2), hvor vi understøtter flyvevåbnet og søværnet. En grundlæggende forståelse for informationssikkerhed og netværksarkitektur er en forudsætning for at få succes i stillingen.

Afhængig af din profil kan du komme til at arbejde inden for følgende:

  • Drift, vedligehold og udvikling af C2 systemer til Søværnet eller Flyvevåbnet
  • Multi-Domain Operations-integration af C2-systemer på tværs af domænerne
  • Netværksdesign som binder sensorer til beslutningstagere
  • AI og avancerede data analysesystemer til analyse af rå data
  • Datavisualisering til understøttelse af beslutningstagere

Uagtet hvilke områder du kommer til at arbejde med vil du skulle arbejde med teknisk kravspecificering, projektering, gennemførelse af anskaffelser og driftsopgaver i relation til den Flyvevåbnets eller Søværnets landbaserede overvågning, samt rådgivning inden for kapacitetscenterets opgaveportefølje. Du kan altså se frem til en stilling, hvor du vil have en bred kontakt til beslutningstagere, brugere, vedligeholdelsesorganisationen såvel som eksterne leverandører.

Vi arbejder med tværorganisatoriske projekter, og implementerer systemer, hvori der indgår meget it på tværs af Forsvaret og i relation til NATO-systemer og netværk. Hertil koordinerer vi analyser og dialog omkring de operative digitale kapaciteter, herunder Joint Command and Control, Communications, Computers, Intelligence, Surveillance and Reconnaissance i en Multi-Domain Operations kontekst. Dit ansvar bliver heri at koble tekniske løsninger til de konkrete operative behov og indgå i dialog om, hvad den rigtige løsning er i forhold til de operative brugeres behov.

Af øvrige opgaver, som du kommer til at arbejde med i hverdagen, kan nævnes:

  • Deltagelse i projektarbejde ved kapacitetsopbygning, hvor du får en bred kontaktflade til resten af Forsvaret
  • Foretage fremdriftsrapportering og øvrig kommunikation af opgaveløsning
  • Udbygge relationer og repræsentere FMI ved nationale og internationale konferencer, mødefora og symposier, så du kan holde dig opdateret og bidrage aktivt i dialogen med myndigheder, kunder, leverandører og andre interessenter
  • Udførelse af dokumentation og sagsbehandling, herunder udarbejdelse af sagsfremstillinger og referater i vores journaliseringssystem.

Du skal påregne rejseaktiviteter i forbindelse med opgaveløsningen samt møder med vores samarbejdspartnere i ind- og udland.

Om dig
Som teknisk specialist har du en relevant teknisk uddannelse eller tilsvarende erfaring med: Kommando og Kontrol systemer (C2), radarsystemer, efterretnings systemer, kunstig Intelligens og machine learning (AI/ML), NATO-kommunikations standarder og doktrin. Vi forventer, at du kan bidrage med nye idéer og være løsningsorienteret ift. opgaverne.

Vi leder efter en kollega, som arbejder struktureret, er dygtig til at anvende informationsteknologi effektivt i sin opgaveløsning. Du behersker både dansk og engelsk på et højt teknisk niveau, både mundtligt og skriftligt. Da koordinering og rådgivning er en stor del af jobbet, er det vigtigt, at du er imødekommende og serviceminded og er indstillet på at samarbejde på tværs af organisationen.

For at kunne indgå i teamet skal du kunne arbejde i grupper og på egen hånd. Hos os kan hverdagen hurtigt ændre sig, og du skal derfor trives med skiftende opgaver og prioriteringer.

Det er vigtigt, at du er indstillet på at tilegne dig ny viden og formidle den effektivt i rollen som systemansvarlig, rådgiver og koordinator. Tidligere erfaring fra Forsvaret vil være en fordel, men ikke et krav. Vi forventer, at du minimum har B kørekort.

Ansættelsesvilkår
Ansættelse og aflønning sker i henhold til den til enhver tid gældende overenskomst.

Er du akademiker ansættes du i henhold til den til enhver tid gældende overenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og en række akademikerorganisationer for akademikere i staten (Akademikeroverenskomsten).

Afhængigt af dine kvalifikationer og kompetencer, er der mulighed for forhandling af tillæg. Der er til stillingen knyttet en arbejdsgiverfinansieret pensionsordning.

Arbejdsstedet er i Ballerup eller i Karup.

Som ansat under Forsvarsministeriets område er du omfattet af nogle særlige vilkår. Du skal bl.a. kunne sikkerhedsgodkendes og opretholde sikkerhedsgodkendelsen under hele ansættelsesforholdet.

Du har som ansat pligt til at forrette tjeneste uden for landets grænser, herunder ved enheder i internationale operationer med henblik på deltagelse i konfliktforebyggende, fredsbevarende, fredsskabende, humanitære og andre lignende operationer.

Kontakt og ansøgning
Hvis du vil høre mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte sektionschef Morten Bjerregaard Hansen på telefon 2481 8650.

Har du spørgsmål til løn- og ansættelsesvilkår er du velkommen til at kontakte Personelkommandoen, HR-konsulent Birgit Jepsen på telefon 3266 5811.

Ansøgningsfristen er den 25. november 2026. Samtaler forventes i forlængelse heraf. Vi udvider vores kapacitet, og har i øjeblikket flere ledige stillinger. Stillingerne er i det værns fælles kapacitetscenter MDO og C2 og er til besættelse 1. januar 2027 eller snarest muligt.

Du søger stillingen via linket og vi beder dig vedhæfte ansøgning, CV og kopi af uddannelsesbevis. Vær opmærksom på at bilag skal tilføjes i PDF-format.

I Forsvarsministeriets organisation tror vi på, at mangfoldighed optimerer opgaveløsningen. Derfor opfordrer vi alle interesserede uanset baggrund til at søge stillingen.

Om Forsvarsministeriets Materiel- og Indkøbsstyrelse
Forsvarsministeriets Materiel- og Indkøbsstyrelse (FMI) er en styrelse under Forsvarsministeriet.

FMI har ansvaret for det samlede forsvars og beredskabs materiel, IT og cybersikkerhed. Det er os, der anskaffer, driver og bortskaffer materiel og IT for såvel Hæren, Søværnet, Flyvevåbnet, Arktisk Kommando, Specialoperationskommandoen, Hjemmeværnet, Beredskabsstyrelsen og resten af Forsvarsministeriets koncern. Desuden bistår vores IT-medarbejdere dagligt i at modstå de cyberangreb, Forsvarsministeriets koncern udsættes for. Vi er ca. 2500 medarbejdere (3/4 civile - 1/4 militære) fordelt ud over hele Kongeriget, med hovedkontorer i henholdsvis Ballerup, Brabrand og Hvidovre.

title: Family Housing Hub Specialist
description:
Job Title: Family Housing Hub Specialist

Supervisor: Family Housing Hub Manager

Classification: Exempt

Hiring Salary Range: $46,800 - $49,800 per year

About UMOM New Day Centers: Founded in 1964, UMOM is Arizona's largest provider of services for families experiencing homelessness. Our mission is to end family homelessness by restoring hope and rebuilding lives. With an annual operating budget of $20 million dollars, UMOM provides shelter, supportive services, and housing programs to families and individuals experiencing homelessness in Maricopa County. UMOM serves over 15,000 unique individuals across all our services annually, including those families receiving support at the Family Housing Hub, Maricopa County's family coordinated entry system.

Position Description: The Family Housing Hub Specialist assists families experiencing a housing crisis by problem solving, identifying resources, offering support and/or assessment through the community coordinated entry system at the Family Housing Hub (FHH). The Family Housing Hub Specialist position is responsible for providing client navigation services and screenings for families experiencing homelessness with the purpose of diverting families to safe housing options and/or to connect them to the community emergency shelter waitlist.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Direct Client Care

  • Provides resources, support, and information to households and assists households in creating short-term plans to solve immediate housing crises.
  • Engages in problem-solving techniques and housing stability planning with households including preventing families from entering the homeless services system when appropriate.
  • Completes assessments with households in a professional, trauma-informed, and accurate manner.
  • Collects all required information from households to insure appropriate connections to resources and housing.
  • Serves as liaison between household and partner agencies to assure continuity of care.
  • In collaboration with partner agencies, assists clients in accessing all necessary documentation for program eligibility.
  • Assists with triage at FHH front-desk and phones, greets clients, and provides high level screening upon initial contact.

Family Housing Hub Operations

  • Staffs satellite locations and off-site screening events.
  • With the FHH team, maintains up-to-date listings of community, employment, and housing resources.
  • Clearly and consistently communicates program details and client navigation information to external partners.
  • Assists in office administration including client record upkeep, data entry, and information inquiries.
  • Supports program Coordinator with customer service responsibilities by fielding client concerns and external partner inquiries.

Documentation, Data Quality, and Outcomes

  • Assures data is complete, accurate, and on-time in accordance with UMOM's data quality standards.
  • Focuses on achieving agency outcomes of diversion from homeless system, data quality, and program efficiency.

Other duties as assigned by Leadership and/or Executives.


Qualifications and Competency Requirements:

Experience and Education

  • High School or GED Diploma, required
  • Bachelor's degree preferred, ideally in a related field
  • Minimum 3 years of experience working with at-risk populations and/or case management required
  • Demonstrated knowledge of Motivational Interviewing and Trauma Informed Care, preferred
  • Knowledge of non-profit sector; experience working with underserved or disadvantaged populations is preferred
  • Knowledge of community resources and understanding of community health and social service system is a plus

Computer skills

  • Basic computer literacy required, including data entry, web navigation, typing and text editing, and the ability to learn operations in new software systems
  • Proficiency with Windows operating system, Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook
  • Previous experience with Efforts to Outcomes (ETO) or HMIS is preferred.

Compliance

  • Valid Level One Fingerprint Clearance Card or the ability to obtain one
  • Ability to clear the Central Registry Screening from the Department of Child Safety & Adult Protective Services.
  • Ability to comply with and pass all required background check and drug screening requirements, including but not limited to pre-employment and random drug screening as required/requested.
  • Valid AZ Driver's License and a driving record that falls within UMOM's policy
  • 50/100 level of car insurance coverage.
  • This is a Safety Sensitive position.

Physical activities and working conditions

The physical demands and working conditions described here are representative, but not exhaustive, of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

  • This position is typically performed in an interior, environmentally controlled office setting. The duties of the job require extended periods of time being stationary and manipulating a computer (keyboard, monitor, mouse), and other standard office equipment including, but not limited to: printer, fax, calculator, copier, telephone and associated computer/technology peripherals.

Additional Attributes

  • Willingness to embrace and actively support the unique culture and values of UMOM
  • Ability to focus on the tasks and details relevant to the position and the organization, while also switching quickly between tasks
  • Ability to exercise excellent independent judgment and take ownership of decisions
  • Ability to think on a broad, systems-level relative to the scope of the position
  • Ability to work independently and self-manage to achieve goals while being a strong team player
  • Ability to organize, meet deadlines, prioritize and delegate appropriately
  • Ability to cope with and embrace change, risk, and uncertainty
  • Ability to develop strong relationships within a fast-paced, collaborative setting that values diverse opinions; enthusiasm for helping drive change as UMOM becomes a more data-driven organization

Work Schedule: The typical schedule for this position is Monday-Friday, including one early evening shift, with the ability to work flexible hours, including occasional nights and weekends as needed to support the needs of the position and the organization.


Other: Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

title: Endoscopy Technician (2308) - Department of Public Health - H00202
description:
Under supervision of a Registered Nurse, the 2308 Endoscopy Technician assists the provider, nurse, and patient with pre, intra, and post care during gastrointestinal endoscopic procedures. The Endoscopy Technician is responsible for performing technical skills within regulatory and organizational standards and departmental scope of service. They are proficient with gastrointestinal endoscopic equipment and ensure proper performance of endoscopic equipment, selecting alternate equipment or adjusting equipment settings to accommodate patient needs. The 2308 Endoscopy Technician performs essential duties including, but not limited to the following:

  • Assists physician and nurse staff to complete endoscopic procedures, including, but not limited to: Colonoscopy with or without interventions, Endoscopic Retrograde Cholangiopancreatography (ERCP), Endoscopic Ultrasound (EUS), Endoscopic Mucosal Resections (EMR), Esophagogastroduodenoscopy (EGD) with and without interventions, Esophageal Dilation, Flexible Sigmoidoscopy.
  • Assists physician in accomplishing intraprocedural interventions, including but not limited to: obtaining biopsies, preparing diagnostic biopsy specimens, polypectomy, application of hemostatic clips, intramucosal injection, inflation of balloon dilators, and placement of intraluminal stents.
  • Assists physician and nurse staff to verify correct patient and procedures, informs patients of the procedure to be performed, and ensures patient comfort and safety during the procedure.
  • Prepares procedural rooms for the performance of gastrointestinal endoscopic procedures and maintains adequate inventory of supplies in endoscopy rooms needed for patient care
  • Inspects, tests, verifies the proper functioning and calibration of the endoscopy equipment used during the procedure to ensure patient safety.
  • May assist in training staff in the operation of equipment, proper techniques, handling of instruments, and GI Procedures.
  • Performs endoscope reprocessing in accordance with infection prevention standards, manufacturer instructions, and departmental policies: including bedside pre-cleaning, leak testing, manual cleaning, high-level disinfection, drying, and proper storage.
  • The 2308 Endoscopy Technician may perform other duties as assigned/required

Please note that incumbents in this classification may be required to perform duties as listed in the class specification, which can be found on DHR’s website:

  • Ability to follow oral instructions.
  • Ability to demonstrate attention to detail.
  • Knowledge of endoscopy equipment and use in basic and advanced endoscopy procedures.
  • Knowledge of infection prevention principles, including aseptic techniques, universal precautions, endoscope reprocessing and disinfection techniques and ability to adhere to standard operating policies and procedures to clean reusable medical equipment.

title: Collections Specialist/AR -  Full Time
description:
We are looking for a detail-oriented, hard-hitting Collections Specialist with an Accounts Receivable background to be responsible for effective management, analysis and problem resolution of the company’s outstanding accounts and the application of payments. The individual will also perform a variety of accounting, bookkeeping, and financial tasks. The applicant should display a positive and proactive attitude, strong organizational skills, the ability to prioritize and multitask and be a strong communicator, both on paper and over the phone, as he or she will frequently deal with outside parties as well as higher levels of management. Responsibilities include keeping financial records updated and preparing reports. A successful candidate should be familiar with all accounting procedures and have a flair for numbers.

Priority is given to strong collections professionals with a successful track record of resolving ageing receivables.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Performs collection requests either by telephone and/or email. This is the position's primary responsibility and focus.

Prepares, reviews and mails monthly customer statements.

Posts customer payments by recording cash, checks, ACH, and credit card transactions.

Updates receivables reports detailing collection notes.

Verifies validity of account discrepancies by obtaining and investigating information from sales, trade promotions, customer service departments, and customers.

Resolves valid or authorized deductions by entering corrections to customer accounts.

Resolves customer accounts by examining payment plans and payment history to determine if collection letters need to be sent out on delinquent accounts.

Creates credit memos as needed to adjust un-collectible amounts.

Assists other finance areas such as accounts payable coordinating paid when paid procedures.

Researches and negotiates charge-back claims.

Other duties as assigned.

Education and/or Experience:

High School Diploma, GED, or High School Equivalence Certificate.

College level accounting coursework or a Bachelor’s degree in Accounting preferred.

2 years of hands-on Accounting experience in accounts receivable preferred.

Computer Skills:

Proficiency with Microsoft products, including Word, Outlook & Power Point. Excellent skills in Excel are required.

Working knowledge of financial reporting software – Dexter & Chaney Spectrum preferred

Full-time, exempt position.

Excellent insurance benefits package (Highmark BC/BS, EyeMed, AFLAC, company paid Life and EAP), and 401k with match offered.

This is an in-person position with remote work not available. Position is onsite at our home office in Wilmington, DE 19808.

Hours are Monday - Friday; 8AM - 5 PM with flexibility.

Wayman provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment, without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, martial or veteran status, sexual orientation, or the presence of handicaps or disabilities.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Medical Practice Scheduler (3676)
location: BHC - Medical Drive Main - Birmingham, AL 35235
description:
US Heart and Vascular is needing a Part-time Medical Practice Scheduler to join our team at Birmingham Heart Clinic in Birmingham AL
This is an entry level position with a lot of opportunity for growth and advancement within a rapidly growing Cardiology Clinic

title: Manufacturing Engineering 3
description:
Primary Function of Position:

Lead manufacturing engineering initiatives that improve safety, quality, delivery, cost, and capacity through process optimization, equipment improvements, and Lean Manufacturing practices. This position provides technical expertise and cross-functional leadership to support production performance, new product introductions, continuous improvement projects, and the manufacture of high-quality robotic surgical instruments.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Provide manufacturing engineering support for production processes, tooling, fixtures, equipment, and product design improvements.
  • Support daily production activities by resolving manufacturing issues, updating manufacturing documentation, and driving corrective actions.
  • Design, specify, procure, qualify, document, troubleshoot and maintain, and improve manufacturing tooling, fixtures, hand tools, and production equipment.
  • Review and assess engineering changes, ECOs, and design releases from manufacturing and field-service perspectives.
  • Disposition Non-Conforming or Material in Review, according to appropriate procedures, perform risk assessments and provide sorting or rework instructions
  • Execute and develop Performance Process Qualifications (PPQ), Installation Qualifications, Operational Qualifications for different process, products or equipment

  • Ensure compliance with Quality System requirements, applicable procedures, and regulatory standards.
  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives focused on safety, quality, delivery, cost, capacity, and operational efficiency.
  • Participate in new product introduction, process transfers, and manufacturing scalability initiatives.
  • Define manufacturing inspection and test requirements and ensure appropriate process controls are implemented.
  • Analyze manufacturing performance metrics and identify opportunities to improve yield, productivity, and process capability.
  • Support supplier selection, supplier quality improvement, and outsourcing initiatives as required.
  • Train, coach, and support production personnel while maintaining training compliance and performance standards.
  • Provide DFM expertise by evaluating product designs for reliability, functionality, manufacturability, and production readiness.
  • Develop and implement efficient, high-volume manufacturing processes and assembly lines, including workflow optimization and workstation design.

Skills, Experience, Education, & Training:

  • Must be a hands-on team player able to interact cross-functionally to develop improvement strategies and implement solutions. We need someone with an unfailing commitment to continuous improvement.
  • Bachelor of Science in Engineering, Master Degree is a plus.

  • GD&T experience, must be able to interpret and read technical drawings
  • Experienced in ISO 13485, or medical device manufacturing environment is a plus.
  • Lean manufacturing and Six Sigma background and knowledge is highly desirable.

title: Gourmetslagterelev - kun 2 år - Silkeborg
description:
Gourmetslagterelev - kun 2 år - Silkeborg

Gourmetslagterelev - kun 2 år

Er du klar til at tage kniven i hånden og skære dig vej til en spændende karriere? Som gourmetslagter bliver du en del af en stolt tradition, hvor kvalitet, håndværk og smag går hånd i hånd. I føtex kan du blive færdiguddannet gourmetslagter på 2 år, men har du mod på mere, kan du vælge at tage et speciale oven i din 2-årige uddannelse.

**Hvad er en gourmetslagter?
**En gourmetslagter er meget mere end en slagter. Du lærer at mestre alt fra udskæring af kød til at skabe et lækkert madunivers og give vores kunder den bedste service. Det handler om at skabe smagsoplevelser, der får kunderne til at komme igen og igen. I føtex kommer du både til at stifte bekendtskab med slagter & delikatesse, så du får det bedste af begge verdener.

Hvad kan du forvente af uddannelsen?

  • Praktisk erfaring: Du arbejder i en af vores butikker og får hands-on erfaring fra dag ét.
  • Teori og teknik: Du lærer om råvarer, hygiejne, udskæringer og meget mere.
  • En del af holdet: Du bliver en del af et team der står klar til at udvikle dig til at nå dine drømme og mål.

Hvem er du?

  • Du elsker mad og har en passion for kvalitet.
  • Du er nysgerrig og klar til at lære et unikt håndværk.
  • Du trives med at arbejde i et team og give kunderne den bedste oplevelse.

Hvor lang tid tager uddannelsen? Hvis du kommer direkte fra 9. eller 10. klasse skal du starte med at tage grundforløbet indenfor slagterfaget. Det tager 6 måneder. Derefter skal du stå i lære i 1 år og 6 måneder. Det er også muligt starte i ny mesterlære.

**Hvorfor vælge os?
**Hos føtex får du en uddannelse, der åbner døre. Vi tilbyder et stærkt fællesskab, dygtige oplæringsansvarlige og en arbejdsplads, hvor der er plads til at udvikle sig. Samtidig bliver du en del af en virksomhed, der sætter bæredygtighed og ansvarlighed højt. Du bliver en del af Danmarks største elevfælleskab, og skal deltage på vores interne moduler som er eksklusive for koncernens elever.

**Nysgerrig på mere?
**Hvis du gerne vil læse mere om uddannelsen og gourmetslagteruddannelsen kan du besøge; www.slagterfaget.dk

**Sådan søger du:
**Er du klar til at tage det første skridt mod en spændende fremtid? Send din ansøgning allerede i dag! Du finder os her hvor du kan læse mere om både skoleophold, din hverdag i varehuset og fremtidsmuligheder.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

title: Associate Manager, Site Operations
description:
POSITION TITLE: Associate Manager, Site Operations

REPORTS TO: Senior Manager, eCommerce Operations

BUSINESS AREA: eCommerce & Digital Experience

LOCATION: New York, NY (Hybrid)

TRAVEL: Occasional Domestic & International travel for meetings.

OVERVIEW

The Associate Manager, Site Operations – North America owns the day-to-day customer experience and operational execution of the Salomon North America eCommerce site. Reporting to the Senior Manager, eCommerce Operations, this role ensures site issues are logged and prioritized, new features are tested before they go live, and escalations reach the right partners with the right urgency. The role requires independent judgment, strong organizational discipline, and the ability to drive outcomes through partners without direct authority.

This role is the working-level point of contact for regional eCommerce teams and global technical and product management teams, and partners closely with the eCommerce IT team. Operations owns the business side of site health, including business impact and priority, business-side acceptance testing, and training and adoption. IT owns technical triage, root cause, resolution, vendor management, and technical release readiness. Peak readiness and post-go-live stabilization are shared, with IT leading on the technical side and this role on the business side.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty and responsibility satisfactorily:

Site Health and Bug Management

  • Log and track site bugs and issues reported by business teams, Customer Service, and consumers
  • Document issues with clear context, including what the consumer experiences, which journeys are affected, and the scope of impact, so technical partners can diagnose and resolve
  • Assess business impact and set priority for incoming issues, routing them to IT for technical triage
  • Drive escalations to technical partners with clear context and appropriate urgency, following through until resolution is confirmed with the business
  • Serve as the escalation point for Customer Service on order and inventory issues they cannot resolve, assessing business impact and engaging IT for technical investigation
  • Maintain a live view of open issues, progress, and resolution timelines, communicating status, risks, and dependencies to stakeholders
  • Identify recurring or systemic issues and escalate patterns for strategic consideration

Feature Testing and Validation

  • Own business-side user acceptance testing of new features, integrations, and platform capabilities across new and existing systems ahead of deployment
  • Coordinate directly with the global product management team on testing requirements, test plans, and acceptance criteria
  • Partner with regional eCommerce functional teams to execute test cases across site experiences and business workflows, documenting outcomes and flagging defects
  • Ensure test cases are thoroughly defined, covering all North America-specific requirements and edge cases
  • Escalate unresolved risks or blockers before features, launches, and campaigns go live, summarizing potential impact

Cross-functional Coordination

  • Serve as the working-level contact for IT, logistics, and technical partners on site operations matters
  • Participate in working-level meetings with the global product team, ensuring North America open items are visible, tracked, and followed up on
  • Log and track North America enhancement requests, partnering with the Senior Manager on prioritization
  • Coordinate with IT on cross-team issues, tracking progress and confirming resolution with the business
  • Support business-side readiness for launches, peak, and seasonal campaigns, and the business response during post-go-live stabilization, in partnership with IT
  • Support change management, training, and adoption of new features and process changes with business teams

Process, Documentation, and Analysis

  • Maintain SOPs, issue logs, testing playbooks, and operational documentation
  • Report on operational metrics including time-to-resolution and open issue aging
  • Analyze the consumer experience across the site and customer service channels to identify areas of opportunity to optimize our use of eCommerce tools
  • Flag operational inefficiencies and friction points

REQUIRED EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
  • 3-5 years of experience in eCommerce site operations, digital operations, or a closely related technical operations role
  • Hands-on experience with eCommerce platforms; SAP, Salesforce Service Cloud and Shopify experience preferred
  • Experience coordinating feature testing, QA, or UAT in a digital or eCommerce environment

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Strong sense of urgency and demonstrated ability to manage multiple issues and projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment, prioritizing by business impact and driving resolution through external partners
  • Experience working with global or cross-functional product and technology teams in a matrixed environment
  • Familiarity with end-to-end eCommerce ecosystems including storefront, order management, payment processing, and fulfillment systems
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail and disciplined follow-through
  • Comfortable operating independently, making prioritization decisions and knowing when to escalate versus resolve
  • Clear communicator able to translate technical issues into plain language for non-technical stakeholders
  • Collaborative partner to IT, product, and eCommerce teams
  • Analytical approach to operations, using data and KPIs to understand site experience and surface systemic issues
  • Proficient in Excel, including pivot tables and lookups; familiarity with analytics tools such as Power BI
  • Customer-centric mindset with an understanding of eCommerce user experience
  • Familiarity with JIRA, Confluence, or similar issue tracking and documentation tools preferred

PHYSICAL DEMANDS & WORKING ENVIRONMENT

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk and listen. The employee is frequently required to sit, stand, and walk. The employee must occasionally kneel, stoop, crouch, twist, and lift up to 30 pounds, with or without accommodations.

Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, and ability to adjust focus.

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

When specific circumstances are met, work from home may be an option, but must be approved by your direct manager. When utilized, the workflow must equal that of if the individual were working from the office setting. Amer Sports will not provide needs other than a laptop to work from home. (including the internet, monitors, keyboard, mouse, speakers, etc.)

title: CNC Laser Programmer
description:
CNC Laser Programmer

Location: Virginia Beach, VA
Job Type: Direct Hire
Salary: Starts at $55,000 annually, higher rates available depending on experience

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced CNC Laser Programmer to develop and maintain machine programs for sheet metal fabrication operations. This role is responsible for preparing cutting programs, creating efficient material layouts, and ensuring equipment runs accurately and productively.

The successful candidate will work with engineering, production, and quality personnel to improve manufacturing processes, reduce material waste, resolve programming issues, and maintain production standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, edit, and improve CNC programs for laser cutters, punch presses, press brakes, and other fabrication equipment.

  • Review CAD models, engineering drawings, blueprints, GD&T requirements, and technical specifications to prepare machine programs.

  • Create and optimize nesting layouts to improve material usage and reduce scrap.

  • Prepare production-ready programs and verify accuracy before releasing them to operators.

  • Coordinate with engineering and production teams to improve part manufacturability and reduce machine cycle times.

  • Identify and resolve programming errors and equipment-related production issues.

  • Maintain organized CNC program files, revision records, and technical documentation.

  • Assist with first-article inspections and production testing to confirm program accuracy.

  • Evaluate manufacturing methods and recommend improvements to increase productivity and efficiency.

  • Support machine setup activities and determine appropriate tooling requirements.

  • Provide technical guidance and training to CNC machine operators when needed.

  • Ensure all programs meet quality specifications and applicable safety procedures.

Performance Expectations

  • Maintain a first-pass program approval rate of at least 98%.

  • Improve material yield through accurate nesting and programming practices.

  • Reduce machine cycle times and improve production output.

  • Keep scrap and rework within established quality targets.

  • Complete and release programs according to production schedules.

  • Identify and implement improvements that produce measurable efficiency gains.

  • Follow established safety requirements and maintain a strong safety record.

Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.

  • At least 3 years of CNC programming experience in a manufacturing environment.

  • Proficiency with CAD/CAM software and CNC programming systems.

  • Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, GD&T, and technical specifications.

  • Experience programming CNC laser cutting machines, press brakes, punch presses, or similar fabrication equipment.

  • Strong understanding of sheet metal fabrication processes and manufacturing methods.

  • Knowledge of machine tooling, setup requirements, and production workflows.

  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.

  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office and ERP/MRP systems.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Associate degree in Manufacturing Technology, Mechanical Engineering Technology, or a related discipline.

  • Experience with nesting software such as SigmaNEST, TruTops, BySoft, or similar programs.

  • Familiarity with Amada, Trumpf, Mazak, or comparable CNC equipment.

  • Background in Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives.

  • APICS, SME, or other manufacturing-related certifications.

Apply today to take the next step in your CNC programming career!

Why Join Us?

This is an excellent opportunity to join a growing manufacturing team where you can contribute to process improvements, optimize production efficiency, and play a key role in delivering high-quality fabricated products.

Apply today to learn more about this Direct Hire opportunity in Virginia Beach, VA.

title: Vocational Rehabilitation Specialist (Transition)
description:
General Job Information

SALARY RANGE PER GRADE LEVEL

Grade CS-09 - $62,158 - $80,032

Grade CS-11 - $74,893 - $96,547
Grade CS-12 - $92,656 - $118,558

If you like to stay busy and immersed in cultural activities, then Washington, DC is the place to be! Museums, restaurants, great climate, green space and job opportunities are among the many positives of living in the Nation’s Capital. Not to mention the residents of the District of Columbia are highly educated and the region has some of the best schools in the country. Each day the District of Columbia continues to be ranked in the top 10 of thriving city indicators where you can live, work and play.

This position is located in the Department on Disability Services, Rehabilitation Services Administration (RSA) Transition unit. The mission of the administration is to provide comprehensive vocational rehabilitation and independent living services to persons with disabilities, which will maximize their quality of life and promote their employability and economic self-sufficiency, independence, inclusion, and integration into society, and adjudication of disability claims.

The incumbent provides comprehensive pre-employment transition services for potentially eligible students with disabilities, ages 14-22.

MAJOR DUTIES

  • Provides services to clients in meeting problems of personal, social, and vocational adjustment.
  • Interprets and analyzes applicants’ physical or mental condition, social and economic situation, attitudes and aptitudes, work experiences, functional limitations, educational background, and personality traits to determine eligibility and rehabilitation possibilities.

  • Collects existing information from hospitals/medical records, schools, employers, other agencies, and individuals to supplement and/or verify history and current status.
  • Evaluates information and its relationship to client's current and potential medical and vocational status.
  • Determines eligibility for vocational rehabilitation services in accordance with applicable Federal and District laws, regulations, guidelines, policies, and procedures.
  • Plans and arranges for rehabilitation services; approves expenditures within specified limits for planned rehabilitation services.
  • Assists in developing an Individualized Plan for Employment (IPE).
  • Informs client of the terms and conditions for the provision of vocational rehabilitation services. Informs client of his/her rights and the means by which he/she may express and seek a remedy for any dissatisfaction.
  • Ensures clients' information is maintained in the VR information system. Works with the client in securing employment, which is suited to his/her capabilities, interests, strengths, and informed choice.
  • Make pre-referral contact with prospective employers and follow-up contacts with both the employer and the employee to ascertain progress or challenges in the client's achieving his/her vocational goal.
  • Informs client of case closure and of the availability of post-employment services.
  • Assists in planning and providing post-employment services to assist the client in a satisfactory adjustment to employment and achieving a successful employment outcome.
  • Meets established agency performance standards in terms of quality and quantity of casework; accuracy of eligibility determinations, adhering to established agency and federal guidelines for eligibility determinations and for developing and implementing the IPE.

  • Prepares reports as required to promote the effective operation of the vocational rehabilitation program.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Applicant must have one (1) year of specialized experience at the next lower grade-level. One (1) year of experience that equipped the applicant with the particular knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the duties of the position successfully, and that is typically related to providing pre-employment transition services aligned with the Individuals with Disabilities Education Act (IDEA) and the Rehabilitation Act, as amended by the Workforce Innovation and Opportunity Act (WIOA) of 2014.

Applicants must have met the qualifications requirements for this position by the closing date to be eligible for this position.

Education, Licenses, Certifications, and other Requirements

Minimum requirement: Master's Degree in Rehabilitation Counseling, Vocational Evaluation, Vocational Rehabilitation, or related field is required. An equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered.

Work Experience/Knowledge

Practical knowledge of the federal and District laws, rules and regulations, guidelines, policies, and procedures governing the administration of the vocational rehabilitation program in order to provide appropriate services within the scope of these statutory provisions.

Practical knowledge of theories, principles, practices, and techniques of counseling to assist eligible persons with disabilities in adjusting to their disabilities and pursuing a successful employment outcome.

Practical knowledge of medical and psychological terminology in order to understand various physical and mental problems and collaborate with consultants in the evaluation of the clients' current status and potential for a successful employment outcome.

Practical knowledge of service-providing agencies in the community in order to refer clients for comparable services not available within the Administration.

Practical knowledge of the local labor market and its practices, work requirements, and needs of specific employers, employment trends, salaries, and assisting their clients to achieve a successful employment outcome.

Collective Bargaining Unit

This position is in the collective bargaining unit represented by local union AFSCME 2401.

Additional information

Once applications are submitted, applicants will not be able to change their responses to the online questions.

The position for which the individual is applying has been identified and designated as requiring enhanced suitability screening.

If tentatively selected for the position, a criminal background check, traffic record check, consumer credit check, and mandatory drug and alcohol test will be conducted (as appropriate); and

The appointee to the position may be offered employment contingent upon receipt of a satisfactory enhanced suitability screening.

Work Schedule

This position requires 4 days a week in the office.

How You Will Be Evaluated

You will be evaluated for this job based on how well you meet the qualifications above. Your application includes your resume, responses to the online questions, and required supporting documents. Please be sure that your resume includes detailed information to support your qualifications for this position; failure to provide sufficient evidence in your resume will result in a "not qualified" determination.

title: Founding GTM Lead
description:
flowscope (YC P26) is building the software factory for enterprise. Our agents capture how a client works, map its workflows, and deliver production software for that client. The end state is a custom, AI-native software stack for every company.

Enterprise software has a delivery problem. Every customer works differently, so fitting their workflows to a SaaS product takes months of forward-deployed engineers, consultants and integrators. Custom builds from consultancies cost millions and rarely get past the proof of concept.

Coding agents change the economics. When code is nearly free, the expensive part is understanding how the client works. Palantir built Foundry, then needed an army of engineers to deploy it. We start from the other end: automate the forward-deployed engineer, and let agents build custom software for each client, instead of one bloated product plus years of customisation.

As founding GTM lead, you take the software factory to market: you find the companies, close them, and run each one from the first mapping to live automation.

What you'll work on

  • Find: build your own pipeline from your network, outbound and conferences, with operations and finance leaders and the private equity firms behind them.
  • Close: run every deal yourself: discovery, business case, proposal and contract.
  • Map: lead the discovery. Our desktop agent records how the client's team works; you turn that into the case for an AI transformation.
  • Deliver: work with our engineers and agents until the transformation is running in production.
  • Repeat: run the motion again with the next client, faster each time.

Who we're looking for

This is not a normal job, and we will not pretend it is.

  • You want to take the future of software production to market.
  • You have run client work at the highest level, in consulting, private equity or a fast-growing company, and can carry a client end to end: from first call to live automation.
  • You love to sell and want your pay tied to what you bring in.
  • Serious intensity. This is 996.
  • A friend! We will spend countless hours building a huge company, so cultural fit is essential.

How we operate

  • We train hard, sleep properly and treat our bodies as part of the job.
  • You will be expected to live and perform like a professional athlete. 996 is a marathon.
  • We say what we think.

What we offer

  • Founding-level ownership and meaningful equity.
  • Base plus uncapped commission: $320K at target, and more above it.
  • Unlimited token spend on agents. Use them for everything.
  • Direct say in how we sell and what we build, from day one.

Your first 30 days

You will run the factory end to end on a live client, then start filling the pipeline.

  • Run a mapping alongside us on a live client: see how our desktop agent captures a team's work, and build the case for automation.
  • Join the founders on every sales call and make the pitch your own.
  • Book your first meetings.

Where

New York or San Francisco. First 90 days in SF with the founders, then once or twice a month.

Founders

  • Javier (CTO): two-time founder. Founding engineer at Model ML (YC W24), one of the fastest-growing YC companies in history. ML engineer at Encord (YC W20). Ironman triathlete.
  • Samuel (CEO): McKinsey & Company (QuantumBlack). Satellite engineer. Platoon commander in the Singapore Armed Forces.

If you want to change the world of software forever, we want to talk.

title: FCL Trade Manager (f/m/d)

description:
FCL Trade Manager (f/m/d)

FCL Trade Strategy

  • Ensure adherence to the global core carrier policy within trade including evaluating the carriers’ performance.

  • Monitor and assess the performance of the trade, regularly reviewing key performance indicators (KPIs) to identify areas for improvement and strategic adjustments.

Carrier Relationship Development

  • Build and maintain relationships with global core carriers’ regional decision makers.
  • Lead the improvement of relationship within local offices between local procurement teams and core carriers within region,
  • Monitor and control core carriers’ performance in alignment between the other regions and the Regional Product Team; enforcing a methodology of local and regional performance reviews and Action Plans for Carriers, including QBRs.
  • Act as an escalation point within region for any core carrier issues related to trade.

FCL Tariff, Rates and Contract Management

  • Based on the trade FCL strategy, coordinate with sales management and other product heads or trade managers to ensure capturing and developing business. Must lead trade FCL tender strategy, including risk-taking decisions for regional accounts and tenders, and escalate to the trade head or the regional product head if needed.
  • Support a high performing culture of accountability and ownership within the local and regional procurement teams in the region, by supporting and working together with the country procurement managers to deliver the best rates and services possible.
  • Negotiate rates for Key Accounts or high-volume accounts with regional carriers.
  • Responsible for ensuring the competitiveness of the product framework within the region for the trade, including freight rates, freight surcharges, carrier pick-up and drop-off tariffs, and detention and demurrage conditions.
  • Manage the suggested selling rates and Cloud Ocean Line Tariffs within the trade to ensure a high degree of competitiveness that drives both profitability and market share growth.

Business Development

  • Support the commercial teams by visiting customers that are strategic for the region or the product globally, with a focus on regional and Global Key Accounts.
  • Present Rhenus trade performance to C-level Executives and target Key Accounts.

Trade Market Intelligence Management

  • Enable channeling market intelligence between local and regional offices to ensure exceptional trade understanding. The information must be actionable and insightful, always within the frameworks set by the Global and Regional Product Teams. This includes maintaining a working rapport with Country management by providing expertise and education in capacity, pricing, and product management.
  • Organize a monthly Broadcast summarizing the key information for the trade lane to local procurement and key commercial stakeholders.
  • Spearhead an analytical approach to assess the competitiveness of Rhenus' rate levels.

What you bring

  • Minimum 5 years’ experience in an ocean procurement role in freight forwarding company or ocean carrier experience.
  • Minimum 5 years’ experience in people management and leadership, including recruitment, training & development, coaching, conflict, and performance management.
  • Service minded and with a high degree of ownership, excellent commercial understanding.
  • Proven track record in the trade lane management with shipping lines
  • Negotiation skills and confident manner
  • Proactive and capable of handle responsibility without needing to be micromanaged.
  • Excellent cross-cultural communication (both oral and written) and interpersonal skills.
  • Outgoing personality, while able to communicate well in English both spoken and written.
  • Strong analytical and organizational skills
  • Able to work under pressure and to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Result driven and persistent in meeting day to day challenges and goals.
  • Ability to multi-task in an intense, fast-paced, high-energy, environment.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Demonstrate confidence as a performer and lead by example.
  • Willingness to travel as needed.
  • Ability to maintain a focus on simplicity while dealing with complex challenges.

Business Unit

Air & Ocean

Regardless of whether it is a long-distance shipment or a particularly time-critical shipment, we at Rhenus make everything possible for our customers and partners to get the goods to their destination safely and on time. Our particular strength lies in our global network, which is constantly being maintained and expanded. As part of Rhenus Air & Ocean you can, therefore, expect to find a whole host of exciting tasks all over the world, a wide range of opportunities for personal development, and the chance to take on responsibility in an international working environment.

Welcome to Rhenus

Where our journey of growth connects with yours.

We are a global powerhouse on a mission to be pioneers in everything we do. United, we make an impact and dare to redefine what's possible. Ready to unlock untapped potential. We are on the fast track. At Rhenus, we thrive on collaboration. Every voice is heard, and every idea is valued. We stand as one global team. Where everyone contributes to our success. Together, we shape the future of logistics and beyond. Empowered by you.

title: Slagtermester, SuperBrugsen Jelling
description:
Vi søger en slagtermester til SuperBrugsen Jelling

Er du til lammekrone, traditioner og trends, service og salg?

Hvis ja, så skulle du overveje at blive slagtermester i vores butik, hvor du skal inspirere kunderne og udvikle fremtidens måltider og afdelingen. Du sætter en ære i dit håndværk og ved, at fællesskab og samarbejde er vejen frem.

Fokus på at leve op til kundernes forskellige og skiftende behov

I MadCooperativet er det kundernes behov, der dag for dag sætter menuen med et fristende udvalg. Der er noget for enhver smag og til enhver tid. Med din faglige bagage og dit engagement er det dit ansvar, at:

  • tilbyde gode og lækre varer, der alle ugens dage afspejler kundernes behov fra morgen til aften
  • rådgive og inspirere kunderne til god mad og også gerne vinen, der passer til
  • sætte fokus på nemme måltidsløsninger og frokostretter
  • sørge for produktion, fødevaresikkerhed, salg og arbejdsplaner i afdelingen

Dit mål er at skabe de bedste kundeoplevelser, salg og gode resultater

Det er dig, der:

  • ejer, driver og udvikler afdelingens salg og indtjening gennem formidling af fremtidens måltider og professionelt håndværk
  • har ansvaret for at nå budgetter og målsætninger
  • viser vejen i forhold til at give kunderne den bedste service og rådgivning
  • har ansvar for samarbejde på tværs
  • deltager i møder og giver input til strategien for butikken

Faglig stolthed og glimt i øjet

Din personlighed er lige så vigtig som din faglige stolthed. Du går forrest med godt humør, og alle skal kunne mærke, at du gør det, du er bedst til:

  • Du er uddannet slagter eller har erfaring som slagter, gerne fra detailbranchen
  • Du har kendskab til planlægning af produktion og bevarer overblikket i en travl hverdag
  • Du kan dit håndværk og dine udskæringer – og elsker at lave mad
  • Du er ambitiøs i forhold til at udvikle dig selv

Du sælger både gode varer og gode værdier

Som en del af SuperBrugsen skal du brænde for at gøre hverdagen lettere, sundere og mere økologisk og bæredygtig. Med SuperBrugsens stærke lokale forankring skal du være med til sikre, at butikken lever op til de værdier og den ånd, vi er kendt for.

Nyd de bedste forudsætninger for en professionel og effektiv produktion – og attraktive personalegoder

Hos os har du og dit team gode produktionsforhold og alle muligheder for at dyrke og udvikle håndværket. Samtidigt får du gode, fleksible arbejdsforhold, uddannelses-og udviklingsmuligheder og også personalegoder som fx personalerabat og adgang til feriehuse til meget fordelagtige priser.

Spørg løs, hvis du vil med på holdet

Har du spørgsmål, så ring eller skriv til uddeler Heidi Petersen, mobil2494 3053 eller skriv til heidi.rubow.petersen@superbrugsen.dk

Er du vores nye slagtermester, så send din ansøgning via "Søg job" – vi afholder samtaler løbende.

Kom tæt på lokalmiljøet i Danmarks største supermarkedskæde

I SuperBrugsen arbejder vi ud fra vores DNA, som er kvalitet, ansvarlighed og fællesskab. Det betyder at vi tager ansvar for vores beslutninger, arbejder sammen på tværs for at skabe de bedste resultater, og vi tror på at kvalitet opstår, når vi deler viden, løfter i flok og tager et fælles ansvar.

I SuperBrugsen ønsker vi at være tæt på kunderne og være en del af lokalsamfundet. Vores kunder skal kende os og de skal kunne finde varer fra lokale producenter i deres butik, samtidig med, at vi støtter lokale Initiativer. I SuperBrugsen er der også plads til at prøve nye ideer af og som Danmarks største supermarkedskæde er der masser af udviklingsmuligheder for at skabe din karriere.

Bliver du ansat i SuperBrugsen bliver du en del af Coop-familien. Vi er omkring 40.000 medarbejdere og sammen med brugsforeningerne har vi en samlet omsætning på mere end 40 milliarder kr. i vores ca. 900 butikker over hele Danmark. Derfor er der mange muligheder for både nye opgaver og uddannelse og ikke mindst jobskifte internt i Coop. Vi er ejet af vores 2 million medlemmer og det andelsejede Energiselskab OK.

Vi værdsætter mangfoldighed og søger kvalificerede kandidater uanset baggrund. Sammen skaber vi plads til forskellighed, faglighed og kvalitet. Derfor sikrer vi en retfærdig rekrutteringsproces, hvor det er op til dig, om du vil vedhæfte ansøgning og billede.
